plugin_fields.source: It's no fun getting pushed around all the time...
plugin_fields.target: 大家老是欺負我。這可一點也不有趣…
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I don't know what you did, but Braith won't even look at me now! So thanks!
plugin_fields.target: 我不知道你做了什麼，但是布賴絲現在甚至都不敢看我了！謝謝你！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: My friend Olava? The seer? She says things will get better for me, once I start sticking up for myself.
plugin_fields.target: 我的朋友奧拉瓦？那個先知？她說只要我能改變態度，事情會好轉的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I can't fight. Not even a little bit. My family thinks I'm a little milk drinker.
plugin_fields.target: 我不會打架。一點也不會。家裡人都說我還沒斷奶呢。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Ripe fruit and fresh vegetables for sale! Straight from the fields and orchards of Whiterun to your table!
plugin_fields.target: 賣熟透的水果和新鮮的蔬菜！剛從田裡和白漫城的果園摘來的，直接送上你的餐桌！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Fresh-baked loaves, still warm from the oven!
plugin_fields.target: 剛出爐的麵包，還熱騰騰的呢！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I've got a hungry daughter to feed, so selling my produce is really the only thing I care about.
plugin_fields.target: 我有個女兒要養，所以我滿腦子只想著做生意的事情。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I hope you're looking at me like that because you want to buy something?
plugin_fields.target: 我希望你那樣看著我是因為你想買點什麼？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: What're you lookin' at? I'm not afraid of you, ya know. Even if you are my elder.
plugin_fields.target: 你在看什麼？我不怕你，你知道的。就算你是我的長輩也一樣。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Boys, girls, dogs, elders - there's nobody I won't fight!
plugin_fields.target: 男孩、女孩、狗狗、長輩——沒什麼我不敢打的！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Do you get to the Cloud District very often? Oh, what am I saying - of course you don't.
plugin_fields.target: 你常去雲頂區嗎？哦，我在說什麼呀——你當然不常去了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Oh, it took years, but I earned my way to the top. I own Chillfurrow Farm, you see. Very successful business. Obviously.
plugin_fields.target: 哦，花了我好些年，但我終於掙出了自己的出路。我擁有寒犁農場，正如你所見。生意不錯。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I actually advise the Jarl on political matters. My input is invaluable, of course. But this is all probably a bit over your head.
plugin_fields.target: 我其實是領主的政治顧問。當然，我的建議很寶貴。但我想和你說了也不會懂。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: There's been talk amongst the guards. That you are... Dragonborn. But such a thing... Surely that's not possible...
plugin_fields.target: 最近衛兵們經常聊起你。他們說你是……龍裔。但是這種事……怎麼可能嘛。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You... you're the Harbinger. Of the Companions. It is my honor to stand before you.
plugin_fields.target: 你……你是先驅。戰友團的先驅。能站在你面前實在是我的榮幸。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Whoa, whoa, whoa! Watch the magic!
plugin_fields.target: 哇哦！哇哦！哇哦！小心你的魔法！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Go cast your fancy magic someplace else.
plugin_fields.target: 到別處放你那花哨的魔法。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Guard might get nervous, a man approaches with his weapon drawn...
plugin_fields.target: 一個拿著武器晃悠的男人是會讓人緊張的……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Guard might get nervous, a woman approaches with her weapon drawn...
plugin_fields.target: 一個拿著武器晃悠的女人是會讓人緊張的……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You see those warriors from Hammerfell? They've got curved swords. Curved. Swords.
plugin_fields.target: 你看到那些從落錘省來的戰士了嗎？他們有弧形的彎劍，弧形的——劍！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: No lollygaggin'.
plugin_fields.target: 不要浪費時間了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Let me guess - someone stole your sweetroll...
plugin_fields.target: 讓我猜猜~你的甜捲被人偷了……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'd be a lot warmer and a lot happier with a bellyful of mead...
plugin_fields.target: 每天灌點蜂蜜酒真是舒服又暖和呀。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Disrespect the law, and you disrespect me.
plugin_fields.target: 蔑視法律，你就是蔑視我。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: My cousin's out fighting dragons, and what do I get? Guard duty.
plugin_fields.target: 我兄弟出去屠龍了，我呢？在這裡當門衛。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I used to be an adventurer like you. Then I took an arrow in the knee...
plugin_fields.target: 我以前和你一樣是個冒險家，直到我的膝蓋中了一箭…
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Everything all right?
plugin_fields.target: 沒什麼情況吧？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Trouble?
plugin_fields.target: 有麻煩嗎？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Staying safe, I hope?
plugin_fields.target: 我看沒什麼危險吧？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I mostly deal with petty thievery and drunken brawls. Been too long since we've had a good bandit raid.
plugin_fields.target: 我大部分時間都在對付小賊和醉鬼，很少有機會和真正的強盜對抗。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: If you're heading to the Blue Palace, you might want to rethink that outfit.
plugin_fields.target: 如果你要向藍宮那邊走的話，你或許需要重新打理你的衣著。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: If you ever want to replace those old rags, stop by Radiant Raiment.
plugin_fields.target: 想換掉你身上那些破布的話，去錦衣服飾店看看吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Why, hello! Here to buy? If you have to ask the price, you may be in the wrong store.
plugin_fields.target: 哎呀，你好，來這裡買東西啊？如果你還得要問價格，那你可能走錯店家了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: We provide clothing for all of Solitude's most... influential residents. But for you, I'll make an exception.
plugin_fields.target: 我們為整個獨孤城的最……有影響力的居民們準備服裝。至於你，我可以破例一次。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Oh, what delight. Another charming customer...
plugin_fields.target: 哦，真讓人高興！又一個迷人的顧客……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So good to see you again. How can I be of service?
plugin_fields.target: 再一次見到你，真是太好了。我能幫你什麼？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Let me just drop everything to help you. I don't mind. Really.
plugin_fields.target: 讓我放下手頭的事情去幫你。我不介意，真的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I can help with purchases, but if you came to talk, see my sister. She's the one who gets on with people. It's her one virtue, really.
plugin_fields.target: 如果你是來買東西的，我可以幫上你的忙。但是如果你是來閒聊的，請去找我姐姐。她唯一的優點就是跟任何人都處得來，真的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'm looking for work. Got any leads?
plugin_fields.target: 我是來找工作的。有什麼可以介紹的嗎？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: The Jarl has put out a bounty on some bandits. Here, take a look at this decree for details.
plugin_fields.target: 領主懸賞捉拿幾個強盜，這是詳細資訊。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Another wanderer, here to lick my father's boots. Good job.
plugin_fields.target: 又一個無所事事的流浪漢，跑來舔我爸的鞋底？做得好。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: The only grownups who talk to me are the kind I don't want talking to me.
plugin_fields.target: 願意和我聊天的大人們都是那種我不想和他們講話的人。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Have I done something to make you bother me?
plugin_fields.target: 我做錯了什麼，為何你要來找我麻煩？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'm looking for work. Got any leads?
plugin_fields.target: 我是來找工作的。有什麼可以介紹的嗎？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: The Jarl has put out a bounty to slay a giant. Here, take a look at this decree for details.
plugin_fields.target: 領主已經為殺死巨人釋出了懸賞令。拿去，好好看一下懸賞令的細節吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'm looking for work. Got any leads?
plugin_fields.target: 我是來找工作的。有什麼可以介紹的嗎？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: The Jarl has put out a bounty on Forsworn. Here, take a look at this decree for details.
plugin_fields.target: 領主已經為殺死棄誓者釋出了懸賞令。拿去，好好看一下懸賞令的細節吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'm looking for work. Got any leads?
plugin_fields.target: 我是來找工作的。有什麼可以介紹的嗎？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: The Jarl has put out a bounty on the dragon that's been terrorizing the countryside. Here, take a look at this decree for details.
plugin_fields.target: 領主正在懸賞捕殺滋擾鄉鄰的巨龍。來，這張紙上寫得更詳細。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Ripe fruit and fresh vegetables for sale!
plugin_fields.target: 這有熟透的水果，新鮮的蔬菜快來買！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Fresh-baked loaves, still warm from the oven!
plugin_fields.target: 剛出爐的麵包，還熱騰騰的呢！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Wait here.
plugin_fields.target: 在這裡等著。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: OK, I guess I'll wait a while but I'm not waiting forever.
plugin_fields.target: 好吧，我會乖乖等一會兒的，不過我可不會永遠等下去。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: OK I'll be here... maybe.
plugin_fields.target: 好吧，我會在這兒等著的……大概。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Fine... let me get killed. Oh don't worry I can handle myself.
plugin_fields.target: 行吧……就讓我被砍死好了。噢別擔心，我自己能搞定。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'll just sit here like a good doggie.
plugin_fields.target: 我會像隻乖狗狗一樣坐在這兒的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Why do you get to have all the fun?
plugin_fields.target: 憑什麼全讓你一個人去爽了？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I hope I don't get plundered by bandits... Unless they happen to be good looking of course.
plugin_fields.target: 希望我不會遇上強盜打劫……當然，如果他們長得足夠帥那就另當別論了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'll be here, unless I find someone better to stalk.
plugin_fields.target: 我會在這兒等你的，除非我找到個更值得尾隨的傢夥。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Don't be too long. I hate having to entertain myself.
plugin_fields.target: 別去太久了哦。我討厭無聊得只能自娛自樂。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Don't you dare forget and leave me here otherwise I am gone.
plugin_fields.target: 你敢把我忘了扔在這兒試試，不然我就自己走人了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Good, I needed a rest anyways.
plugin_fields.target: 很好，不管怎樣我也需要歇會兒了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Wake me up when you get back.
plugin_fields.target: 你回來的時候記得叫醒我。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Don't take too long!
plugin_fields.target: 別磨蹭太久！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Okay... okay...
plugin_fields.target: 好啦……好啦……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Don't take too long, I'll either be gone or asleep.
plugin_fields.target: 可別去太久了，不然我要麼走人了，要麼就直接睡死過去了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: OK I'll be here... maybe.
plugin_fields.target: 好吧，我會在這兒等著……大概。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: It might be good to check the stables if I'm not here anymore... hehe
plugin_fields.target: 如果我不在這兒的話，你去馬廄裡找找也許會有收穫……呵呵。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You would leave your wife all on her own?
plugin_fields.target: 你居然要把你老婆一個人丟在這裡？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: If you don't come back for me, I will make sure that you never come back at all.
plugin_fields.target: 如果你不回來找我，我保證你以後再也回不來了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Oh trust me you don't want to leave me for too long otherwise you will never hear the last of it.
plugin_fields.target: 噢相信我，你不會想離開我太久的，否則我以後能拿這事唸叨你一輩子。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I would like to trade some things with you.
plugin_fields.target: 我想和你交換些物品。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: OK but next time you can carry my stuff.
plugin_fields.target: 好吧，不過下次你可得幫我背東西。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well OK but only because it's you.
plugin_fields.target: 好吧，不過只因為是你我才拿的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: OK but if I hurt my back you'll be carrying me.
plugin_fields.target: 行吧，不過如果我閃了腰，你可得把我揹回去。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Yippee I love holding peoples junk.
plugin_fields.target: 太棒了，我就喜歡給別人收破爛。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Do I have a choice? Well OK but you owe me.
plugin_fields.target: 我有得選嗎？行吧，但你欠我一次。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Oops, I dropped something... Just kidding.
plugin_fields.target: 哎呀，我東西掉了……開玩笑啦。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Uh oh, I hope that wasn't valuable... Haha You should have seen your face.
plugin_fields.target: 啊噢，希望那不是什麼貴重物品……哈哈，你真該看看你剛才的表情。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: OK, but don't push your luck.
plugin_fields.target: 行吧，但你別得寸進尺。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: How about for a change you do something to... I mean for me.
plugin_fields.target: 換個花樣怎麼樣？你來對我做些……呃我是說幫我做些事。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Are you sure you want to trust me with that?
plugin_fields.target: 你確定你要放心把它交給我？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: How about you take me instead... Damn it that came out wrong.
plugin_fields.target: 要不你乾脆「要」了我吧……該死，這話聽起來不對勁。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Fine but don't take advantage of me... At least not in that way.
plugin_fields.target: 行吧，但你可別佔我便宜……至少別用這種方式來佔便宜。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I take it by trade you mean dump all your useless junk on me. Fine.
plugin_fields.target: 我就當你的「交換」是指把你那些沒用的垃圾全扔給我吧。行吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Why must I hump all these stupid objects just to please you? I mean hump as in carrying stuff by the way not that kind.
plugin_fields.target: 為什麼我非得天天去「幹」這些蠢東西來取悅你？順便一提，我是說「幹活」的幹，別想歪了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Before your dirty mind gets any ideas.
plugin_fields.target: 以防你那骯髒的小腦瓜裡又蹦出什麼齷齪的想法。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Do I get more booze?
plugin_fields.target: 能再給我點酒喝嗎？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Yeaaaah... sure, some things.
plugin_fields.target: 行——啊……當然了，就一點兒。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Aaahh, not too heavy right?
plugin_fields.target: 啊，別太重了對吧？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Right now? OK, but don't complain if I move too slow!
plugin_fields.target: 現在？行吧，但如果我走得太慢，你可別抱怨！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: If it's jewelry, I won't complain.
plugin_fields.target: 如果是珠寶的話，我才不會發牢騷呢。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Sure... wait, what was the question?
plugin_fields.target: 當然啦……等等，剛才你問我啥來著？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I may be your wife but I'm certainly not your slave.
plugin_fields.target: 我的確是你的老婆，但這可不代表我就是你的奴隸了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: If it's a load of old junk then you will be sleeping on the floor tonight.
plugin_fields.target: 如果是一堆破銅爛鐵，那你今晚就只能睡地板了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: This better be good otherwise I will be stopping all privileges if you know what I mean.
plugin_fields.target: 最好是好東西，否則我就會取消你所有的「特權」，你懂我的意思吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: OK I guess in a relationship you have to share responsibility but don't you start slacking off.
plugin_fields.target: 好吧，我想夫妻之間責任確實應該共同分擔，但你可別藉機偷懶。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: All this marriage stuff better not be making you weak.
plugin_fields.target: 結個婚最好別讓你變得軟弱無力了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: It's time for us to part ways
plugin_fields.target: 是時候分道揚鑣了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'm gonna miss you... Well not really. OK maybe a little.
plugin_fields.target: 我會想你的……好吧並沒有。行吧，也許還是有一點想你。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: OK but don't blame me when you get eaten by a sabrecat or mauled by a bear.
plugin_fields.target: 好吧，但當你被劍齒虎吃乾抹淨或是被熊生吞活剝的時候，你可別怪我。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well OK but you better come and see me again.
plugin_fields.target: 好吧，但你最好再回來看看我。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Are you breaking up with me? Oh well see you.
plugin_fields.target: 你要和我分手？噢好吧，再見不送。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: OK but you'll be back... won't you?
plugin_fields.target: 好吧，但你會回來的……對吧？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: If you find somebody else I will hunt them down. Not really.
plugin_fields.target: 如果你敢去找別人，我會把他大卸八塊的。開玩笑的啦。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: But I was having so much fun. Maybe next time we'll have some real fun.
plugin_fields.target: 但是我才剛剛玩得盡興呢。也許下次我們應該找點真正的「樂子」。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'll just find someone even better to hang around with then. Don't you get jealous.
plugin_fields.target: 我會找個更好的人去結伴同行的。到時候你可別吃醋哦。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: What's wrong with me? Am I not enough for you? OK, OK I understand.
plugin_fields.target: 我做錯什麼了？難道我還不能滿足你嗎？好吧，好了我懂了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: OK but I want to see more of you... much more.
plugin_fields.target: 好吧，但是我想和你相處得更久一些……要久得多。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: HA... very funny.
plugin_fields.target: 哈……真逗。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: That's a good one.
plugin_fields.target: 那句還不錯。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: No no no, there's time for serious business later.
plugin_fields.target: 不不不，以後有的是時間辦正事。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You better be off to earn some more gold.
plugin_fields.target: 你最好趕緊去賺點金幣。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You better not be seeing someone else behind my back.
plugin_fields.target: 你最好別趁我不在去勾搭別的傢夥。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: As your wife I have a right to go where I please... OK OK I'll give you a little space.
plugin_fields.target: 作為你的老婆，我有權去我想去的任何地方……好吧好吧，我會給你點個人空間的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Follow me.
plugin_fields.target: 跟著我。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I knew you couldn't stay away from me.
plugin_fields.target: 我就知道你離不開我。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Anything to please you... Well maybe not anything.
plugin_fields.target: 只要能讓你高興什麼都行……好吧，也許不是什麼都行。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Why should I follow you? Actually, I can think of a few good reasons.
plugin_fields.target: 為什麼我要跟著你呢？說實話，我倒是能想到幾個好理由。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: OK let's go pick some flowers... just kidding, I want to go and kill something.
plugin_fields.target: 好啦，咱們採花去吧……開玩笑的啦，我只想去宰個活物過過癮。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You came back for me? I mean of course you did.
plugin_fields.target: 你專門回來找我的？我的意思是，那是必須的嘛。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I was kind of hoping you would come back.
plugin_fields.target: 我還挺盼著你回來的呢。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Thank goodness it's you. I thought you were a stalker... no offense.
plugin_fields.target: 謝天謝地，是你。我還以為是個什麼跟蹤狂呢……別介意啊。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well, I have nothing better to do I suppose.
plugin_fields.target: 好吧，反正我也沒啥更好的事可做。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You've been thinking about me haven't you?
plugin_fields.target: 你一直在想著我，對不對？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You can take me anytime... Uh I mean you can take me with you... yeah.
plugin_fields.target: 你隨時都可以把我「收」了……呃，我的意思是收下我一起走……對。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: No. Why would I want to follow you? Haha I'm just kidding of course.
plugin_fields.target: 我才不。我憑什麼要跟著你？哈哈，我當然是在開玩笑啦。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I have been so bored. I never thought I'd want you so bad... Uh I mean want to see you.
plugin_fields.target: 我無聊透頂了。我從來沒想過我會這麼地想要你……呃，我是說想要見你。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw
Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; manually reviewed target

plugin_fields.source: Can I talk to you for a bit?
plugin_fields.target: 我能跟你聊一會兒嗎？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Sure. What's on your mind?
plugin_fields.target: 當然。你在想什麼？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: What would you like to talk about?
plugin_fields.target: 你想聊些什麼呢？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'm always ready for a chat.
plugin_fields.target: 要聊天的話我隨時奉陪。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Of course.
plugin_fields.target: 當然。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You can ask me anything.
plugin_fields.target: 想問什麼儘管問。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw
Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; manually reviewed target

plugin_fields.source: Are you trying to avoid my question?
plugin_fields.target: 你在顧左右而言他嗎？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Okay okay. My parents were killed by bandits when I was young. Those cowards picked them because they were easy targets.
plugin_fields.target: 好吧好吧，我的父母在我很小的時候就被強盜給殺了。那些懦夫專挑軟柿子捏。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I guess they couldn't bring themselves to kill a child so I was spared.
plugin_fields.target: 我想他們是不忍心對一個小毛孩下毒手，所以我才僥倖逃過一劫。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I suppose it taught me just how harsh this world can be. It only made me stronger though as I spent years taking out my frustration
plugin_fields.target: 這教會了我這個世界到底有多麼殘酷。不過這也讓我變得更強大了，我花了好幾年的時間將我的滿腔怒火發洩在
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: by training daily with my sword and bow.
plugin_fields.target: 每天苦練劍術和弓箭上。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I challenge you to find a tougher opponent in all of Skyrim and to make things even better I have the advantage of getting the first strike
plugin_fields.target: 我敢說在整個天際你都找不到比我更難纏的對手，更妙的是我總是能搶佔先手，
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: as no one would ever see someone as cute and innocent as me as a threat and I can charm my way around any man or woman in seconds.
plugin_fields.target: 因為根本沒人會把像我這樣可愛又清純的人當成威脅，而且我分分鐘就能迷倒周圍的任何男女。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So I wouldn't get on my bad side as you wouldn't even see it coming.
plugin_fields.target: 所以最好別惹毛我，否則你怎麼死的都不知道。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I also spent some time at the College of Winterhold. Not because I particularly wanted to learn magic but I needed a place to stay, so I could
plugin_fields.target: 我也在冬堡學院混過一陣子。倒不是因為我有多想學魔法，我只是需要個地方落腳而已。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I had to leave the college though as it betrays the mighty ways of the nord warrior and was no place for a nord like me.
plugin_fields.target: 但我最後不得不離開學院，因為它背離了諾德戰士的強大之道，根本不適合像我這樣的諾德人。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Although I suppose using the odd spell doesn't make me a traitor.
plugin_fields.target: 儘管我覺得偶爾用用那些奇怪的法術也不至於讓我變成叛徒吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Hold onto these please but don't use them.(Storage)
plugin_fields.target: 請帶上這些，但不要拿來用。（獨立儲藏空間）
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Are you saying you don't trust me? Fair point actually. I wouldn't trust me.
plugin_fields.target: 你是說你信不過我？說實話，還挺有道理的。連我自己都信不過我自己。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Hmph. You're no fun.
plugin_fields.target: 哼，你真沒勁。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Is it because you're scared what I might do with it?
plugin_fields.target: 難道是因為你害怕我會拿它做些出格的事？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I can't promise anything.
plugin_fields.target: 我可不敢保證什麼。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Are you sure you want to do that now? I can barely hold a drink.
plugin_fields.target: 你確定現在要弄這個？我連杯酒都快端不穩了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Hmpf, you're no fun.
plugin_fields.target: 哼，你真沒勁。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'll probably forget.
plugin_fields.target: 我大機率會忘個精光。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: If I fall, it's your fault!
plugin_fields.target: 如果我摔倒了，那全怪你！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: We are married yet you still keep things from me?
plugin_fields.target: 我們都已經結婚了，你居然還有事瞞著我？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Fine but if you keep anything good from me then I will keep something good from you. Understand?
plugin_fields.target: 很好，要是你敢背著我藏什麼好東西，那我的「好東西」你也休想再碰。明白了嗎？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: OK I guess you can still keep a few belongings but the gold is mine... I mean ours.
plugin_fields.target: 好吧，我猜你還是可以留點私人物品的，但金幣都是我的……我是說我們的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: We may be married but I guess some things will never change.
plugin_fields.target: 雖然我們結了婚，但我想有些東西是永遠不會變的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Follow me. I need your help.
plugin_fields.target: 跟著我。我需要你的幫助。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I knew you couldn't stay away from me.
plugin_fields.target: 我就知道你捨不得離開我。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Why should I follow you? Actually, I can think of a few good reasons.
plugin_fields.target: 為什麼我要跟著你呢？說實話，我倒是能想到幾個好理由。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: OK let's go pick some flowers... just kidding, I want to go and kill something.
plugin_fields.target: 好吧，讓我們採花去吧……開玩笑啦，我只想去宰點什麼。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You came back for me? I mean of course you did.
plugin_fields.target: 你專門回來找我的？我的意思是，那是必須的嘛。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I was kind of hoping you would come back.
plugin_fields.target: 我還挺盼著你回來的呢。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Thank goodness it's you. I thought you were a stalker... no offense.
plugin_fields.target: 謝天謝地，是你。我還以為是個什麼跟蹤狂呢……別介意啊。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well, I have nothing better to do I suppose.
plugin_fields.target: 好吧，反正我也沒啥更好的事可做。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You've been thinking about me haven't you?
plugin_fields.target: 你一直在想我，對不對？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You can take me anytime...Uh I mean you can take me with you... yeah.
plugin_fields.target: 你可以隨時把我「拿下」……呃，我是說帶我一起上路……對的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: No. Why would I want to follow you? Ha ha I'm just kidding of course.
plugin_fields.target: 不要。我憑什麼要跟著你？哈哈我當然是在開玩笑啦。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Anything to please you... Well maybe not anything.
plugin_fields.target: 只要能讓你高興什麼都行……好吧，也許不是什麼都行。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I have been so bored. I never thought I'd want you so bad... Uh I mean want to see you.
plugin_fields.target: 我無聊透頂了。我從來沒想過我會這麼地想要你……呃，我是說想要見你。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Can I ask you to do something for me?
plugin_fields.target: 我能讓你為我做些事情嗎？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw
Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; manually reviewed target

plugin_fields.source: Hyagh!
plugin_fields.target: 哈呀！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Heughh!
plugin_fields.target: 嘿！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Huughh!
plugin_fields.target: 喝啊！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Hughh!
plugin_fields.target: 嘿呀！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Heauugh!
plugin_fields.target: 嘿-呀！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Hueghh!
plugin_fields.target: 喝呀！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Heughh!
plugin_fields.target: 嘿！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Heuurghh!
plugin_fields.target: 嘿—呀！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Heeyyyaggh!
plugin_fields.target: 嘿——呀！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Heeyaaghh!
plugin_fields.target: 嘿——呀啊！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Hiiyyyaaaghh!
plugin_fields.target: 喝———呀啊！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: The guards in Skyrim are a miserable bunch.
plugin_fields.target: 天際的衛兵可真是一群悲催的傢夥。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: We risk life and limb slaying wolves, bandits and a lot worse all day and they complain about a single arrow in the knee.
plugin_fields.target: 我們整天冒著斷胳膊斷腿的風險去消滅狼群、強盜和更糟的怪物，而他們居然只知道抱怨膝蓋裡中了那麼一小箭。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Children creep me out. Is it me or do they all look the same? If we had kids what do you suppose they would look like?
plugin_fields.target: 這些孩子真讓人發毛。是我的錯覺還是他們長得一模一樣？如果我們有了孩子，你覺得他們會長成什麼樣？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Oh no... I meant hypothetically not that I would want to... although you are... I'm just going to shut up now before I really embarrass myself.
plugin_fields.target: 噢不……我是說假設啦，不是說我真想跟你生……雖然你確實……算了，趁我還沒把自己糗死之前我還是閉嘴吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Does drinking milk make me a milk drinker?
plugin_fields.target: 喝牛奶真的會讓我變成一個沒斷奶的懦夫嗎？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'm confused. I drink milk but I'm also tough and drink as much mead as the other Nords so what does that make me.
plugin_fields.target: 我真搞不懂，我喝牛奶但我同樣強壯，而且我和其他諾德人一樣能灌蜂蜜酒，那我到底算什麼人？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I do love causing a stir. Once I started singing at the top of my voice and someone told me to stop shouting...
plugin_fields.target: 我喜歡搞點大動靜。有次我扯著嗓子唱歌，居然有人叫我別亂吼了……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: then I replied do I look Dragonborn or like one of those creepy old guys who live on the mountain tops to you?
plugin_fields.target: 然後我懟了回去：你覺得我看起來像龍裔，還是像那些住在山頂的怪老頭？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Do you think I'm pretty? I'm feeling a little self-conscious. I love saying that to guys when they are with their wives.
plugin_fields.target: 你覺得我漂亮嗎？我對自己稍微有點不自信呢。我最愛在那些男人帶著老婆的時候這麼問他們了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: They don't know what to say as if they say yes their wives get jealous and if they say no I pretend to be really upset and they feel bad.
plugin_fields.target: 他們會不知道該說什麼，因為如果說漂亮，他們的老婆會吃醋；如果說不漂亮，我就假裝非常難過，然後他們就會很內疚。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: What? I have to amuse myself somehow.
plugin_fields.target: 幹嘛？我總得找點樂子吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Don't think I don't see you eyeing me up and down.
plugin_fields.target: 別以為我沒看見你那雙色瞇瞇的眼睛在上下打量我。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'm not just eye candy you know. I do have other uses and if you're thinking what I think you are thinking then think again.
plugin_fields.target: 我可不是個花瓶。我能幹的事多著呢，如果你腦子裡想的真是我猜的那檔子事，那你趁早打消這個念頭吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I do like to be admired though I must admit.
plugin_fields.target: 不過我必須承認，我確實享受被注視的感覺。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I get a lot of looks from people wherever I go. I'm not sure if it's because they find me attractive or because they think I'm a little odd or both.
plugin_fields.target: 無論走到哪兒我總是萬眾矚目。不知道是因為他們覺得我魅力四射，還是覺得我這人腦子有點古怪，抑或是兩者兼有。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Damn it all this walking is giving me a front wedgie. Oh I said that out loud didn't I.
plugin_fields.target: 該死的，走了這麼久的路，內褲都卡進前面那道溝裡了。噢，我剛才是不是大聲說出來了？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I can get away with anything in Skyrim. I just act all cute and innocent and the guards turn a blind eye.
plugin_fields.target: 在天際我做什麼都能脫身。我只要表現得可愛又無辜，守衛們就會睜一隻眼閉一隻眼。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Not that I'm a bad person or anything. Most of the time.
plugin_fields.target: 倒也不是說我是個多壞的人啦。至少大部分時間不是。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I can't help feeling a kind of connection between us. I'm not sure what it is.
plugin_fields.target: 我總感覺我們之間有種說不清道不明的羈絆。雖然我也不確定那是什麼。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I guess it's natural with you being a brave adventurer and me, well... you know.
plugin_fields.target: 我想這很自然吧，畢竟你是個勇敢的冒險家，而我嘛……你懂的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I bet if a guy found out his wife was Dragonborn he wouldn't be best pleased. Men already constantly complain about being shouted at by their wives.
plugin_fields.target: 我敢打賭，如果一個男人發現自己老婆是個龍裔，他絕對笑不出來。畢竟男人們已經整天抱怨被老婆「吼」了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I mean can you imagine a Dragonborn woman shouting at her husband, that would really give him something to complain about.
plugin_fields.target: 你能想像一個龍裔對著她老公「吐龍吼」的畫面嗎，那才真的叫有得他受的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Imagine if I was Dragonborn. The term shouting would take on an entirely new meaning.
plugin_fields.target: 想像一下如果我是龍裔。那「大吼大叫」這個詞絕對會被賦予一層全新的內涵。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I think I need to go to bed after all this walking. Care to join me... Oh no I didn't mean you know. I meant separate...
plugin_fields.target: 走了這麼久，我想我該上床睡覺了。你想加入嗎……噢不，我不是那個意思。我的意思是各睡各的……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I think I should just stop talking.
plugin_fields.target: 我看我還是閉嘴吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: It's not about how much gold you have, it's about how much of it you spend on me.
plugin_fields.target: 重點不在於你有多少錢，而在於你願意為我花多少錢。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: It was a joke, honest, although I wouldn't mind a new dress or maybe a necklace.
plugin_fields.target: 開個玩笑，真的。不過我不介意你送我一條新裙子，或者一條項鍊也行。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I've always wondered... Since when people die they take their final form as they were when they died, if you die naked does your spirit remain naked?
plugin_fields.target: 我一直很好奇……既然人死後靈魂會保持死時的模樣，那如果光著身子死掉，靈魂豈不是個裸鬼？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I can't say I fancy roaming around either in Sovngarde or as a ghost without any clothes on. Well at least not all the time.
plugin_fields.target: 我可不想光著屁股在安息聖域瞎逛，或者當個裸奔的幽靈。嗯，至少不能一直光著吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I wonder what would happen if a Khajiit and an Argonian had a baby. That would be one ugly baby.
plugin_fields.target: 我想知道如果凱季特人和阿爾貢人生了孩子會怎樣。那絕對是個醜到爆的怪胎。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Do you think the Sabrecats and Khajiit are somehow related? They do seem similar except the Khajiit are more human.
plugin_fields.target: 你難道不覺得劍齒虎和凱季特人有某種血緣關係嗎？除了凱季特人長得更像人之外，他們簡直一模一樣嘛。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You don't suppose a human and a Sabrecat... No I'm not going there. People get a little touchy when I say that.
plugin_fields.target: 你該不會覺得是一個人類和一隻劍齒虎……不，我不往下說了。每次提到這個話題總有人會暴跳如雷。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Is it just me or does it sound a little inappropriate when the guards tell people to stop lollygagging.
plugin_fields.target: 難道只有我一個人覺得，當守衛警告別人「不要浪費時間了（lollygagging:lolly gag/口交）」的時候，聽起來有點不太正經嗎？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So have you ever read The Lusty Argonian Maid? It sounds like my kind of book.
plugin_fields.target: 你讀過《活力充沛的阿爾貢人女僕》嗎？這書聽起來挺對我的胃口。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: What? Just because I'm female doesn't mean I can't enjoy a nice classy piece of literature. I've heard it's quite intellectually stimulating.
plugin_fields.target: 幹嘛？誰規定女人就不能欣賞這種經典的高雅文學了？我聽說這書特別能「刺激」人的大腦。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Actually I just heard it was stimulating although I don't think it was the intellectual kind.
plugin_fields.target: 其實我只聽說是挺「刺激」的，不過估計刺激的不是大腦。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You and I make a great couple. Uh I mean like a team not like... Ah forget it.
plugin_fields.target: 咱倆真是一對絕配。呃我的意思是在隊伍裡，不是那種配對……啊算了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I don't get it. Men say they wouldn't mind piercing me with their arrow or stabbing me their sword and then walk away laughing. Should I be worried?
plugin_fields.target: 我真搞不懂。男人總是對我說，他們一點也不介意用長劍「刺」我，或者用弓箭「射」我，然後大笑著走開。我該感到擔心嗎？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I always miss the people I break up with... I need to learn to aim better with my bow.
plugin_fields.target: 對分手的人，我總是「射」不得……看來我得好好練練我的準頭了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: My parents were funny people... I mean weird funny not the ha ha kind.
plugin_fields.target: 我的父母都是挺有趣的人……我是說性格古怪的那種有趣，不是能逗得人哈哈大笑的那種。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: The people of Skyrim have very dirty minds. I say the most innocent of things and they all get the wrong idea.
plugin_fields.target: 天際的人思想都好骯髒。我隨口說句最純潔的話他們都能想歪。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I suppose you're a bit like that as well.
plugin_fields.target: 我看你也半斤八兩。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: People seem to think all Nords are racist but surely that itself is racist? I'm not racist though, I just don't like Khajiit or Argonians or elves.
plugin_fields.target: 人們總覺得諾德人都是種族主義者，但這說法本身不就是種族歧視嗎？我才不是種族主義者，我只是單純討厭凱季特人、阿爾貢人和精靈而已。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Come to think of it, I'm not that fond of Orcs, Redguards or Imperials either. Damn it I always end up upsetting someone, don't take it personally.
plugin_fields.target: 再仔細想想，我好像也不怎麼喜歡獸人、紅衛人和帝國人。該死的，我這張嘴總是得罪人，別介意啊。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: People think women are vain for trying to look good. Just because men are lazy and don't even bother having a wash doesn't mean we are vain.
plugin_fields.target: 人們總以為女人愛打扮就是愛慕虛榮。僅僅因為男人又懶連澡都懶得洗，並不意味著我們打扮就是虛榮。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Have you noticed that people seem to always say the same things? And people complain about me.
plugin_fields.target: 你有沒有注意到人們似乎總是說同樣的話？而大家居然還抱怨我。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: The last man who said women belong in the kitchen and should go back to their knitting soon ate his words when I punched him into Oblivion.
plugin_fields.target: 上一個對我說「女人就該待在廚房織毛衣」的男人，很快就把他的話嚥下去了——因為我一拳把他揍回了湮滅。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I think he must have been eating soup for quite a while after that, and I bet it wasn't a woman serving it.
plugin_fields.target: 估計他那之後的很長一段時間都只能靠喝流食度日了，我敢打賭伺候他的絕對不是個女人。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: When people think of wood elves they usually think of trees but not me. I'm a little too embarrassed to say what comes to mind.
plugin_fields.target: 人們一提起木精靈，首先想到的總是樹木，但我可不這麼想。不過我腦子裡聯想到的東西實在有些難以啟齒。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I wonder why the Dunmer are called dark elves. It makes them sound really evil.
plugin_fields.target: 我很好奇為什麼丹莫會被叫做暗精靈？這名字讓他們聽起來像個邪惡反派一樣。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I have noticed that there seems to be a trend of women wearing subtle amounts of war paint on their lips and around their eyes and cheeks.
plugin_fields.target: 我發現現在女人們流行在嘴唇、眼皮和臉頰上塗抹少量的戰爭塗裝，簡直成了新風尚。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Do you think I look attractive? Uh what I mean is does it make me look more attractive or did you not notice?
plugin_fields.target: 你覺得我迷人嗎？呃我的意思是，你覺得我塗上那個會不會更迷人，還是你壓根就沒注意到？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Would it be wrong if I was physically attracted to you even though you're a woman? Sorry I was thinking out loud. Just ignore anything I just said.
plugin_fields.target: 如果我被你的身體所吸引，就算大家都是女的，這算一種錯誤嗎？抱歉，我不小心把心聲念出來了。就當我什麼都沒說。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You don't see as many Khajiit about these days. I guess they must have gone Elsweyr... Do you get it, Elsweyr, elsewhere.
plugin_fields.target: 最近街上的凱季特人變少了呢。我猜他們肯定是去了「艾斯維爾」……你懂嗎？艾斯維爾（Elsweyr），別處（elsewhere）。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So you like using just one hand for your weapon? I always thought you had good wrist action, but then again most men do...
plugin_fields.target: 所以你喜歡用單手武器？我一直覺得你的手活兒挺不錯的，不過話說回來，大多數男人的手活兒都不賴……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: especially if they happen to be single.
plugin_fields.target: 尤其是那些單身漢。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So you like using just one hand for your weapon? I always thought you had good wrist action, but then again women can be quite good with their hands.
plugin_fields.target: 所以你喜歡用單手武器？我一直覺得你的手腕動作特別靈活，不過話說回來，女人的手活兒向來都不差。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So you're pretty good at using a weapon with both hands? Then again you would need to be with a weapon of your size.
plugin_fields.target: 所以你很擅長雙手揮舞武器咯？也是，畢竟要拿捏你那種尺寸的「傢夥」，確實得用雙手。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So you're pretty good at using a weapon with both hands? Then again I heard you only like handling big weapons.
plugin_fields.target: 所以你很擅長雙手揮舞武器咯？不過我又聽說你只喜歡把弄那些「又大又長」的武器呢。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So you're good at piercing people with your bow and arrow huh? Well make sure you don't you go penetrating me... I mean with an arrow of course.
plugin_fields.target: 所以說你很擅長用弓箭射穿敵人咯？那你可得當心點，別把我給「射」了……呃，我的意思當然是用箭矢射我。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So you're good with Conjuration? Ok why don't you conjure up a pink mammoth wearing a hat. You can't do that? Well what use is that then?
plugin_fields.target: 原來你是個召喚系大師啊？行啊，那你給我變一隻戴著帽子的粉紅色猛獁象出來看看。變不出來？那你這魔法留著有何用處？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So you're good with Destruction? I do like a causing a bit of destruction myself, although I prefer the traditional methods.
plugin_fields.target: 你很擅長毀滅系法術？我也挺喜歡親手搞點破壞的，但我更偏愛那些傳統的物理手段。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You're good with Illusion? So you can bend people to your will? Well I'd like to see you try with me. I don't need magic to bend people to my will.
plugin_fields.target: 精通幻術系？所以你能讓別人對你唯命是從咯？那你倒是在我身上試試看啊。我讓別人臣服可從來不需要靠魔法。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So you're good at Alteration? Do you know the spell where you can turn iron into gold? Now that would be useful...
plugin_fields.target: 所以你是個變換系大師？你會那種能點鐵成金的法術嗎？那玩意兒絕對實用……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: or maybe the one where you can see people through walls? I bet you could have some fun with that.
plugin_fields.target: 或者那種能透視牆壁偷窺別人的法術？我敢打賭你肯定能用它找到不少樂子。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: What? No I'm not only interested in gold and making love, I do also enjoy killing and the odd bit of mead.
plugin_fields.target: 看什麼看？我又不是隻對金幣和做愛感興趣，我還喜歡殺人和偶爾來杯蜂蜜酒呢。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So you're good at Restoration? That's a little dull but...
plugin_fields.target: 所以你擅長恢復系法術？聽起來挺無聊的，不過……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'm sure I won't be saying that when I'm lying there moaning whilst you use your healing fingers or whatever it's called on me...
plugin_fields.target: 當我躺在那兒呻吟，而你用你那「治癒神指」——管它叫什麼名字——在我身上治療時，我肯定就不會這麼想了……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Hmm, that did sound a little wrong. What I meant was me lying injured on the ground in serious pain.
plugin_fields.target: 咳咳，這聽起來不對勁。我的意思是我受了重傷痛苦地倒在地上呻吟的時候。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So you're the sneaky kind of person huh? I'll have to keep an eye on you then, especially whilst getting changed.
plugin_fields.target: 原來你是那種喜歡偷偷摸摸的人啊？看來我得好好提防你了，特別是我換衣服的時候。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Then again you'll also need to keep an eye on me.
plugin_fields.target: 不過話說回來，你也得看緊我才行。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So you like to go feeling around peoples pockets looking for valuables huh? Well make sure you don't grab the wrong valuables...
plugin_fields.target: 所以你喜歡在別人的口袋裡亂摸找寶貝對吧？好吧，我希望你別摸錯了別人的「寶貝」……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: or you may get arrested for touching someone indecently.
plugin_fields.target: 要不然你絕對會因為猥褻罪被抓進大牢。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So you're good with picking locks? I like to think I'm good with picking locks too but judging by the number of corpses lying around with lockpicks
plugin_fields.target: 所以你很擅長撬鎖？我也覺得自己挺擅長撬鎖的。不過看看周圍那些身上揣著開鎖器卻淪為屍體的傢夥，
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: and merchants selling them, I think it's fair to say everyone must be up to no good these days, so watch yourself.
plugin_fields.target: 再看看那些販賣開鎖器的商人，我想說這年頭每個人都不幹好事，你最好還是小心點。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So you see yourself as a bit of a blacksmith huh? I bet you love to get real dirty.
plugin_fields.target: 所以你覺得自己是個鐵匠咯？我敢打賭你肯定喜歡把自己弄得「髒兮兮」的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well you better wash off all that dirt and soot before you come anywhere near me.
plugin_fields.target: 好吧，在你靠近我之前，你最好把身上的灰塵和煤煙都洗乾淨。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So you can make some pretty decent potions I hear? Can you make love potions or perhaps a laxative?
plugin_fields.target: 聽人說你能調配出相當不錯的藥水？那你能做迷情藥或者瀉藥嗎？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Don't worry, I just thought of a funny prank to pull on someone.
plugin_fields.target: 別緊張，我只是想到了一個能捉弄人的惡作劇而已。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So you're good with your shield? Yes, my parents always said to use protection. That must be what they meant.
plugin_fields.target: 所以你很擅長使盾？也是，我父母總教導我要「做好安全措施」。他們一定就是這個意思。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So you're a real smooth talker huh? Well don't think you can talk your way around me. I know all the moves. I probably invented half of them.
plugin_fields.target: 你還真是個能言善道的人啊？不過別以為你能靠花言巧語把我忽悠瘸了。你那些套路我全都知道，而且其中一半估計還是我發明的呢。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So you can enchant stuff huh? I bet I could enchant your sword. What? I spent some time at the College of Winterhold...
plugin_fields.target: 所以你能給物品附魔對吧？我敢打賭我也能給你的劍「附個魔」。幹嘛？我好歹也在冬堡學院待過一陣子好不好……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: but come to think of it that was a disaster so maybe not.
plugin_fields.target: 不過仔細想想那根本就是一場災難，還是算了吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: It's rather sunny today. I'm not complaining it's just I find it harder to see my enemies with the sun in my eyes. OK I suppose I am complaining.
plugin_fields.target: 今天陽光真刺眼。我不是在抱怨，只是陽光晃得我很難看清敵人。好吧，我承認我就是在抱怨。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Not a cloud in the sky. It feels kind of unnatural.
plugin_fields.target: 萬裡無雲。感覺這天氣有點不太正常。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Another dull, cloudy day. No I don't always complain about the weather, only sometimes.
plugin_fields.target: 又是個沉悶陰鬱的陰天。別誤會，我可沒天天抱怨天氣，也就偶爾說說而已。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Rain. Typical. I hate the rain, it makes my hair go all frizzy...
plugin_fields.target: 下雨了，真俗套。我討厭下雨，它會把我的毛全弄捲……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: and it makes me all wet right down to my under-garments which is really uncomfortable when I walk. OK maybe that was too much information.
plugin_fields.target: 還會把我渾身上下連內衣都淋得濕漉漉的，走起路來別提多難受了。好吧，我可能說得太多了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: There's something quite beautiful about the snow. It's just a shame it is so cold.
plugin_fields.target: 這雪景倒是美得別有一番風味，只可惜實在太冷了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I can barely see through this fog. This would be the perfect time to cause trouble as no one would be able to see us.
plugin_fields.target: 這霧濃得我什麼都看不見。不過這倒是惹事生非的絕佳時機，反正誰也看不見我們。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Another fine morning. What should we do today? Maybe we could... I don't know. Ah let's just go and kill something.
plugin_fields.target: 又是一個美好的早晨。我們今天該幹點啥？也許我們可以……我不知道。啊不管了，咱們去砍點什麼吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Dawn has got to be the most beautiful time of the day. I love watching the sun rise.
plugin_fields.target: 黎明絕對是一天中最美的時刻。我就喜歡看日出。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Seeing the sunset is so romantic. Watching it with you makes me feel all... nevermind.
plugin_fields.target: 看日落多浪漫啊。和你一起看更是讓我整個人都……沒什麼。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: What a fine afternoon it is. Do you know what I love to do in the afternoon? No, neither do I.
plugin_fields.target: 真是個愜意的下午。你知道我下午最喜歡幹什麼嗎？其實我也不知道。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: What a miserable morning it has turned out to be.
plugin_fields.target: 好端端的早晨怎麼變成這副鬼樣子了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: This certainly has turned out to be a rather miserable afternoon.
plugin_fields.target: 這絕對是個糟糕透頂的下午。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Are you sure it's wise staying out at night in the dark? We might get lost or something.
plugin_fields.target: 你確定大半夜在外面瞎晃悠是個明智的選擇？我們可能會迷路或者遇到點什麼意外的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: It certainly is dark. Not that I'm scared of the dark or anything.
plugin_fields.target: 天確實黑得嚇人。我可不是怕黑或者別的什麼哦。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'm soooo cold. I'm f-f-freezing my nipples off. Did I say nipples? I meant... damn it what sounds like nipples.
plugin_fields.target: 我好——冷啊。冷得我「奶頭（nipples）」都要凍、凍、凍掉了。我剛才說奶頭了嗎？我的意思是……該死，哪個詞（icicles/冰柱）發音像奶頭來著？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I don't think swimming in icy water is a good idea.
plugin_fields.target: 我覺得在冰水裡游泳可不是什麼好主意。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I don't think now is the time to go skinny-dipping.
plugin_fields.target: 我不認為現在是裸泳的好時候。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: What happened to the sun? I'm pretty sure it's not supposed to look like that.
plugin_fields.target: 太陽出什麼毛病了？我敢肯定它本來不長這樣。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Your outfit got me thinking. What would a Khajiit fur coat look like? I mean one that is not on a living Khajiit of course.
plugin_fields.target: 你這身衣服倒提醒我了。要是用凱季特人的皮毛做件大衣會是什麼樣？我的意思是——做成大衣穿在別人身上，而不是長在活著的凱季特人身上的那種。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Maybe we should try and start a new fashion and perhaps create a new business out of it. We could make a killing...
plugin_fields.target: 也許我們該開創一種新風尚，順便還能做個新生意。這絕對能讓我們大宰一筆……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Get it? A killing? You know, by killing Khajiit?
plugin_fields.target: 懂了嗎？大宰一筆？也就是去「宰」了凱季特人呀？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Ugh, somebody died in those clothes and you seriously want to wear them?
plugin_fields.target: 呃，有個人死在這衣服裡，你真的還想穿上它？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Ugh, somebody died in that armour and you seriously want to wear it?
plugin_fields.target: 呃，有個人死在這盔甲裡，你真的還想穿上它？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Sure, dress like a criminal. It's not like anyone in Skyrim is going to notice. Unfortunately I'm not even joking.
plugin_fields.target: 對，穿得就像個罪犯一樣。反正天際也沒人會在意。可惜我甚至不是在開玩笑。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You don't exactly look like the most honourable citizen in that outfit but who cares about honour anyway?
plugin_fields.target: 你這身行頭看起來可不像什麼體麵人，不過誰在乎體面不體面呢？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: If that armour was made by the dwarves then it must be absolutely ancient.
plugin_fields.target: 如果那套盔甲是矮人打造的，那它絕對是個老古董了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well it has certainly stood the test of time, which is more than you can say about some of the faces around Skyrim.
plugin_fields.target: 看來它經受住了時間的考驗，這可比天際裡那些飽經風霜的臉皮強多了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I must say you are looking rather nice today. I just can't resist someone wearing tight fitting armour.
plugin_fields.target: 我得說你今天看起來相當不錯。我就是對穿著緊身盔甲的人沒有抵抗力。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Just look at that stunning view. What? I wasn't looking at you, I was looking at... okay I was looking at you.
plugin_fields.target: 瞧瞧這迷人的風景。幹嘛？我又沒在看你，我在看……好吧我就是在看你。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You are putting very inappropriate thoughts into my head right now. You should probably put something on before there's an accident.
plugin_fields.target: 你現在讓我滿腦子都是些不太正經的想法。你最好趕緊穿上點什麼，免得出意外。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I know I say if you've got it then flaunt it but I didn't mean exposing yourself even if you do have a nice physique.
plugin_fields.target: 我知道我常說「有好身材就該秀出來」，但就算你身材再好，我也不是讓你當眾裸奔啊。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I would put something on if I were you. You might give some old guy a heart attack.
plugin_fields.target: 如果我是你，我就會穿上點什麼。你這樣會害得某些老頭子心臟病發作的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Those arch-mage robes really seem to suit you.
plugin_fields.target: 那件首席法師的長袍真的很襯你。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: It's the perfect thing to wear whilst pushing college students around and acting superior to all other mages.
plugin_fields.target: 這衣服簡直就是你在學院學生面前頤指氣使，並在其他法師面前擺架子時的完美行頭。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: That armour must be difficult to polish. The next time you take your armour off and find it a bit hard, I could help give it a quick rub for you.
plugin_fields.target: 這盔甲肯定很難打磨吧。下次你要是把盔甲脫下來，覺得它有點「硬」，我可以幫你快速「磨一磨」。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Uh no... that didn't come out as intended.
plugin_fields.target: 呃不……這話說出來味道完全變了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You seriously couldn't find anything better to wear than that? Well we can't all look like me I guess.
plugin_fields.target: 你就找不到比那件更好看的衣服了嗎？好吧，畢竟不是每個人都能像我一樣天生麗質。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Please tell me you are only wearing that as a joke and that you are not actually planning on joining a group of deranged fools.
plugin_fields.target: 拜託告訴我你穿成這樣只是在開玩笑，你並不是真的打算加入那群瘋瘋癲癲的白痴。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: What in Oblivion are you wearing? You look absolutely ridiculous. Uh... no offense.
plugin_fields.target: 湮滅在上，你穿的這都是些什麼玩意兒？看起來簡直滑稽透了。呃……無意冒犯。
