plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Dressing down I see. Are you on some top secret undercover mission? I sure hope so. I do love it under the covers...
plugin_fields.target: 穿得挺低調嘛。你是不是在執行什麼高度機密的「深入」任務？真希望是這樣。我最喜歡在被窩裡「深入」了……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: uh I mean undercover. You are probably just trying to fit in with the locals.
plugin_fields.target: 呃，我是說「深入敵後」的臥底任務。可能你只是想融入當地人而已。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Wow. That outfit shows a lot of flesh. Not that I'm complaining.
plugin_fields.target: 哇。這衣服露得可真多。當然，我不是在抱怨。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well you'll certainly be turning some heads in that outfit. Whether it's for the right reasons I'll let you be the judge.
plugin_fields.target: 好吧，你穿這身衣服走出去回頭率絕對百分百。至於他們是因為什麼原因回頭，這就由你自己去評判了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well don't you look fancy. It's a nice try but you will never outdo me.
plugin_fields.target: 打扮得挺花哨的嘛。算是次不錯的嘗試，但你永遠也比不過我。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Since when did you become the court jester? Oh... well it still seems an odd choice of outfit to me.
plugin_fields.target: 你什麼時候成了宮廷小丑了？噢……好吧，在我看來你這穿衣品味還是挺奇葩的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You look rather intimidating in that outfit. I wouldn't want to mess with you, although don't think that outfit would stop me.
plugin_fields.target: 你穿這身行頭看起來挺嚇人的。我可不想招惹你，但別以為這套衣服就能嚇住我。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You really do look like the legendary Dragonborn in that armour. It's kind of gross that it's made out of dragon bones but it does look good.
plugin_fields.target: 你穿著那套盔甲，看起來真有傳說中龍裔的派頭。雖說它是用龍骨做的讓人覺得有點噁心，但不可否認確實挺帥氣的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So how many innocent creatures had to die to make your outfit I wonder? Well what do I care anyway?
plugin_fields.target: 我很好奇，為了做你這套衣服，到底犧牲了多少無辜的生靈？算了，我操這心幹嘛。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I hope you aren't planning to fight in those clothes? Even with me around you wouldn't last a few seconds.
plugin_fields.target: 你該不會打算穿著這身衣服去戰鬥吧？就算有我在你身邊，你也撐不過幾秒鐘。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You're a brave adventurer! I thought you would have at least tried to make an effort with what you are wearing.
plugin_fields.target: 你是個勇敢的冒險家哎！我還以為你至少會在穿著打扮上稍微下點功夫呢。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I think I'm going to have nightmares about you in that outfit. Couldn't you wear something nicer so that I can have good dreams about you?
plugin_fields.target: 我覺得你穿成這樣絕對會害我做噩夢的。你就不能換件好看點的衣服，讓我在夢裡也能見見你美美的樣子嗎？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Not that I dream about you of course.
plugin_fields.target: 當然，我可沒夢見過你。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You are such a show off. Yea ok, I know that look you are giving me, but it's important to let people know that you are superior.
plugin_fields.target: 你可真愛顯擺。行吧行吧，我知道你那眼神是什麼意思，不過讓別人明白你高人一等的身份確實挺重要的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: It's for their own good. Otherwise they would have no one but the gods to admire.
plugin_fields.target: 這是為了他們好。不然除了眾神，他們就沒有別的可以崇拜的物件了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You had to prove yourself to a Daedric Lord to earn that armour so if that doesn't scare or at least impress people then I don't know what will.
plugin_fields.target: 你得向魔神證明自己才能贏得那套盔甲，如果這都不能讓人聞風喪膽，或者至少肅然起敬的話，那我也想不出還有什麼能了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well you certainly look the part of brave adventurer if nothing else.
plugin_fields.target: 好吧，別的不說，你看起來確實挺有勇敢冒險家那味兒的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Who did you have to kill to get those clothes? Oh yeah now I remember.
plugin_fields.target: 為了得到這些衣服你究竟殺誰了？噢對，我想起來了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I don't know how you can even move in that armour. It's bigger than you and must weigh an absolute ton.
plugin_fields.target: 我真納悶你穿著那身重甲是怎麼邁開腿的。它看起來比你人都大，絕對有千斤重。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: *Singing*
plugin_fields.target: *唱歌*
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: *Singing*
plugin_fields.target: *唱歌*
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: *Singing*
plugin_fields.target: *唱歌*
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: *Singing*
plugin_fields.target: *唱歌*
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So is it true what they sing about you? Perhaps you could show me what really happens when the Dragonborn comes.
plugin_fields.target: 所以他們歌裡唱的關於你的故事都是真的？也許你能向我展示一下當「龍裔降臨」時究竟會發生些什麼。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You never did tell me about your parents. I mean you are Dragonborn, so do you have ancestors that are dragons?
plugin_fields.target: 你從來沒跟我提起過你的父母。我是說，既然你是龍裔，難道你的祖先裡真有一條龍嗎？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: That would be really disturbing if you did.
plugin_fields.target: 要真是那樣可就太驚悚了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Apparently alchemists eat ingredients to learn how to make potions. That doesn't sound very pleasant to me.
plugin_fields.target: 顯然鍊金術士們靠生吃材料來研究如何配製藥水。這聽起來可不怎麼享受。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I mean who in their right mind would eat a giant's toe or troll fat? As for eating thistles and antlers, that sounds painful.
plugin_fields.target: 我是說，哪個腦子正常的人會去吃巨人的腳趾或是巨魔的脂肪？至於生嚼薊花和鹿角，光聽著就覺得扎嘴。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: It was at the College of Winterhold that I learnt this spell that made people naked. It has definitely got to be my favourite.
plugin_fields.target: 我就是在冬堡學院學到這招能讓人脫光光的法術的。它絕對是我的最愛。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I can show you if you like. Woah, calm down, I didn't mean on me. I was talking about on you.
plugin_fields.target: 如果你想看的話我可以給你演示一下。哇哦，冷靜點，我沒說是對著我自己放。我指的是對著你放。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Did I tell you about the time I nearly made two people die without even touching them? I didn't feel like wearing clothes that day.
plugin_fields.target: 我跟你說過有次我連碰都沒碰就差點讓兩個人喪命的事嗎？那天我剛好懶得穿衣服。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: One man nearly choked to death on a piece of bread when he saw me and the other fell over a bridge and nearly drowned.
plugin_fields.target: 其中一個人看到我時差點被嘴裡的麵包噎死，另一個人更是直接從橋上摔下去險些淹死。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You are not very talkative are you? I always open up for you... I mean to you.
plugin_fields.target: 你不怎麼愛說話，對吧？我總是為你敞開胸懷……呃，我是說對你敞開心扉。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You owe me a serious foot rub for all the walking you have made me do. What do you mean it's my fault?
plugin_fields.target: 你害我走了這麼多路，必須得給我好好捏個腳。你說這是我的錯是什麼意思？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Yes ok I may have agreed to it but... ah whatever you still owe me a foot rub.
plugin_fields.target: 行吧行吧，我當初可能是同意了，但是……不管怎麼說你都欠我一次足部按摩。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Bread seems to be very popular don't you think? It's all people ever seem to eat.
plugin_fields.target: 麵包似乎很受歡迎，你不覺得嗎？感覺這兒的人除了麵包就沒吃過別的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Have you ever thought that our lives are just one big game? Like someone is sitting there playing with us like some adult play thing.
plugin_fields.target: 你有沒有想過我們的生活也許只是一場大型遊戲？就像有個人坐在那兒把我們當成什麼成人的玩具來擺佈。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: And no I don't mean that kind of adult. It makes you think though.
plugin_fields.target: 別亂想，我指的不是那種少兒不宜的「成人玩具」。不過這想法確實挺耐人尋味的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I want your honest opinion. What do you think about my boobs? I mean do they look the right size to you? Hey, stop looking at me like that you pervert.
plugin_fields.target: 我想聽聽你的實話。你覺得我的胸怎麼樣？我的意思是對你來說尺寸合適嗎？嘿，別用那種變態的眼神盯著我！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So what do I have to do to get a drink around here? Actually I don't think I want to know.
plugin_fields.target: 我得幹點什麼才能在這兒搞到酒喝？算了我想我還是別知道的好。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Do you know what I love to do when I have a little too much spare gold? I find a beggar and pay them to harass people.
plugin_fields.target: 你知道當我閒錢太多的時候最喜歡幹嘛嗎？我會隨便找個乞丐，付錢讓他們去騷擾路人。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: They are so desperate for money that they will do almost anything. It can be very entertaining to watch.
plugin_fields.target: 他們太缺錢了，為了金幣幾乎什麼都願意幹。在旁邊看著別提多有趣了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: A word of advice. Never buy a used copy of The Lusty Argonian Maid. The covers are always worn and the pages stuck together.
plugin_fields.target: 給你個忠告。千萬別買二手的《活力充沛的阿爾貢人女僕》。封面總是磨損得不成樣子，而且裡面好幾頁還會黏在一起。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I just don't get it. I swear there must be some kind of conspiracy.
plugin_fields.target: 我實在搞不懂為什麼會這樣。我發誓這其中絕對有什麼陰謀。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I have been told that I have one of the nicest voices in Skyrim or even Tamriel for that matter. I must say I am inclined to agree.
plugin_fields.target: 總有人誇我的嗓音是天際乃至整個泰姆瑞爾大陸最動聽的之一。我必須得說，我也是這麼認為的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: If there is one thing I don't like it is people who think they are really tough and special and boast all the time.
plugin_fields.target: 如果有什麼是我看不慣的，那就是那些自以為很能打、很了不起，還成天吹牛皮的傢夥。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Also don't you just hate those people who talk about pointless stuff that they should really keep to themselves?
plugin_fields.target: 另外，你不覺得那些總是把雞毛蒜皮的破事掛在嘴邊的人很煩嗎？那些廢話明明就該爛在肚子裡。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: What? Why are you looking at me like that?
plugin_fields.target: 幹嘛？你幹嘛用那種眼神看著我？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You know sometimes I like to roleplay. No not like that. I mean like pretending I'm a mudcrab that goes around pinching people on the bottom.
plugin_fields.target: 你知道有時候我還挺喜歡角色扮演的。哎呀不是那種啦。我是說比如假裝自己是一隻泥沼蟹，到處去夾別人的屁股。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: It's rather fun, you should try it. Roleplaying I mean, although pinching bottoms is quite fun too.
plugin_fields.target: 挺好玩的，你也該試試。我是說角色扮演啦，當然，夾別人屁股其實也相當有趣就是了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I don't get why people worship the gods. What have they ever done for us mere mortals? Nothing! I prayed for money, free booze and...
plugin_fields.target: 我真搞不懂為什麼人們要去崇拜那些神明。他們為我們這些凡夫俗子做過什麼嗎？啥也沒有！我祈求金錢，祈求免費的美酒還有……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: more free booze and did I get it? No! Instead I got a hangover and a huge hole in my pocket where my money used to be.
plugin_fields.target: 更多的免費美酒，結果我如願了嗎？並沒有！我換來的只有宿醉，還有腰包裡曾經裝錢的地方留下的大窟窿。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Why must there always be incest inside temples? It really does make me feel a little sick.
plugin_fields.target: 為什麼神殿裡總是少不了那些近親的事？這真讓我覺得噁心。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Did I say incest? I meant incense. The smell really gets up my nose.
plugin_fields.target: 我剛才說近親了嗎？我的意思是進香。那味道真的太嗆鼻子了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Is it me or are the priests in Skyrim all perverts. I said I had injured my leg and one of them told me to remove my clothes...
plugin_fields.target: 到底是我多心了，還是天際的祭司們全都是變態？我只是說我腿受傷了，其中一個居然叫我把衣服脫掉……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: so he could use his healing hands on me. Needless to say he needed a bit of healing himself after that.
plugin_fields.target: 好方便他用那什麼「治癒之觸」來摸我。不用說也知道，在那之後他自己倒是需要被好好治癒一番了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Have you ever tried bareback? I didn't like it. It started to make me a little sore after a while.
plugin_fields.target: 你試過「無套」直接騎上去嗎？我不喜歡那樣。沒過多久我就覺得有點摩擦得痠痛了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: What's with the funny face? I was talking about horse riding.
plugin_fields.target: 你幹嘛一副滑稽的表情？我是在說不套馬鞍騎馬啦。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Out of all the Daedric Princes, Sanguine is the only one I would actually consider worshipping.
plugin_fields.target: 在所有的魔神裡，桑吉恩是我唯一會認真考慮去崇拜的一位。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: He really understands how to have a good time and knows the importance of alcohol. I quite like Sheogorath too.
plugin_fields.target: 他是真懂得怎麼尋歡作樂，而且深知酒精的重要性。我也挺喜歡謝爾格拉的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: We need more drunk people in Skyrim. That would make things ten times more fun.
plugin_fields.target: 天際需要更多的醉鬼。這能讓生活有趣十倍。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I mean why would the guards discourage drunken behaviour when they should be encouraging it? A drunken person is a happy person.
plugin_fields.target: 我的意思是，守衛們幹嘛要壓制醉酒鬧事，他們明明應該大力提倡才對嘛！一個喝醉的人才是一個快樂的人。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: The alchemists in Skyrim will buy anything that comes in a potion bottle. Can you believe I made money by urinating in a bottle and calling it...
plugin_fields.target: 天際的鍊金術士只要看到是裝在藥水瓶裡的東西就全收。你能相信我曾經往瓶子裡撒了泡尿然後還賣了錢嗎，我管它叫……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: potion of youth? I had to stop though when I got chased out of town by the shop owner.
plugin_fields.target: 「返老還童藥水」？不過後來我不得不收手了，因為那個店老闆一路把我追殺出了城。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I love teasing guys. After I went bear hunting one day I asked a hunter if he wanted to see my bear chest.
plugin_fields.target: 我最愛戲弄男人了。有次我去獵熊回來，我問一個獵人想不想看看我的「胸」。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I showed him the pelt of the bear I just killed and pointed to its chest. You should have seen the disappointment on his face.
plugin_fields.target: 結果我向他展示了剛打下來的「熊」皮，指了指它的胸脯。你真該看看他當時臉上那失望的表情。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So you're the strong silent type huh? I bet you must love me talking to you all the time. Then again who could resist spending time with me?
plugin_fields.target: 原來你是那種強壯沉默型的對吧？我打賭你肯定愛死我在你耳邊喋喋不休了。話說回來，又有誰能抗拒和我共度時光呢？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So as a werewolf do you prefer the taste of man meat... I mean do you prefer feasting on men or women?
plugin_fields.target: 作為一個狼人，你會不會更喜歡「男人肉」的滋味……呃，我是說你開葷時更喜歡吃男人還是女人？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I've heard werewolves are absolute beasts when it comes to a full moon. I better make sure I'm carrying a second set of clothes...
plugin_fields.target: 我聽說一到滿月，狼人就會徹底獸性大發。看來我最好多帶一套備用的衣服……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You know, just in case you start tearing them off or anything.
plugin_fields.target: 你懂的，以防你獸性發作開始撕扯衣服之類的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I guess being a werewolf must give you unimaginable strength. Well that's OK, I can handle you getting a bit rough with me. Not in that way of course.
plugin_fields.target: 我想變成狼人肯定會賜予你難以想像的力量吧。沒關係，就算你對我粗暴一點兒我也受得了。當然，我不是指那種「粗暴」。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So I guess werewolves are a bit like wolves, which are a bit like wild dogs? You're not going to start doing that thing with my leg are you?
plugin_fields.target: 我想狼人有點像狼，而狼又有點像野狗對吧？你該不會要開始抱著我的大腿做那種事吧？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So what's it like to be dead but not dead? This is really confusing because do I tell people that you are dead or that you are alive?
plugin_fields.target: 成為一個似死非死的活死人是什麼感覺？這真讓我頭疼，我是該跟別人說你死了，還是說你還活著？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Actually it's probably best not to mention it at all.
plugin_fields.target: 事實上，最好還是提都別提。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I heard vampires like to eat steak and garlic. Or was it that they hate garlic and steaks?
plugin_fields.target: 我聽說吸血鬼喜歡吃牛排（steak）和大蒜。還是說……他們其實討厭大蒜和木樁（stake）？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well what does it matter? You should be thankful for whatever I give you.
plugin_fields.target: 哎呀管它呢？我給你吃什麼你都該感恩戴德。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: If I was to become a vampire, would it be possible to bite me in an area that any bite marks won't show. So not my face, neck, arms, legs, stomach...
plugin_fields.target: 如果我想變成吸血鬼，你能不能挑個咬痕不會暴露的地方下口？所以不能咬我的臉、脖子、手臂、腿還有肚子……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Hmm I guess that only leaves... Uh yes well, let's not worry about that now.
plugin_fields.target: 嗯……我想那剩下的就只有……呃好吧，我們現在還是別操心這個了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I don't know how you could drink blood. That's just gross. I wonder what would happen if you drank another vampire's blood.
plugin_fields.target: 我真搞不懂你怎麼喝得下去血。那也太噁心了吧。我很好奇如果你去吸另一個吸血鬼的血會發生什麼？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Perhaps it could make you even more powerful. Or it could just kill you of course, but then how can you die twice?
plugin_fields.target: 也許那會讓你變得更加強大。當然也有可能直接要了你的命，不過死人怎麼還能再死一次呢？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: *Singing*
plugin_fields.target: *唱歌*
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Skyrim might be a cold place with miserable people but after a few drinks you don't really notice. Speaking of which I'm getting a little thirsty.
plugin_fields.target: 天際也許是個住著一群苦命人的苦寒之地，但幾杯酒下肚你就什麼都不會在意了。說到這個，我現在都有點渴了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Do you ever get the feeling of just losing your clothes at the most inappropriate moments? No, me neither, ok well maybe sometimes.
plugin_fields.target: 你有過那種總在最不合時宜的場合把衣服弄丟的經歷嗎？不，我也沒經歷過。好吧，也許有過那麼幾次。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well this is fun. You and me just walking around doing stuff to each other...
plugin_fields.target: 這可真有意思。你和我到處溜達，還互相為對方做那些事……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I mean with each other but not like that... like bonding... not that kind though.
plugin_fields.target: 我的意思是一起做事，不是你想的那樣……就像是增進感情的深入交流……但不是那方面的交流。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: How many people does it take to screw a chandelier? I don't know but it could be painful... You know because you might fall and hurt yourself.
plugin_fields.target: 要幾個人才能「上」一盞吊燈？我不知道，但這肯定挺疼的……你懂的，因為你可能會從上面掉下來摔傷。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Have you ever woken up in the morning with a big cock in your ear? That damn bird screeched so loud that I cooked it for dinner.
plugin_fields.target: 你有沒有試過大清早醒來，耳朵旁頂著個「大雞雞」？那隻該死的扁毛畜生叫得震天響，最後它直接成了我的晚餐。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: That's why stables are a bad place to sleep. Luckily the farmer didn't find out about it.
plugin_fields.target: 這就是為什麼馬廄絕不是個睡覺的好地方。幸好那個農場主一直沒發現他的雞去哪了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I've heard of this mystical natural wonder known as the fountain of booze. Do you think the stories are true? I sure hope so.
plugin_fields.target: 我聽說過一種被稱為「酒之泉」的神秘自然奇觀。你覺得這些傳說是真的嗎？我當然希望是真的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: If I ever found it I would never go sober again.
plugin_fields.target: 如果我找到了它，我這輩子就再也不打算清醒過來了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Never work on a farm. They are always full of tools and hoes. Those hoes are a real pain to use, never again will I do an honest days work.
plugin_fields.target: 千萬別去農場幹活。那兒到處都是「幹活的工具」和「欠操的破鋤頭」。那些「破鋤頭」用起來太費勁了，我這輩子都不會再去幹這種老實活了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You know what we should do? We should get drunk and have a big sing-song... no a naked sing-song. Yes that would be fun.
plugin_fields.target: 你知道我們應該幹點啥嗎？我們應該去喝個爛醉，然後放聲高歌……不，來一場裸體大合唱！對，那肯定好玩極了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Do you like to dance? I've heard that there's this dance called the horizontal dance. I think we should try it.
plugin_fields.target: 你喜歡跳舞嗎？我聽說有種舞蹈叫做「躺著跳的舞」。我覺得我們該找機會切磋一下。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Unfortunately I've never seen anyone do it before.
plugin_fields.target: 可惜我以前從沒見過別人跳這個。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: People say you shouldn't be naked  in public but I managed to get a free outfit out of it so it can't be all that bad.
plugin_fields.target: 人們總說公共場合不能光著身子，但我卻靠這個白嫖了一套衣服，所以裸奔倒也不全是壞事嘛。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I mean it's not like you would leave me walking around naked the whole time.
plugin_fields.target: 我的意思是，你總不可能忍心讓我一直光著身子到處晃悠吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You should never fight a woman, they always fight dirty.
plugin_fields.target: 永遠別和女人打架，她們下手總是特別陰。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: If you've ever been in a fight with a woman you should know they always win.
plugin_fields.target: 如果你跟女人打過架，你就該明白最後的贏家總是她們。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You've obviously never met me otherwise you would be cowering right now.
plugin_fields.target: 你顯然以前沒見識過我，否則你現在早就嚇得直哆嗦了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I almost feel sorry for you thinking you could actually take me on.
plugin_fields.target: 看你居然覺得自己能打贏我，我都快可憐起你來了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I hope you don't live to suffer the shame of being beaten by a woman. Since it's me though they may be a little more forgiving.
plugin_fields.target: 你最好死在這裡，免得還要活著承受敗給女人的恥辱。不過既然是敗給了我，大家對你的寬容度應該會高那麼一點點。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: What makes you think you're any different to the hundreds of others like you I have killed?
plugin_fields.target: 是什麼讓你覺得你會比死在我手上的成百上千個雜兵有什麼不同？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I would admire your courage if I wasn't laughing at your stupidity.
plugin_fields.target: 要不是忙著嘲笑你的愚蠢，我可能還會讚賞一下你的勇氣。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You should pick on someone your own size...or bigger as you would stand more chance than beating me.
plugin_fields.target: 你應該找個跟你體型差不多的……或者更大的，畢竟那樣你打贏的勝算還比打敗我高一點。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Don't let my looks fool you, looks can be deceiving. Maybe that means you actually have a brain.
plugin_fields.target: 別被我的長相給騙了，美貌是會騙人的。如果你能明白這點，那說明你還有點腦子。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: They say actions speak louder than words so I'll let my weapons do the talking.
plugin_fields.target: 俗話說行動勝於言辭，所以接下來就讓我的武器替我發言吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I don't like to boast but I am superior to you in every possible way. Ah who am I kidding I love to boast.
plugin_fields.target: 我不喜歡吹噓，但我確實在所有方面都碾壓你。哎呀我在騙誰呢，我最愛吹噓了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: It's a shame I have to kill you. We could have got better acquainted.
plugin_fields.target: 真遺憾我必須殺了你。我們本來可以深入交流一下的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I love a challenge... I guess you'll have to do though.
plugin_fields.target: 我最喜歡挑戰了……不過我看你也只能湊合著當個樂子了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Most people like to hunt animals. I also love to hunt people and pretty much anything else that moves.
plugin_fields.target: 大多數人喜歡狩獵動物。而我除了動物，還喜歡獵殺活人，以及基本上所有會動的東西。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: At least you will die with a nice view... Yes I'm referring to my face and possibly my other womanly assets.
plugin_fields.target: 至少你在死前還能大飽眼福……沒錯，我指的就是我這絕美的容顏，或許還有我其他充滿女人味的本錢。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You're lucky I have company so I can't do unspeakable things to your corpse.
plugin_fields.target: 你運氣真好，因為我身邊有伴，所以我沒法對你的屍體做些不可描述的事了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I normally like to seduce my victims before I kill them but I'm on a tight schedule and my friend here might get jealous.
plugin_fields.target: 我平常喜歡在動手前先勾引一下獵物，不過現在趕時間，而且我怕我這位朋友會吃醋。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: The last person I killed was stiff before he was fully dead... Well part of him was.
plugin_fields.target: 上一個被我殺掉的人，還沒死透就已經僵硬了……呃，我是說他身體的某個部位硬了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: It seems the only part of you that always remains dead is your brain!
plugin_fields.target: 看來你全身上下唯一一直死透的地方就是你的腦子了！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You're just jealous of my looks!
plugin_fields.target: 你純粹是在嫉妒我的美貌！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Sorry but necrophilia's not really my thing.
plugin_fields.target: 抱歉，但我真的對戀屍癖不感興趣。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Rest in peace? Hah! I'll make sure you rest in pieces.
plugin_fields.target: 安息（Rest in peace）？哈！我會確保你碎屍萬段（rest in pieces）的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You need to eat more. You look seriously underweight.
plugin_fields.target: 你真該多吃點。你看起來嚴重營養不良。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Your joints seem a little creaky. Let me fix that for you.
plugin_fields.target: 你的關節聽起來有點嘎吱作響了。讓我來替你修理修理。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Hey bonehead! Come and get me!
plugin_fields.target: 嘿，骨頭架子！有本事來抓我呀！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: If there is one thing I have learned it is to never try and talk sense into a troll.
plugin_fields.target: 如果我學到了什麼教訓，那就是永遠別試圖和巨魔講道理。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Don't just stand there I'm being trolled! Wait, that's not even a word.
plugin_fields.target: 別傻站著啊，我被巨魔給「巨魔（trolled/惡搞）」了！等等，這現在好像還不能當動詞用。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'm sure deep down you are really a sweet troll.
plugin_fields.target: 我敢肯定你的內心深處絕對是一隻甜美的小巨魔。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I heard your mother was a sabrecat and your father a drunken imperial.
plugin_fields.target: 我聽說你老媽是隻劍齒虎，而你老爸是個喝醉的帝國人。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: The only way you will be keeping me warm at night is as a fur blanket!
plugin_fields.target: 你能在晚上幫我取暖的唯一方式，就是變成一張毛皮毯子！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You really have been at the skooma if you think you can take me on!
plugin_fields.target: 如果你覺得自己能打贏我，那你絕對是斯庫瑪嗑多了！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: This brings a whole new perspective on cat fights.
plugin_fields.target: 這可真讓我對貓咪掐架有了個全新的認知。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I heard The Lusty Argonian Maid was written about your mother.
plugin_fields.target: 我聽說《活力充沛的阿爾貢人女僕》寫的就是你老媽的豔史。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Ugh! You smell like something that just crawled out of a swamp! Oh wait.
plugin_fields.target: 嘔！你身上的味兒簡直就像剛從沼澤裡爬出來的一樣！噢，等等。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You are so stupid that you don't even know you are stupid!
plugin_fields.target: 你簡直蠢到連自己有多蠢都不知道！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: The only creature alive that would date you is a Falmer!
plugin_fields.target: 這世上唯一願意跟你約會的活物恐怕只有伐莫了！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I've seen better looking horkers than you!
plugin_fields.target: 我見過的海象都比你長得順眼！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Even Malacath is ashamed of you!
plugin_fields.target: 連瑪拉凱斯都以你為恥！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Why don't you come here and show me that big curved sword of yours!
plugin_fields.target: 你幹嘛不過來讓我見識見識你那根彎彎的「大寶劍」！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I know of another annoying Redguard that you will never get the chance to meet!
plugin_fields.target: 我剛好還認識另一個討人厭的紅衛人，不過你馬上就再也沒機會見到他了！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Now I see why elves are so hated!
plugin_fields.target: 現在我總算明白精靈為什麼這麼招人恨了！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Can't you take a hint? Nobody wants you. Go home!
plugin_fields.target: 你是聽不懂人話嗎？沒人歡迎你，滾回你的老家去！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Are you okay? You seem a little off-colour. Oh right, you're an elf!
plugin_fields.target: 你沒事吧？你看上去膚色不太正常。噢對，你是個精靈啊！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You died once, now it's time to die again!
plugin_fields.target: 你已經死過一次了，現在是時候再死一回了！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I will feast on your soul! Well not me but my friend will.
plugin_fields.target: 我要生吞你的靈魂！好吧不是我，是我的朋友會生吞了它。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Why must you things always attack at the most inconvenient times?
plugin_fields.target: 為什麼你們這些怪物總挑別人最不方便的時候攻擊？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Hah! Even the villagers aren't scared of you!
plugin_fields.target: 哈！連那些村民都不怕你！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Eeww gross! Kill it! Kill it with fire!
plugin_fields.target: 呃真噁心！殺掉它！用火燒死它！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You are an abomination! Killing you would be the kindest thing to do!
plugin_fields.target: 你這噁心的怪物！除掉你就是我大發慈悲了！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You don't look so tough to me!
plugin_fields.target: 你在我眼裡可一點也不抗揍！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Do the whole of Nirn a favour and just die will you!
plugin_fields.target: 拜託你乾脆去死，就當是給整個奈恩星造福了好嗎！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Why do you even exist?
plugin_fields.target: 你存在的意義到底是什麼？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: The gods must have been drunk the day they created you!
plugin_fields.target: 眾神在創造你那天絕對是喝高了！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I will wear you as a trophy!
plugin_fields.target: 我要把你的皮剝下來當戰利品穿在身上！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Won't you just die already!
plugin_fields.target: 你怎麼還不去死啊！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I bet your bark is worse than your bite!
plugin_fields.target: 我敢打賭你也就是個光說不練的貨色！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You need to cut your nails! You'll end up taking somebody's eye out!
plugin_fields.target: 你真該剪剪指甲了！不然遲早會把別人的眼珠子摳出來！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Ugh! Your breath stinks!
plugin_fields.target: 呃！你嘴巴臭死了！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I didn't want it to end like this. Actually it's not over yet.
plugin_fields.target: 我可不想以這種方式落幕。實際上好戲還沒完呢。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I don't fear death as I know I have a place in Sovngarde.
plugin_fields.target: 我從不畏懼死亡，因為我知道安息聖域早為我留好了位子。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: If you kill me, I'll be sure to take you with me. Well not with me but you know what I mean.
plugin_fields.target: 如果你殺了我，我絕對會帶你一起下地獄。呃，雖然不是跟我在一起，但你懂我的意思。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: If I die then I'll come back as a ghost to haunt you.
plugin_fields.target: 如果我死了，我發誓會化作厲鬼回來纏死你。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'll die a hero whereas you will soon be forgotten.
plugin_fields.target: 我將作為英雄死去，而你很快就會爛在沒人知道的角落。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I Must... Continue... Fighting.
plugin_fields.target: 我必須……繼續……戰鬥。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: OK, I underestimated you but I'm not dead yet.
plugin_fields.target: 好吧，我承認低估你了，但我還沒死透呢。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: If I am to die then I want to go out in style. Does my hair look alright?
plugin_fields.target: 就算要死，我也得死得有型。我的髮型沒亂吧？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Let me just catch my breath.
plugin_fields.target: 讓我先喘口氣。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: If I die my friend will avenge me... I hope.
plugin_fields.target: 就算我死了，我的朋友也會替我報仇的……大概吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: While I still breathe your life is in danger.
plugin_fields.target: 只要我還有一口氣在，你的小命就保不住。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Argh... you got me. That doesn't make you special, it just means I'm getting sloppy.
plugin_fields.target: 啊……你贏了。但這不代表你有多厲害，純粹是我大意了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You're just making me even more angry.
plugin_fields.target: 你只會讓我更加憤怒。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: No! I think I just broke a nail.
plugin_fields.target: 不！我想我的指甲斷了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Ow that hurt.
plugin_fields.target: 噢，好疼！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Uugh! That does it!
plugin_fields.target: 啊！我受夠了！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Argh! That's gonna cost you!
plugin_fields.target: 啊！你會付出代價的！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You'd hit a woman?
plugin_fields.target: 你居然打女人？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Ugh! You'll pay for that!
plugin_fields.target: 啊！我會讓你付出代價的！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Careful! You wouldn't want to hurt my pretty face!
plugin_fields.target: 悠著點！你也不想毀了我這如花似玉的臉蛋吧！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Ugh!
plugin_fields.target: 呃！

plugin_fields.source: Yes. Did you want something?
plugin_fields.target: 我在。你想要點什麼嗎？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Do you have something to say?
plugin_fields.target: 你有什麼話要說嗎？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Was there something you wanted?
plugin_fields.target: 你需要點什麼嗎？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: What is it?
plugin_fields.target: 什麼？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Yes. I'm listening.
plugin_fields.target: 說吧，我在聽。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: What's on your mind?
plugin_fields.target: 在想什麼呢？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Let me guess. You want to talk.
plugin_fields.target: 讓我猜猜。你想找我聊天。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'm all ears. Well not literally of course.
plugin_fields.target: 我洗耳恭聽。好吧，當然不用真的去洗耳朵。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Ssshhhh Keep it down will you. We're supposed to be stealthy remember.
plugin_fields.target: 噓，小聲點行嗎。別忘了咱們現在可是在潛行。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Please tell me you actually know what you are doing.
plugin_fields.target: 拜託告訴我你確實清楚你自己在幹什麼。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Talking whilst sneaking. Makes sense.
plugin_fields.target: 一邊潛行一邊聊天。真有道理。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I thought you wanted to play this the sneaky way?
plugin_fields.target: 我還以為你想玩潛行暗殺流呢？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I really don't think you are taking this stealth thing seriously at all.
plugin_fields.target: 我嚴重懷疑你壓根就沒把潛行當回事兒。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You're not exactly filling me with confidence right now.
plugin_fields.target: 你這副樣子可真是讓我對咱倆的處境充滿「信心」啊。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: What are you waiting for? Now is the time to make a move.
plugin_fields.target: 你還在等什麼？現在正是動手的好時機。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Come on, come on. Get on with it. The suspense is killing me.
plugin_fields.target: 來吧，趕緊的。這該死的懸念簡直快把我折磨瘋了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Hmmm?
plugin_fields.target: 嗯？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: What's on your... ehhh... mind?
plugin_fields.target: 你腦子裡……呃……在想什麼呢？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Yeeeees?
plugin_fields.target: 什——麼事兒？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Why are you looking at me like that? Oh, you want something...
plugin_fields.target: 你幹嘛用那種眼神看著我？噢，你想要了是不是……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: This will be amusing.
plugin_fields.target: 這一定很有趣。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Oh, I love a chat! Especially when you listen.
plugin_fields.target: 噢，我最喜歡聊天了！尤其是當你乖乖聽著的時候。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well if it isn't my second most favourite person. The first should be pretty obvious.
plugin_fields.target: 哎呀，這不是我第二喜歡的人嗎。至於我最喜歡誰，應該很明顯了吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Hello there... uh... husband?
plugin_fields.target: 你好啊……嗯……老公？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Hello there... uh... wife?
plugin_fields.target: 你好啊……嗯……老婆？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Did you want to tell me how beautiful I am?
plugin_fields.target: 你是想告訴我我今天有多美嗎？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: How about you make me feel really special... Got any booze?
plugin_fields.target: 你要不要來點特別的舉動讓我高興高興……比如請我喝杯酒什麼的？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Are you just admiring me or did you want something?
plugin_fields.target: 你是在純粹地欣賞我的美貌，還是別有所圖？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Oh I love it when you talk to me like that.
plugin_fields.target: 噢，我就喜歡你用這種調調跟我說話。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Who said marriage couldn't also be fun?
plugin_fields.target: 誰說婚姻就一定是愛情的墳墓了？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You better have stopped so you could shower me with gifts.
plugin_fields.target: 你最好是停下來準備用禮物把我淹沒的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I only have eyes for you my love... Oh sorry I was thinking about alcohol.
plugin_fields.target: 我的眼裡只有你，親愛的……噢抱歉，我剛才腦子裡全都是美酒。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You better be trying to impress me. Being married is no excuse.
plugin_fields.target: 你最好想辦法讓我開心點。結了婚可不是你懈怠的藉口。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Hopefully my beauty isn't too much of a distraction for you?
plugin_fields.target: 希望我的美貌沒有讓你太分心？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Can I ask you something?
plugin_fields.target: 我能問你點事兒嗎？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: There was something I wanted to ask you.
plugin_fields.target: 我有點事兒想問你。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: OK then.
plugin_fields.target: 好吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Yes, let's go.
plugin_fields.target: 好的，我們走。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Alright then.
plugin_fields.target: 那好吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'm glad that's sorted.
plugin_fields.target: 很高興事情都解決了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Time to move I guess.
plugin_fields.target: 我想該動身了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'm here if ever you need me.
plugin_fields.target: 只要你需要我，我就在這兒。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Let's not hang around then.
plugin_fields.target: 那我們就別再這兒閒晃了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I rather enjoyed our little chat.
plugin_fields.target: 我還挺享受我們之間的小聊天的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: OK, then.
plugin_fields.target: 好吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: That was fun.
plugin_fields.target: 真有趣。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Let's do something more fun now.
plugin_fields.target: 現在讓我們來找點更有樂子的事吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Back to partying then!
plugin_fields.target: 狂歡繼續！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Alright then.
plugin_fields.target: 那好吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Time to move I guess... slowly though.
plugin_fields.target: 我想該動身了……慢吞吞地。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Were you trying to grope me? Um OK.
plugin_fields.target: 你剛才是想鹹豬手摸我嗎？呃，也不是不行。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Stop trying to look up my armour.
plugin_fields.target: 別再試圖偷瞄我的裙底風光了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Hands off. Only I get to touch myself... and no I don't mean like that.
plugin_fields.target: 把手拿開。我可只讓自己摸……呃不，我的意思不是那種「摸」。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I know what you're up to and it would be hypocritical of me to say anything.
plugin_fields.target: 我知道你在打什麼鬼主意，不過我要是多嘴指責你的話，那我也未免太虛偽了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: And I thought I was clumsy.
plugin_fields.target: 看來笨手笨腳的人不止我一個嘛。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Keep it up and one of these days you will become like me. Yeah you wish.
plugin_fields.target: 繼續保持，總有一天你會變得像我一樣優秀的。想得美吧你。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Ooh I hope that wasn't valuable. Actually what do I care.
plugin_fields.target: 噢，我希望剛才摔壞的那個不是什麼貴重物品。算了，我操這心幹嘛。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You're trying to upstage me aren't you? Well I'm sorry to tell you but I've had years of practice.
plugin_fields.target: 你想搶我的風頭對不對？不過我很遺憾地告訴你，我為了搶風頭可是苦練了好幾年了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Don't look at me. I'm not taking the blame.
plugin_fields.target: 別看著我，我可不背這個鍋。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: For once it actually wasn't me that knocked something over.
plugin_fields.target: 難得一次，終於不是我把東西撞翻了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: That was rather inappropriate. Well done.
plugin_fields.target: 你這舉動實在有失體統。不過幹得漂亮。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Now, now. Calm yourself. I know I'm irresistible.
plugin_fields.target: 好了，好了，冷靜點。我知道我魅力四射讓人無法抗拒。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I know you're excited to see me but perhaps you should wait for a more appropriate moment before trying to dive on top of me.
plugin_fields.target: 我知道你見著我總是急不可耐，但在你打算撲倒我之前，也許你該等到一個更合時宜的場合。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You remind me of a dog I used to know. I had to always shake him off of me as well.
plugin_fields.target: 你讓我想起了我以前養過的一條狗。它總是喜歡往我身上撲，我也總得費勁把它甩開。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Oh, is there something hard in your pocket? I felt it when you brushed against me.
plugin_fields.target: 噢，你口袋裡是不是裝了什麼硬邦邦的東西？剛才你蹭到我的時候我感覺到了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Most people usually buy me a drink first.
plugin_fields.target: 別人通常都會先請我喝杯酒的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Wake up. Stop daydreaming about me and watch where you're going.
plugin_fields.target: 醒醒吧。別再做關於我的白日夢了，走路看著點。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: This isn't one of those boy meets girl clichés is it?
plugin_fields.target: 這該不會是那種俗套的「男孩邂逅女孩」的狗血搭訕橋段吧？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Is this your idea of girl on girl action? What? I heard someone say it. I'm not even sure what it means.
plugin_fields.target: 這難道就是你理想中的「女孩跟女孩的動作戲」？幹嘛？我聽別人這麼說過，但我甚至都不知道這詞啥意思。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I know I can be annoying but you're not going to shoot me are you?
plugin_fields.target: 我知道我這人有時挺煩人的，但你總不至於要拿箭射我吧？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: How about I aim my weapon in your face and see how you like it.
plugin_fields.target: 要不我也把武器指著你的臉，看看你作何感想？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'm used to guys pointing their weapon at me but this isn't quite what I had in mind.
plugin_fields.target: 我已經習慣了男人把「武器」指著我，但這可絕對不是我想要的那種。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You should be careful where you point that. Just ask the wood elf in Whiterun or the fletcher in Solitude.
plugin_fields.target: 你最好當心點你指的方向。不信你去問問白漫城的木精靈，或者獨孤城的製箭師。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Careful with that! I don't want to become some hunting trophy.
plugin_fields.target: 小心點！我可不想變成某個獵人的牆頭裝飾。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Could you point your weapon somewhere else. Preferably at a bandit or the Thalmor.
plugin_fields.target: 你能把你的武器挪開嗎？最好是指著強盜或者梭默。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Your weapon may be sharp but my tongue is sharper so watch where you point that thing.
plugin_fields.target: 你的武器也許很鋒利，但我的舌頭更毒，所以看清楚你指著的是誰。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I would like you to remain here when I don't need you.
plugin_fields.target: 我希望當我不需要你的時候，你能留在這兒。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Why would you ever not need?
plugin_fields.target: 你為什麼還會不需要呢？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well I plan on sticking around so don't think you can dump me off that easily.
plugin_fields.target: 既然我都打算賴著你了，就別指望能輕易把我甩掉。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So you want me to stand outside whenever you feel like abandoning me. What if it rains?
plugin_fields.target: 所以你一想撇下我，就讓我乾站在外面挨凍？萬一下雨了怎麼辦？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Oh you'll certainly find me in the tavern alright.
plugin_fields.target: 噢，你直接去酒館肯定能找到我。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So I guess this is my home now? I guess it beats living in a cave.
plugin_fields.target: 所以這裡就是我的新家了？總比住山洞強吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You want this to be my new hideout? But it's filthy and there's probably spiders.
plugin_fields.target: 你想把這兒當成我的新窩？但這兒髒兮兮的，而且說不定還有蜘蛛！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Oh OK. I suppose this place will do.
plugin_fields.target: 噢行吧。我看這地方還湊合。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Could you leave all the fighting to me.
plugin_fields.target: 你能把所有的戰鬥都留給我嗎？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: If that's what you want.
plugin_fields.target: 如果你非要這麼幹的話。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I would like you to join in fighting.
plugin_fields.target: 我希望你加入戰鬥。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I knew you couldn't cope without me.
plugin_fields.target: 我就知道沒了我你寸步難行。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: How about you lead the way for a while?
plugin_fields.target: 你要不要帶一會兒路？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Sure. Sounds like fun.
plugin_fields.target: 當然。聽起來不錯。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So what now?
plugin_fields.target: 接下來去哪兒？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: We made it!
plugin_fields.target: 我們做到了！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Provide covering fire. (ranged)
plugin_fields.target: 提供火力掩護。（遠程）
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I've got your back.
plugin_fields.target: 我來殿後。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Did I tell you about the tavern in Solitude? What was its name again? Uuuuh it was called...
plugin_fields.target: 我跟你提過獨孤城裡的那家酒館嗎？叫啥名字來著？呃……好像叫……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I can't remember but people didn't seem to appreciate me talking about the place. They thought I meant something else.
plugin_fields.target: 我記不清了，但鎮上的人似乎不太樂意我提起那地方。他們好像都想歪了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Did you just call me fat? Well at least I don't look like a horrr...ker. And yes I did say horker.
plugin_fields.target: 你剛才是在說我胖嗎？至少我看起來不像個騷……貨……哎海、海象。沒錯，我剛才說的就是海象。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Did your mum happen to be a troll by any chance? I heard she was so ugly she made the Thalmor cry.
plugin_fields.target: 你老媽該不會恰好是隻巨魔吧？我聽說她長得奇醜無比，連梭默都能被她醜哭。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Don't you walk away from me. I might have to get my fighting moves out and then give you a big hug.
plugin_fields.target: 你別想甩開我。不然我可就要亮出我的戰鬥架勢，然後強行給你一個大大的擁抱了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Dovahkiin, Dovahkiin, da da da duh duh duh daaah. I don't know, all the words, so I'm making them up.
plugin_fields.target: 都瓦克因，都瓦克因，噠噠噠噠噠~噠。我記不住歌詞，所以我就自己瞎編了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Have you heard my impersonation of an Imperial?
plugin_fields.target: 你聽過我模仿帝國人的樣子嗎？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Halt, you need to fill out this piece of paper before you can pass because I will chop your head off and give it to the thalmor.
plugin_fields.target: 「站住，通行之前你必須填完這張表，否則我就砍下你的腦袋拿去獻給梭默。」
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'm so big and tough because I can pay someone to chop your head off in public instead of fighting you one on one.
plugin_fields.target: 「我之所以如此威風凜凜，是因為我能花錢僱人當街砍你的頭，而不是跟你單挑。」
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I do take thee noble peasant to be my wife or possibly husband.
plugin_fields.target: 我確實願意娶——或者嫁給——你這位高貴的鄉巴佬。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I wonder if the huntsman in Whiterun is actually drunk right now otherwise it is false advertising and he should close his shop.
plugin_fields.target: 我很好奇白漫城那個「醉獵戶」老闆現在到底喝醉了沒，如果沒醉那他就是虛假宣傳，他的店早該關門大吉了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: We should buy him a few drinks just to make sure. You can pay though.
plugin_fields.target: 我們應該去給他買幾杯酒幫他「名副其實」。不過得你來掏錢。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Let's have a party at my house. Actually wait a minute I don't have a house. What about your house then?
plugin_fields.target: 去我家開個派對怎麼樣！哎等等，我連個房子都沒有。去你家怎麼樣？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: What do you mean I'm drunk? You're drunk. It's lies. Lies I tell you. All of it. Every single word you say is lies.
plugin_fields.target: 你說我醉了是啥意思？你才醉了！你在撒謊。我告訴你，全是謊話。你說的每一個字都是一派胡言。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Will one of you please slow down. Hey wait a minute you didn't tell me you had a twin.
plugin_fields.target: 你們兩個能不能走慢點！嘿等一下，你可沒告訴我你還有個雙胞胎兄弟啊。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Will you stop embarrassing me. Everyone is looking at us. It must be you. It couldn't possibly be me.
plugin_fields.target: 你別讓我丟臉了好不好。所有人都在盯著我們看。絕對是因為你，反正絕不可能是因為我。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You're a funny looking pretty girl but you're also kind of ugly and attractive at the same time.
plugin_fields.target: 你是個長得挺逗的漂亮女孩，但你同時又醜得很迷人。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Oh what happened to all my clothes? I think I must have accidentally lost them. What a shame.
plugin_fields.target: 噢我的衣服都跑哪去了？我一定是不小心把它們都弄丟了。真可惜。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Have you seen my dance? Let me show you, I just know you're gonna love it.
plugin_fields.target: 你看過我的舞姿嗎？讓我跳給你看看吧，我保證你會愛死它的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Right that does it. I challenge you to a fist fight. The loser has to become my personal slave.
plugin_fields.target: 沒完了是吧。我要跟你肉搏單挑。輸了的人必須當我的貼身奴隸。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: What did you just say? Oh you want to fight, bring it on.
plugin_fields.target: 你剛說什麼來著？噢你想打架是吧，放馬過來。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You can lock me up but you'll never take me alive.
plugin_fields.target: 你們可以把我關起來，但休想活捉我。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Use your magic! (magic)
plugin_fields.target: 把你的魔法用上！（魔法）
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'm a little rusty but ok.
plugin_fields.target: 我雖然有點生疏了，不過還應付得來。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Show me how you dual wield. (dual wield)
plugin_fields.target: 讓我看看你的雙持技巧。（雙持）
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'll give it my best shot.
plugin_fields.target: 我會盡我所能的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Just stick to melee. (melee only)
plugin_fields.target: 只要近戰就好。（僅限近戰）
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: That I can do.
plugin_fields.target: 這事我能辦妥。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Can you just use magic. (magic only)
plugin_fields.target: 你能只用魔法嗎？（僅限魔法）
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I suppose, if that's what you want.
plugin_fields.target: 好吧，既然這是你的要求。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Just keep me covered. (ranged only)
plugin_fields.target: 掩護我就好。（僅限遠程）
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I guess I can do that.
plugin_fields.target: 我想我能搞定。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Use two weapons only. (dual wield only
plugin_fields.target: 只用雙持武器。（僅限雙持）
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I guess I'm ok with that.
plugin_fields.target: 我想我沒問題。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: How are you feeling?
plugin_fields.target: 你感覺怎麼樣？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: My legs hurt. I think it's from all that walking. I don't suppose you would mind carrying me?... I take that as a no then.
plugin_fields.target: 我的腿好痠。肯定是走路走太多了。你應該不會介意揹我一段路吧？……我就當你默認說「不」了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: My under-garments are really starting to chafe. I don't suppose you would... no that would be pretty awkward for the both of us.
plugin_fields.target: 我的內衣磨得我渾身難受。你應該不會願意幫我……算了，真那樣幹咱倆都會尷尬死的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Fine, I guess. I would elaborate further if I could be bothered but thanks for asking.
plugin_fields.target: 行吧，還算湊合。要不是我懶得廢話，我還能再多抱怨兩句，但還是謝謝你關心。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'm feeling good but also quite bad at the same time if you know what I mean.
plugin_fields.target: 我感覺棒極了，但同時又感覺糟透了，你懂我意思吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'm feeling a little bit naughty. Do you want to go and do something we might regret? Oh no... I think you misunderstood...
plugin_fields.target: 我現在渾身上下都按捺不住想幹點壞事。你想不想跟我去幹點事後會後悔的勾當？噢不……你腦子裡想哪兒去了……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I meant as in getting into mischief, not the other kind of naughty, although that would also be... uh no I think I'll just leave it at that.
plugin_fields.target: 我是說去搞點惡作劇，不是那種「幹壞事」，雖然那種壞事也挺……算了，這話題到此為止吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I have an itch in a really inappropriate place. I would scratch it, but I'm sure you don't want to see me itching my... uh nevermind.
plugin_fields.target: 我有個非常不方便明說的地方好癢。我真想撓一撓，但我確定你肯定不想看我撓我的……呃，算了沒什麼。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: That's what I like about you. You actually care how I feel and take the time to ask me.
plugin_fields.target: 這就是我為什麼喜歡你的原因。你竟然真的在乎我的感受，還願意花時間來過問我。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw
