plugin_fields.source: Hungry. I'm so hungry I could even eat you... Uh, I mean in a non-perverted way of course.
plugin_fields.target: 餓扁了。我餓得甚至都想把你吃乾抹淨了……呃，我的意思當然是很正經的「吃」。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'm very tired. I think we should stop and get some rest. I don't mind where. I don't even mind sharing with you...
plugin_fields.target: 我累壞了。我覺得我們該停下來找個地方歇腳了。我不介意睡在哪兒。我甚至不介意跟你擠一張床……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: as long as you don't try any funny business.
plugin_fields.target: 只要你別對我動手動腳就行。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I don't think I should tell you how I really feel. I don't want to creep you out or anything.
plugin_fields.target: 我覺得我最好還是別把我的真實感受告訴你。我可不想嚇到你。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Ever since meeting you I just feel like my life has become so much better. You make me feel...
plugin_fields.target: 自從遇見你之後，我感覺我的人生變得美妙多了。你讓我覺得……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Damn it I'm getting all sentimental which is really out of character for me.
plugin_fields.target: 該死的，我居然變得這麼多愁善感，這簡直一點都不像我了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Hmph. Like you care... I'm sorry I shouldn't have been so rude I just... don't worry. I'm fine... really.
plugin_fields.target: 哼。搞得你好像真在乎似的……抱歉，我不應該這麼衝的，我只是……別擔心。我很好……真的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Words can't describe how I feel right now.
plugin_fields.target: 言語已經無法形容我現在的心情了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Oh just fantastic, why shouldn't I be? Apart from the fact I always seem to attract the wrong kind of attention and everyone wants to kill me.
plugin_fields.target: 好得很，為什麼不好？除了我老是招惹些不三不四的人，而且滿世界的人都想宰了我之外，一切都好得很。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I guess it's my fault but I can't change who I am.
plugin_fields.target: 我猜都是我的錯吧，但我生來如此，改不掉的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'm probably feeling a little bit guilty. I kill hundreds of people and enjoy it and then afterwards I feel guilty but then I also feel empowered.
plugin_fields.target: 我可能覺得有點內疚。我殺了成百上千的人，而且還很享受這個過程，事後我會有負罪感，但同時我又覺得充滿力量。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Who ever thought feelings could be so complicated.
plugin_fields.target: 誰能想到感情居然能複雜到這種地步。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Cold. Can't we go and find a nice warm fire, drink some mead and snuggle up together? ...Did I say together? I meant... uh... nothing.
plugin_fields.target: 冷死了。咱們就不能去找個暖和的火堆，喝點蜂蜜酒，然後緊緊地依偎在一起嗎？……我剛才說了「在一起」嗎？我的意思是……呃……當我沒說。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'm freezing. Apparently people have kept warm before by using their body heat and rubbing up against each other.
plugin_fields.target: 我快凍僵了。據說以前的人都是通過互相摩擦身體來取暖的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Uh not that I'm suggesting that of course... unless you... no of course not.
plugin_fields.target: 呃，我當然不是在提議咱們也照做……除非你……不，當然不行。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Bored. Can't we do something a little more exciting like insulting a jarl or punching a sleeping dragon.
plugin_fields.target: 無聊死了。我們不能幹點更刺激的事嗎，比如當面羞辱領主，或者對著一條睡熟的巨龍邦邦來兩拳。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Actually that's probably going a bit too far, even for me.
plugin_fields.target: 說實話，這可能有點玩過火了，就連我都覺得有點吃不消。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You actually care how I feel? You really aren't like most people who just shout abuse at me. Although I probably do deserve it.
plugin_fields.target: 你居然真的關心我的感受？你真不像那些只會對我破口大罵的人。雖說我可能也確實活該被罵。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Wet. From the rain obviously. Can't we find some shelter.
plugin_fields.target: 濕透了。很明顯是被雨淋的。我們就不能找個地方避避雨嗎。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'm absolutely drenched all the way down to my underwear. Can't we get a room and take all our clothes off... Oh no that came out wrong.
plugin_fields.target: 我渾身濕透了，甚至連內衣都能擰出水來。咱們難道不能找個房間把衣服全脫了嗎……噢糟糕，這話聽起來不對勁。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: What I meant was we could go to an inn and change into some dry clothes but not together obviously.
plugin_fields.target: 我的意思是我們可以去旅店換身乾衣服，當然不是一起換。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Nauseous from the smell. This place absolutely stinks, almost as bad as you do. Haha that was just a joke obviously. Or was it?
plugin_fields.target: 這股味兒燻得我直犯噁心。這地方臭氣熏天，簡直跟你身上的味道有得一拼。哈哈，開個玩笑而已。真的只是玩笑嗎？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You know how I always make out that I'm never afraid? Well I was lying. I'm feeling pretty afraid right now, but don't tell anyone I said that.
plugin_fields.target: 你知道我為什麼總是裝出一副天不怕地不怕的樣子嗎？其實我一直在逞強。我現在怕得要死，但你絕不能把這話告訴任何人。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well I was feeling pretty lonely till you came along but I'm so glad you did.
plugin_fields.target: 好吧，在你出現之前我都覺得挺孤單的，我真慶幸你來到了我身邊。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'm fine. Why do you keep asking me?
plugin_fields.target: 我挺好的啊。你幹嘛老是問個不停？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I already told you how I am. Ask me again later and maybe I'll have something else to say.
plugin_fields.target: 我剛才不是告訴過你我感覺怎麼樣了嗎。過會兒再問我吧，說不定我就有別的話要說了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Do you always keep repeating yourself to people.
plugin_fields.target: 你平時跟人聊天也是這麼像個複讀機一樣的嗎？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'm fine, no need to keep asking me.
plugin_fields.target: 我很好，沒必要一個勁兒地問我。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Look can we just cut the small talk. I keep telling you that I am ok.
plugin_fields.target: 聽著，咱能別扯這些沒用的寒暄了嗎。我一直在跟你說我很好。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I don't mean to be rude but I have nothing more to say on the matter.
plugin_fields.target: 我不是想掃你的興，但關於這個問題我已經沒什麼好說的了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: A little bit dizzy. I think we need to slow down for a bit.
plugin_fields.target: 有點暈乎乎的。我覺得咱們得稍微放慢點節奏了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Ohh I feel greaaaat.
plugin_fields.target: 噢！我感覺好——極了！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I am happy you are here with me. You make sure I have a good time.
plugin_fields.target: 我很高興有你陪在我身邊。你總是能讓我開心。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I could use another drink.
plugin_fields.target: 我還能再幹一杯。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I feel like partying! A shame no one else is in the mood.
plugin_fields.target: 我真想開個派對狂歡一下！可惜沒人有這個興致。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You sure you want to know?
plugin_fields.target: 你確定你想知道嗎？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I feel like I'm being stared at, but I can't help I'm beautiful.
plugin_fields.target: 我總覺得有人在偷看我，不過這也難怪，誰讓我長得這麼美呢。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You think I'm drunk, but I'm not! I can perfectly walk on a line.. well, okay a wobbly one.
plugin_fields.target: 你以為我喝醉了，但我沒醉！我走直線穩得很。。好吧，可能是條歪七扭八的直線。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: How could I possibly say no?
plugin_fields.target: 我怎麼可能會拒絕呢？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well if you insist.
plugin_fields.target: 好吧，既然你這麼堅持的話。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: When is there not a good time to have a drink?
plugin_fields.target: 什麼時候會不適合來一杯呢？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: If I'm not mistaken I would say you were trying to get me drunk.
plugin_fields.target: 如果我沒猜錯的話，你肯定是想把我灌醉。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Has someone told you what I'm like when I'm drunk or something?
plugin_fields.target: 是不是有人跟你八卦過我喝醉後會是什麼樣子？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: That's the stuff. I hope you're not just trying to get me to...well you know.
plugin_fields.target: 就是這個味兒。我希望你不是想藉機把我灌醉然後……你懂的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You are sooo kind. You the only one who gets drinks for me.
plugin_fields.target: 你人真——好。你是唯一一個願意請我喝酒的人。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I don't feel too good. I think I have enough now.
plugin_fields.target: 我感覺胃裡一陣翻江倒海，我想我喝夠了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So you're off to see the jarl of Whiterun then? They wouldn't let me into Dragonsreach, apparently I wasn't important enough...
plugin_fields.target: 所以你打算去見白漫城的領主？那幫守衛死活不讓我進龍臨堡，顯然他們覺得我不夠資格……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: but with you I might get away with it as long as they don't remember that incident when a criminal escaped because I was... distracting the guards.
plugin_fields.target: 但跟著你我沒準能混進去，只要他們沒想起之前某個罪犯越獄的案子就行，畢竟當時是我在……吸引守衛的注意力。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So the jarl wants you to go to Bleak Falls Barrow to retrieve some ancient artefact? Sounds like my kind of adventure.
plugin_fields.target: 所以領主讓你去荒瀑古墳找回什麼古代遺物？這活兒聽起來挺對我的胃口。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Although I am a little worried about the draugr. I doubt my feminine beauty is going to cut it with those guys. I doubt they even have any...
plugin_fields.target: 不過我對那些屍鬼還是有點發毛。我懷疑我的女性魅力對這幫傢夥起不了任何作用。我甚至懷疑他們到底還有沒有……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: you know... the difference between a man and a woman.
plugin_fields.target: 你懂的……能區分男女的特徵。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Did I just hear correctly? The jarl wants you to go and fight a dragon? Please tell me you're not actually considering it.
plugin_fields.target: 我剛才沒聽錯吧？領主要你去跟一條巨龍肉搏？求你告訴我你沒當真。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Not that I'm scared of course.
plugin_fields.target: 當然，我才沒有害怕呢。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I can't believe it. You actually killed a dragon and you absorbed its soul. This day just keeps getting better.
plugin_fields.target: 我簡直不敢相信。你居然真的屠了一頭龍，而且還把它的靈魂給吸了。今天真是越來越刺激了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Just wait till I tell people that a true hero slayed a dragon. Of course you helped out a bit.
plugin_fields.target: 等著我告訴大家，一位真正的英雄屠了一頭龍吧。當然，你也幫了點小忙。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'm only joking although you couldn't have done it without me.
plugin_fields.target: 我開玩笑的啦，不過要不是有我罩著你，你肯定搞不定。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I can't believe it. You actually killed a dragon and you absorbed its soul. I just wish I could have been there to share in the glory...
plugin_fields.target: 我簡直不敢相信。你居然真的屠了一頭龍，而且還把它的靈魂給吸了。我真希望當時我也在場，好分走一半的榮耀……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Although it's probably for the best as I don't want to get my beautiful hair burnt.
plugin_fields.target: 不過沒在場可能也是件好事，我可不想我這頭漂亮的秀髮被火燒成焦炭。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Wait are you really dragonborn? So I guess that really does make you kind of special. I guess you almost live up to my high standards now.
plugin_fields.target: 等等，你真的是傳說中的龍裔？那看來你確實有幾分特別之處了。我想你現在勉強夠格達到我選人的高標準了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Good looking, strong, brave, adventurous. So tell me what sort of women are you into? Not that I'm interested in you or anything.
plugin_fields.target: 美貌、強壯、勇敢，還充滿冒險精神。快告訴我，你喜歡什麼類型的女人？我先宣告，我可不是對你有意思啊。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So you're thane now huh. Well don't think some fancy title is going to make me your servant. Although I must admit I am happy for you.
plugin_fields.target: 所以你現在是武衛大人了是吧。別以為頂著個花哨的頭銜就能把我當丫鬟使喚。不過我必須承認，我還是為你感到高興的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Perhaps I could take advantage of you sometime. Uh I mean if we get into trouble I could use your status to my advantage.
plugin_fields.target: 也許改天我能好好利用你一下。呃，我的意思是，如果我們惹了麻煩，我可以搬出你的身份來當擋箭牌。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: What's the deal with that housecarl the jarl just gave you. She doesn't look much to me. I could outmatch her in terms of combat,
plugin_fields.target: 領主賞給你的那個貼身侍衛是怎麼回事。我怎麼看她都不咋地。論打架我能把她按在地上摩擦，
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: looks and just about anything really. I don't know what you could possibly see in her.
plugin_fields.target: 論長相，甚至論任何方面我都完爆她。我真搞不懂你看上她哪點了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'm not sure I like the sound of the 7,000 steps. Surely that must absolutely kill your legs. I also better check I'm wearing underwear...
plugin_fields.target: 一聽到這七千級臺階我就渾身難受。爬完腿絕對要廢掉。我還得檢查一下今天穿內褲了沒……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: as I've heard that it can get a little chilly around the southern parts if you know what I mean. I don't need your help to do that before you ask.
plugin_fields.target: 聽說那山上風挺大，下面會有些冷颼颼的，你懂我的意思吧。你敢張嘴問一句試試，我可不需要你幫我檢查。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well we made it here alive at least. This place is huge.
plugin_fields.target: 好吧，至少我們活著爬上來了。這鬼地方大得離譜。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I would hate to have been the ones who built it on the highest mountain in Skyrim of all places.
plugin_fields.target: 我真同情那些當初負責建修道院的倒霉蛋，天際這麼多地方不選，非要建在最高的山頂上。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Those greybeards are a strange bunch. Imagine having to sit there in silence all the time, I just couldn't do it.
plugin_fields.target: 這些灰髯士真是一群怪咖。想想看，整天像個木頭一樣坐在那兒一言不發，打死我都做不到。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I struggle staying quiet for even a minute. Also what's the point in having all that power and not using it?
plugin_fields.target: 憋一分鐘不說話都能要了我的命。再說了，掌握了那麼毀天滅地的力量卻不用，那圖個啥？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I suppose those greybeards must be getting on a bit though.
plugin_fields.target: 我看那些灰髯士八成是老糊塗了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Hmm... Unrelenting force shout, tallest mountain in Skyrim. Are you thinking what I'm thinking?
plugin_fields.target: 嗯……無情之力，天際最高峰。咱倆想到一塊兒去了嗎？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: We should fetch our good friend Lydia and show her the view, and at the same time you could show her your new shout.
plugin_fields.target: 咱們應該把咱的好朋友萊迪亞拽上來，帶她欣賞一下這裡的絕美風光，順便你還能給她演示一下你的新龍吼。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: If she accidentally falls then I suppose it's no big loss. What? Don't give me that look.
plugin_fields.target: 如果她「不小心」掉下去了，我想這也算不上什麼大損失吧。幹嘛？別用那種眼神看著我。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Hmm... Unrelenting force shout, tallest mountain in Skyrim. It's a shame Lydia is dead.
plugin_fields.target: 嗯……無情之力，天際最高峰。只可惜萊迪亞已經死透了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: We could have shown her the view and you could have demonstrated your new shout to her. What? If she fell she would have still died anyway.
plugin_fields.target: 咱們本來可以帶她欣賞一下這裡的絕美風光，順便你還能給她演示一下你的新龍吼。幹嘛？就算她掉下去了反正早晚也是個死。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So you need to find the Horn of Jurgen Windcaller. Yes, I had heard he was a little horny... Sorry that was a bad joke even for me.
plugin_fields.target: 我們需要去尋找「喚風者」約根的號角。聽說比起「喚風」，他生前其實更「風流」……抱歉，這冷笑話連我都覺得尷尬。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You mean to say we came all this way and risked our lives for nothing. The person who wrote that note better start explaining fast.
plugin_fields.target: 你的意思是，咱們冒著生命危險大老遠跑過來，結果撲了個空？寫這張紙條的傢夥最好趕緊給個合理的解釋。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: We don't have to take orders from that old skeever. As far as I'm concerned you're dragonborn, I'm extremely beautiful and tough,
plugin_fields.target: 咱們憑什麼要聽那隻老惡鼠的發號施令。依我看，你是堂堂龍裔，我更是美貌與實力並存的尤物，
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: and she should be taking orders from us.
plugin_fields.target: 理應是她聽命於我們才對。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: This is either going to be the best or worst idea ever. Still I wouldn't mind getting back at those thalmor for what they have done to our kingdom,
plugin_fields.target: 這主意要麼絕頂聰明，要麼就是爛到家了。不過我倒是一點也不介意趁機報復一下那些傲慢的梭默，誰讓他們把我們的王國搞得烏煙瘴氣的，
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: and I do love to dress up and make a lasting impression.
plugin_fields.target: 而且我也確實很享受盛裝打扮，好給別人留下個終身難忘的印象。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Did he just say getting fingered as a spy or was it by a spy? That doesn't sound so bad.
plugin_fields.target: 他剛才說他是被間諜「指認」了，還是說被間諜「指交」了？這聽起來似乎還不賴嘛。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Oh he didn't mean it like that? Hmm... that's a pity haha. I guess I must have a very dirty mind.
plugin_fields.target: 噢，他不是那個意思？嗯……那可真遺憾哈哈。看來我的思想真是太齷齪了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I guess we better go to Riften and find this Esbern then. We could go and ask Brynjolf but I don't trust anyone who is a member of the thieves guild.
plugin_fields.target: 看來我們最好動身去裂谷城找那個叫伊思本的傢夥了。我們可以去打聽打聽布林紐夫，但我從來都不信任盜賊公會裡的任何一個人。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: We may be better off asking that argonian woman at The Bee and Barb as she seems to have all the gossip, but it's up to you.
plugin_fields.target: 也許去蜂與鉤客棧問問那個阿爾貢人老闆娘會更好，她簡直就是個包打聽，不過這都由你來決定。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You're friends with the thieves guild. Maybe we should go and see them.
plugin_fields.target: 你不是跟盜賊公會的人熟嗎。也許我們該去拜訪一下他們。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Seriously? We have to go into the smelly sewers to find some old guy. The things I have to do for you.
plugin_fields.target: 不是吧？我們非得鑽進那惡臭熏天的下水道去撈一個糟老頭子？我真是為了你什麼都豁出去了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Still, with all these men around Skyrim I guess I must be used to the smell by now.
plugin_fields.target: 不過話又說回來，天際到處都是男人，我估計我也早就習慣這種味道了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Of course there are bandits in the sewers. What next some secret hideout... Oh wait.
plugin_fields.target: 下水道裡當然會藏著強盜。接下來又是什麼秘密基地……噢等等，還真是。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Wow this guy sure is security conscious. He makes me look normal.
plugin_fields.target: 哇哦，這老頭的被害妄想症也太嚴重了吧。跟他比起來我都算個正常人了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Oh great the thalmor. Well their filthy rotting corpses should feel quite at home here in the sewers.
plugin_fields.target: 噢太棒了，是梭默。他們那骯髒腐臭的屍體在這下水道裡絕對有賓至如歸的感覺。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Wow this reunion is so touching. Pass the sick bucket I think I'm going to vomit.
plugin_fields.target: 哇哦，這久別重逢的場面真是催人淚下啊。趕緊把嘔吐桶遞給我，我要吐了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: This place is full of strange people in revealing costumes. I feel quite at home.
plugin_fields.target: 這地方塞滿了一群穿著暴露的奇葩。感覺還挺有家的味道的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well that has got to be the world's easiest puzzle.
plugin_fields.target: 這絕對是世界上最弱智的解謎遊戲。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I had a feeling that they would make you go first. The cowards.
plugin_fields.target: 我早猜到他們會拿你當小白鼠探路。這幫膽小鬼。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'd like to see their faces if you got killed and Alduin came for them. They would be totally screwed.
plugin_fields.target: 如果真有陷阱把你弄死了，然後奧杜因找上門來，我真想看看他們臉上那絕望的表情。他們絕對死定了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Ow that looked painful. Well at least you only had to give a small drop of blood from your hand.
plugin_fields.target: 哎呀看著都覺得疼。不過還好，你只需要放點血就行了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I was waiting for them to stab you in the back and spill all of your blood.
plugin_fields.target: 我還以為他們會在背後捅你一刀，然後流光你所有的血。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Please tell me we don't have to listen to this guy giving a lecture. I'm already tired from all the walking and this guy is so boring.
plugin_fields.target: 拜託告訴我咱們不用像個傻子一樣聽這老頭長篇大論。我走得腿都快斷了，這傢夥簡直無聊透頂。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Finally! I never thought I would be so happy to go and see the greybeards, but after having to tag along with the mighty geriatric dragon slayers...
plugin_fields.target: 總算結束了！我從沒想過見灰髯士也能讓我這麼興奮，但和這群自稱偉大屠龍者的老掉牙的傢夥們待在一起……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: they seem wonderful in comparison.
plugin_fields.target: 相比之下那幫啞巴老頭簡直太可愛了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So the leader of the greybeards is a dragon? Well that explains a lot. So I guess we need an elder scroll then?
plugin_fields.target: 搞了半天灰髯士的頭頭居然是一條龍？這下很多事情就說得通了。所以現在我們要去找上古卷軸了？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Is that all, well that shouldn't be hard. I mean they are just laying all over the place.
plugin_fields.target: 就這？小菜一碟。畢竟這玩意兒滿大街都是，隨便撿嘛。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: There was me thinking he was going to say that we had to do something difficult.
plugin_fields.target: 我還以為他會派給我們什麼登天一樣難的差事呢。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So looks like we need to get into the College of Winterhold. I can't help you I'm afraid.
plugin_fields.target: 看來我們得混進冬堡學院了。這事兒我恐怕幫不上什麼忙。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You'll have to talk your way in or prove that you are capable of magic. I doubt they would take me back somehow.
plugin_fields.target: 你要麼憑三寸不爛之舌說服他們，要麼就得露兩手魔法證明你的實力。我估計他們打死都不會再讓我踏進學院半步了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well getting into the College of Winterhold should be no problem for you. Let's go and see our happy, smiling orc friend.
plugin_fields.target: 進個冬堡學院對你來說還不是易如反掌。走吧，咱們去見見那位每天樂呵呵的獸人朋友。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: He seemed pleased to see us. It's rare to find someone so jolly in Skyrim. Anyway let's go and find this Septimus guy.
plugin_fields.target: 他看起來見到我們還挺「高興」的。想在天際碰上這麼個「熱情洋溢」的人可真是不容易。總之，咱們出發去找那個叫塞普汀默斯的傢夥吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: If his book is anything to go by then this should be interesting.
plugin_fields.target: 如果他的書裡寫的不全是瘋言瘋語，那事情就有趣了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well he seemed fairly normal to me. He should consider writing poetry. So to Blackreach we go then.
plugin_fields.target: 我看他挺正常的嘛，他簡直就是個被埋沒的詩人。那咱們這就要下黑境了？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: What in oblivion is that thing? Is that where the elder scroll is kept? Well that was quicker and easier than I expected.
plugin_fields.target: 湮滅在上那到底是個什麼鬼東西？上古卷軸就藏在那種地方？這也太輕鬆了吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well I guess that old guy was right then but how do we get it, didn't he give you some special cube?
plugin_fields.target: 看來那個瘋老頭沒騙人，但我們怎麼把它弄出來？他是不是給了你個奇怪的方塊來著？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well that is one fancy looking scroll but just looking at it makes my eyes hurt.
plugin_fields.target: 這卷軸看起來確實花裡胡哨的，但我光是瞥一眼就覺得眼睛要瞎了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Let's go and show that Alduin that he picked the wrong woman to mess with. Oh and you of course.
plugin_fields.target: 走吧，去讓奧杜因知道他惹錯了我。噢，當然還有你。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So... What did you see? So you know the Dragonrend shout huh? That should come in rather useful.
plugin_fields.target: 所以……你看到什麼了？你學會龍魂撕裂了？那可是個大殺器啊。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Wait a minute do you hear something? I think Alduin heard us.
plugin_fields.target: 等等，你聽見什麼動靜了嗎？我猜奧杜因已經聞著味兒找上門了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Damn it I thought we had him. Still I think he got the message and he left the fight so I guess that makes us the victors... kind of.
plugin_fields.target: 靠，我還以為咱們能當場做掉他呢。不過他既然夾著尾巴逃跑了，就算是我們贏了吧……勉強算。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: We'll get him though, he's just living on borrowed time.
plugin_fields.target: 別急，他的小命早晚是我們的，現在不過是苟延殘喘罷了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well that sounds like fun. I'm sure you'll have no trouble convincing the jarl to let you lure a dragon into his city,
plugin_fields.target: 聽起來簡直刺激過頭了。我相信憑你的三寸不爛之舌，說服領主同意你把一頭噴火的巨龍引進他的城市絕對不在話下，
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: potentially killing everyone or possibly ruining his beloved palace. I have faith in you though.
plugin_fields.target: 這頂多也就是會把所有人燒成灰，或者把他心愛的宮殿拆成廢墟而已嘛。我對你充滿了信心哦。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: A peace council huh? Well that sounds like it's going to be very peaceful with the Legion and the Stormcloaks.
plugin_fields.target: 和平會議是吧？跟帝國軍團和風暴斗篷在一起，聽起來可真是夠「和平」的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Let's hope war doesn't break out in High Hrothgar. Ah who am I kidding, I would love to see that,
plugin_fields.target: 祈禱他們別直接在高吼修道院打起來吧。哎呀我在騙誰呢，我簡直巴不得他們當場血拼，
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: especially when the Greybeards get angry and start Shouting.
plugin_fields.target: 特別是當灰髯士們暴走，開始一頓「龍吼」大殺四方的時候。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So that's settled then. I thought for a minute there was going to be some serious trouble. Never have I been so disappointed.
plugin_fields.target: 所以這就完事了？我還以為會惹出什麼大麻煩呢。我從來沒這麼失望過。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Oh well we still have a dragon to trap at Dragonsreach which should be a little more interesting.
plugin_fields.target: 算了，至少我們還要在龍臨堡抓一頭龍，這應該會更有趣一點。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well you caught the dragon. Now I guess you'll be heading to Sovngarde but luckily only as a guest and not as a permanent resident.
plugin_fields.target: 幹得漂亮，龍抓到了。看來你馬上就要去安息聖域旅遊了，值得慶幸的是你只是去串個門，而不是去那兒定居。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I guess I'll be staying behind but I wish you luck.
plugin_fields.target: 我估計我是沒法跟著沾光了，祝你好運吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Wow you beat Alduin the world eater himself. You have become legend, a true hero, people will talk about you for hundreds...
plugin_fields.target: 哇，你居然真的幹翻了世界吞噬者奧杜因。你現在可是活著的傳奇，貨真價實的英雄了，人們會傳頌你的事蹟好幾百年……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: if not thousands of years to come, and I did pretty much everything else so I guess they will also talk of me.
plugin_fields.target: 甚至幾千年。不過考慮到基本上所有髒活累活都是我包攬的，我猜後世肯定也少不了關於我的光輝事蹟。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Um... I don't suppose you would mind sticking around, with me I mean? I get kind of lonely out there and I see no reason for our adventure to end.
plugin_fields.target: 那個……你應該不介意繼續帶著我混吧？我是說，外面的世界那麼無聊，我也想不出什麼理由讓我們的冒險就此畫上句號。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw
Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; manually reviewed target

plugin_fields.source: What? Where am I? Ugh my head! Oh it's you! Uh I mean what? No I've never seen you before. I have no idea who you are.
plugin_fields.target: 什麼？我這是在哪兒？嘶我的頭！噢，是你！呃我是說……什麼？不，我絕對沒有見過你，我壓根就不認識你這號人物。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: It's not like I've been stalking you or anything.
plugin_fields.target: 我又沒有一直在跟蹤你什麼的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Um... OK. I have to go now.
plugin_fields.target: 嗯……好吧。我現在該走了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Wait! Don't leave!.. I'm injured... uh yes injured. You have to take me with you otherwise I might die and you wouldn't want that on your conscience.
plugin_fields.target: 等等！別走！……我受傷了……呃對，就是受傷了。你必須帶我一起走，不然我會死在這兒的，你忍心讓自己的良心受譴責嗎？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You look alright to me.
plugin_fields.target: 我看你精神挺好的嘛。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Yeah well that's because... OK fine, if you take me with you I will make it worth your while.
plugin_fields.target: 那還不是因為……行吧，只要你肯帶上我，我保證你絕對不吃虧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You won't find anyone tougher than me in Skyrim. Not to mention as good looking.
plugin_fields.target: 在天際你絕對找不到比我更能打的搭檔。更別提我這驚天動地的美貌了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You are quite modest then? Fine, welcome aboard.
plugin_fields.target: 你還真是夠謙虛的啊？行吧，歡迎入夥。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Haha, you are so funny. I'm just being honest and anyone who says otherwise is clearly jealous.
plugin_fields.target: 哈哈，你真逗。我這人向來只說實話，誰敢反駁那純粹是赤裸裸的嫉妒。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Can you name someone better than me? I didn't think so. Anyway thanks, I guess.
plugin_fields.target: 你能找出哪怕一個比我更出色的傢夥嗎？我看你找不出來。總之，謝了啊。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: OK, but you will be doing me a lot of favours in return.
plugin_fields.target: 好吧，但是你得給我很多的好處作為回報。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well, we will see about that. I could have you wrapped around my little finger in minutes. Either that or I could have your head as a trophy.
plugin_fields.target: 哼，咱們走著瞧吧。我動動小指頭分分鐘就能把你收拾得服服帖帖的。要不然，我也可以把你的腦袋當作戰利品。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Anyway thanks, I'll do what I can to help but don't push your luck.
plugin_fields.target: 不管怎樣，謝了。能幫的忙我會幫，但你也別得寸進尺。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I suppose I could use some backup.
plugin_fields.target: 我想我確實需要些支援。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Is that it? Aren't you going to flex your muscles and tell me how great you are? That seems to be the customary greeting in Skyrim.
plugin_fields.target: 這就完了？你難道不該稍微秀一秀肌肉，再吹噓一下自己有多厲害嗎？這可是天際人民標準的打招呼方式啊。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Anyway, there's no suppose about it. Everyone could use someone a little more like me.
plugin_fields.target: 不管怎樣，把「我想」去掉，這是板上釘釘的事。畢竟誰能拒絕一個像我這樣完美的搭檔呢。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: No, I don't do babysitting.
plugin_fields.target: 算了吧，我可沒空當保姆。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: What you really mean is that you don't like competition. Anyway fine, I get it. People do get a little jealous of me but I've come to accept it.
plugin_fields.target: 其實你就是怕我搶了你的風頭對吧。行吧行吧，我懂的。畢竟太出眾總是容易招人嫉妒，我也習慣了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: If you change your mind come and find me.
plugin_fields.target: 如果你改變主意了，隨時來找我。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So, if you are so tough and independent, why do you need my help?
plugin_fields.target: 所以說，如果你真的那麼強悍又獨立，那幹嘛還需要我的幫助？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I don't. I thought I would help you out.
plugin_fields.target: 我才不需要。我是覺得你比較需要我的幫助。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I didn't ask for any help though?
plugin_fields.target: 我有要求過你的幫助嗎？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well I was hoping you would kind of keep me company. Look I know it sounds weird but it's no fun on my own.
plugin_fields.target: 其實我是指望你能陪陪我。我知道這聽起來有點矯情，但我一個人真的快無聊死了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You can tell me to leave if you want but surely you can at least give me a chance?
plugin_fields.target: 你想趕我走就直說，不過你至少也該給我個表現的機會吧？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So why were you out on your own and why do you stink of booze?
plugin_fields.target: 所以為什麼你會孤身一人在這，而且還一身酒臭？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Am I not allowed out on my own now? I had a little too much to drink. So what? I guess I must have passed out.
plugin_fields.target: 怎麼，我現在連獨自出門的自由都沒有了？我不就是貪杯多喝了兩口嘛，那又怎樣？我大概是醉倒了吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I hope I didn't cause too much trouble. Actually I'm not really that bothered.
plugin_fields.target: 希望我沒惹出什麼大亂子。不過說實話，我也沒那麼在乎就是了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: What happened to your clothes?
plugin_fields.target: 你的衣服去哪了？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: What?! Ugh I have no idea. My memory is a little fuzzy. If you happen to have any I would appreciate it.
plugin_fields.target: 啥？！呃我怎麼知道。我斷片了。如果你碰巧有多餘的衣服，我會很感激。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Oh and stop staring at my body. It's like you've never seen a semi-naked woman before.
plugin_fields.target: 噢還有，把你那色眯眯的眼珠子從我身上挪開。搞得好像你這輩子沒見過半裸的女人似的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Are you alright?
plugin_fields.target: 你沒事吧？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Of course I'm alright. Don't start fussing over me, I'm more than capable of handling myself.
plugin_fields.target: 我當然沒事。別對我大驚小怪的，我完全有能力照顧好自己。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Where do you want me to take you?
plugin_fields.target: 你想讓我帶你去哪兒？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I don't know. I'll just go wherever you are going. I will repay your kindness by fighting alongside you. Surely that's an offer you can't refuse?
plugin_fields.target: 我怎麼知道。你上哪兒我就去哪兒。我會和你並肩作戰，以此來報答你的好意。這提議你肯定無法拒絕吧？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Oh, I haven't introduced myself have I? My name is Sofia but you probably already knew that.
plugin_fields.target: 噢，我還沒自我介紹是吧？我的名字是索菲亞，不過你可能早就知道了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'm quite well known in Skyrim, although sometimes I'm not sure it's for the right reasons.
plugin_fields.target: 我在天際這地界兒多少算個名人，雖說有時候我也不確定這名聲到底有多好聽就是了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I kind of see myself as an adventurer although it's no fun without anyone to witness my heroic deeds such as...
plugin_fields.target: 我大概算是個冒險家吧，不過如果沒人見證我的豐功偉績那也太無聊了，比如……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: well I'm sure there's probably something. I like to get drunk, kill stuff and be a nuisance. So what about you?
plugin_fields.target: 呃，我想大概還是有過那麼一兩件的吧。我平時就喜歡喝個爛醉，找人尋開心順便再砍兩個人。你呢？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: My name is <Alias=Player> and I am a fellow adventurer.
plugin_fields.target: 我的名字是 <Alias=Player> ，我是個同行冒險家。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Nice to meet you. I hope to be of some use to you. I am rather talented if I say so myself so I'm sure there must be something I can do for you.
plugin_fields.target: 幸會幸會。希望能幫上你的忙。不瞞你說我這人天資聰穎，我敢打賭總有派得上用場的地方。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Just let me know.
plugin_fields.target: 儘管吩咐。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: My name is <Alias=Player> and I am a stranger to Skryim.
plugin_fields.target: 我的名字是 <Alias=Player> ，對天際來說我還是個外鄉人。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well then it must be your lucky day as I know Skyrim like the back of my hand.
plugin_fields.target: 那今天一定是你的幸運日，因為我對天際瞭如指掌。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Of course I have many other talents so be sure to let me know if you need me.
plugin_fields.target: 當然啦，我別的本事也不少，有需要隨時知會一聲。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: The hero, the hero, has a warrior's heart.
plugin_fields.target: 蓋世英豪，壯志雄心。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I tell you, I tell you, the Dragonborn comes.
plugin_fields.target: 聽我詠唱，龍裔來臨。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: With a Voice wielding power and some ancient Nord art.
plugin_fields.target: 諾德古道，龍吼強音。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Believe, believe, the Dragonborn comes.
plugin_fields.target: 敬請堅信，龍裔來臨。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: It's an end to the evil, and everyone knows.
plugin_fields.target: 除惡天際，人盡皆知。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Beware, beware, the Dragonborn comes.
plugin_fields.target: 煩請牢記，龍裔來臨。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: For the darkness has passed, and the flowers yet grow.
plugin_fields.target: 黑暗已逝，繁花方興。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You'll know, You'll know the Dragonborn comes.
plugin_fields.target: 世人盡知，龍裔來臨。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So how about you sing for me?
plugin_fields.target: 你為我唱首歌怎麼樣？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Which song?
plugin_fields.target: 想聽哪首？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Dragonborn Comes
plugin_fields.target: 龍裔歸來
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Oh, I love that one!
plugin_fields.target: 噢，我喜歡那首！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'd love to sing for you.
plugin_fields.target: 很樂意為您獻唱。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: That's one of my favorites.
plugin_fields.target: 那是我的最愛之一。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Sure, why not?
plugin_fields.target: 何樂而不為？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Age Of The Dragon
plugin_fields.target: 巨龍時代
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: That's one of my favourites!
plugin_fields.target: 那是我的最愛之一！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'd love to sing for you.
plugin_fields.target: 很樂意為您獻唱。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Oh, I love that one!
plugin_fields.target: 噢，我喜歡那首！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Sure, why not?
plugin_fields.target: 何樂而不為？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Dovahkiin, Dovahkiin, everybody let's sing. I don't know all the words so I'm making them up.
plugin_fields.target: 都瓦克因，齊聲高唱。舊詞全忘，隨口成章。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: *singing* Dovahkiin, Dovahkiin *singing*
plugin_fields.target: *唱歌* 都瓦克因，都瓦克因 *唱歌*
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: We give drink to the youth, for years yet to come. For the age of the dragons is just about done.
plugin_fields.target: 舉杯歡飲，談笑朝夕。巨龍年代，行將平息。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: We'll drive out the people and not pay what we owe. With your blood and your money we'll send them back home.
plugin_fields.target: 驅除異族，不償舊賬。以汝血財，遣返異鄉。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Down with Alduin the big ugly beast. On the day of your death we'll drink and we'll feast.
plugin_fields.target: 誅奧杜因，巨醜孽畜！汝得暴斃，普天同慶。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: We're the people of Skyrim, and we fight for our lives. And when the dragonborn reckons, everybody must die!
plugin_fields.target: 天際兒女，為命相抗。龍裔清賬，俱化塵壤。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: But this land is mine so let's see it wiped clean. Of the dragons that ruined our hopes and our dreams.
plugin_fields.target: 斯土屬我，務滌其瘴。掃盡餘孽，故土重光。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Yes. I can use the back of my hand to transport you there if you like. It's much quicker than crawling your way back there on your hands and knees.
plugin_fields.target: 是啊。如果你願意的話，我可以用我的手背直接送你歸西。那可比你撅著屁股爬回去快多了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: What's that smell? Do you have animals on your farm? Oh no wait, it’s because you opened your mouth and started talking.
plugin_fields.target: 這是什麼味兒？你的農場裡養了牲口嗎？噢不對等等，原來是你剛才張嘴說話散發出來的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Oh, are you lost? Your wife knows the way to the Jarl's quarters very well apparently.
plugin_fields.target: 噢，你是迷路了嗎？我看你老婆倒是對領主大人的臥房熟門熟路得很嘛。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You should ask her the next time she says she's going to hoe around the farm.
plugin_fields.target: 下次她再跟你說她要去農場「鋤地」的時候，你最好仔細盤問一下她到底去「鋤」誰的「地」了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Yes, I was just talking to the Jarl actually. He did say he was missing his court jester.
plugin_fields.target: 巧了，我剛才正好在跟領主大人聊天呢。他確實提過他挺懷念他的宮廷小丑的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Your clothes are perfect by the way, but you need to work on your routine a little.
plugin_fields.target: 順便說一句，你這身行頭倒是非常符合小丑的氣質，只是你的業務水平還有待提高。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You should go to the temple and see a healer right away. It can't be healthy having your head stuck so far up your own backside.
plugin_fields.target: 你該立刻動身去神殿找個祭司看看腦子了。成天把自己的腦袋塞進自己屁股裡可不是什麼好習慣。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Sneaking is so much fun. The thrill of almost getting caught is more addictive than skooma... Oh right yeah now is not the time for talking.
plugin_fields.target: 潛行真是太刺激了。那種差點被逮個正著的緊張感簡直比斯庫瑪還讓人上癮……噢對了，現在不是閒聊的時候。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Ah the art of stealth. They'll either be dead or with significantly less gold before they know what's hit them... Oh sorry I need to be quiet.
plugin_fields.target: 啊，這就是潛行的藝術。那些傢夥甚至還沒搞清楚怎麼回事，要麼就已經丟了小命，要麼包裡的金幣就得少上一大截……噢抱歉，我得小聲點。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'm not sure I like the idea of crouching down behind you. If you dare let one go then you can forget me helping you. Why am I even talking.
plugin_fields.target: 我實在不怎麼喜歡像個傻子一樣蹲在你屁股後面。如果你敢放個響屁燻我，那你休想再讓我幫你打掩護。我到底在瞎嘀咕些什麼。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I hope you have a backup plan if we get caught.
plugin_fields.target: 萬一咱倆玩脫了被逮住，我希望你最好準備了後路。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I do love taking it from behind. Uh I mean taking people from behind... As in sneaking up on them of course... Sorry, I just can't keep my mouth shut.
plugin_fields.target: 我確實很喜歡在後面幹。呃，我是說，在背後幹掉別人……當然是潛行偷襲的意思。抱歉，我就是管不住我的嘴。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Why are you bothering me?
plugin_fields.target: 你幹嘛總纏著我？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Just go away will you!
plugin_fields.target: 你能不能死遠點！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You have no idea who I am do you?
plugin_fields.target: 你根本不知道我是誰，對吧？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So what? You found me. Am I supposed to be impressed?
plugin_fields.target: 那又怎樣？你找到我了，我是不是還得為你鼓個掌？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I don't suppose my voice sounds familiar to you?
plugin_fields.target: 你該不會覺得我的聲音很耳熟吧？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I don't suppose you know anyone called Christine do you? Nah didn't think so.
plugin_fields.target: 你應該不認識一個叫克里斯汀的女孩吧？我想你肯定不認識。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Uh did you want something?
plugin_fields.target: 呃，你有什麼事嗎？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Wait a minute. Don't I know you? I swear I've seen you before.
plugin_fields.target: 等一下。我難道不認識你嗎？我發誓我絕對在哪裡見過你。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well we did it. Let's go spend our gold on cheap booze and get drunk till we both do something we regret and pass out. Sounds like a plan.
plugin_fields.target: 幹得漂亮。咱們趕緊把這些金幣全砸在廉價的劣質酒上，喝得爛醉如泥，直到咱們兩個都幹出些不可告人的蠢事然後醉倒在街頭。這計劃堪稱完美。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So how should we spend our reward? What's that? You want to spend it all on me? How generous.
plugin_fields.target: 這筆豐厚的報酬咱們該怎麼揮霍呢？你說什麼？你打算把錢全花在我身上？你真是太大方了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Let's spend our reward in a way that would make even Sanguine, the Daedric Prince of debauchery, proud.
plugin_fields.target: 咱們一定要把這筆賞金花出水平，花得連掌管放蕩的魔神桑吉恩看了都要豎起大拇指。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: How about you let me look after that reward of ours? What? Don't you trust me? What about if I flutter my eyelashes?
plugin_fields.target: 這筆錢交給我來保管怎麼樣？幹嘛？你信不過我的人品嗎？那如果我對著你眨巴兩下水汪汪的大眼睛呢？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Shall we give some of our hard earned money to the poor? Nah, let's waste it all on mead.
plugin_fields.target: 咱們要不要把辛苦賺來的血汗錢施捨一點給窮人？算了吧，還是全拿去買蜂蜜酒更實在。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I guess now we won't have to listen to them whine about the mine. Hey, that rhymed.
plugin_fields.target: 總算不用聽他們抱怨這破礦，害得大家沒活幹只能四處閒逛。嘿，還挺押韻。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well now that mine is cleared for the miners that reward is mine. Get it… mine? OK it's ours really.
plugin_fields.target: 既然這座礦洞（mine）被清理乾淨了，那這筆賞金就是我的（mine）了。聽懂沒……mine？好啦，其實錢是咱倆的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I don't think there's a need for that!
plugin_fields.target: 我覺得那完全沒必要！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I don't have to take this from the likes of you.
plugin_fields.target: 我憑什麼要受你這種貨色的氣。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'll teach you to talk to me that way!
plugin_fields.target: 你居然敢這樣跟我說話！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I don't have to take that from you!
plugin_fields.target: 你竟敢對我這麼放肆！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well at least we get to kill someone. I never get tired of that.
plugin_fields.target: 至少咱們有架打了。殺人這事兒我永遠都不會膩。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Getting paid to kill people. That's my kind of work.
plugin_fields.target: 拿錢砍人。這才叫真正的專業對口。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Seriously? Out of all the bounties we had to get one involving a dragon!?
plugin_fields.target: 你在逗我嗎？那麼多輕鬆好賺的懸賞不接，非要接個跟巨龍過不去的活兒！？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I was hoping it wasn't going to be a giant we had to kill but the good thing is they are extremely dumb.
plugin_fields.target: 我本來還在祈禱對手千萬別是個巨人，不過好在這些傻大個兒的腦子不太靈光。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Just don't get hit unless you want to get a better look at the stars.
plugin_fields.target: 小心別被他的大棒子掃到，除非你想體驗一把上天看星星的感覺。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Wouldn't it be good if we could make money but without helping other people?
plugin_fields.target: 如果我們能站著把錢賺了，還不用去當什麼濫好人，豈不是美哉？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Tell me why we are doing such menial tasks again? Oh yeah so that I… I mean we can get drunk.
plugin_fields.target: 誰能提醒我一下我們為啥又要來幹這種苦力活？噢對了，這樣我……呃，我的意思是我們就能有錢買酒喝了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You would sell your own mother for a bit of cash wouldn't you? I don't blame you. I would sell my whole family if I had one.
plugin_fields.target: 為了這點臭錢你簡直連親媽都肯賣對不對？我倒是能理解。如果我全家都還活著的話，我也很樂意把他們打包賣個好價錢。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Damn it, now I'm starting to sound like that creep in Whiterun.
plugin_fields.target: 該死的，我現在說話的語氣簡直和白漫城那個雜貨鋪猥瑣男如出一轍。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You know I have found better ways to make quick money such as using my looks to play guys.
plugin_fields.target: 你知道嗎，我其實早就掌握了一條發家致富的捷徑，比如靠我的美色把男人們耍得團團轉。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: All it takes is sitting at a bar alone and you instantly get bought a free drink then once they are hooked you keep pushing for more.
plugin_fields.target: 操作起來非常簡單，只要找個酒館獨自坐下，馬上就會有冤大頭貼上來請你喝酒，一旦他們上鉤，你就狠狠地宰他們一筆。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I hate that pompous Redguard who wanders around Whiterun boasting.
plugin_fields.target: 我煩透了白漫城那個整天遊手好閒還滿嘴跑火車的紅衛暴發戶了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: If he mentions the cloud district one more time then I am going to get one of the vegetables from his farm and ram them up his...
plugin_fields.target: 如果他敢再跟我提一次「雲頂區」，我發誓絕對會去他的農場拔根蔬菜，狠狠地塞進他的……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: sorry I was going off on a rant again wasn't I?
plugin_fields.target: 抱歉，我好像又胡言亂語了是吧？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: That Belethor is such a creep. He said he would even buy me if I was looking to sell then he went on about selling his sister.
plugin_fields.target: 那個貝萊託爾真是個不折不扣的變態。他居然說如果我願意明碼標價他絕對會把我買下來，然後他又扯到他有多想把自己的親妹妹給賣了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: And people think I'm strange.
plugin_fields.target: 跟這種奇葩比起來，大家居然覺得我不正常。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: The Bannered Mare. That's funny, people usually call me the dozy mare.
plugin_fields.target: 戰旗母馬旅店。挺有意思的，反正大家都喜歡管我叫「迷糊的小母馬」。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I don't know why the Companions think they are so honourable.
plugin_fields.target: 我實在搞不懂戰友團的那幫傢夥哪來的臉標榜自己有多榮耀。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: They sent some hired thug to beat up some priest in the temple of Kynareth, as if a priest has ever posed a threat to anyone.
plugin_fields.target: 他們居然僱傭地痞流氓去把凱娜瑞絲神殿裡的祭司給揍了一頓，說得好像一個祭司能給誰造成多大威脅似的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: The Drunken Huntsman. I once tried hunting whilst drunk it was hilarious. I shot some wood elf in the bottom and he squealed like a skeever...
plugin_fields.target: 醉獵戶。我曾經也試過喝得酩酊大醉去打獵，那場面絕了。我一箭射中了一個木精靈的屁股，他嚎起來簡直像隻被踩了尾巴的惡鼠……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Oh no I think I just saw him.
plugin_fields.target: 哦不，我剛才好像看見那個倒霉蛋了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Have you seen that wimpy kid around Whiterun? Can you believe he gets picked on by a little girl.
plugin_fields.target: 你看見在白漫城裡到處亂跑的那個窩囊廢小孩沒？真不敢相信他居然被一個小丫頭給欺負了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I feel like joining in but I doubt his parents would be pleased.
plugin_fields.target: 我倒是挺想去湊湊熱鬧的，但我估計他爹媽不會樂意。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Have you seen that woman selling fruit at the market stall. Apparently all the men in Whiterun fancy her... she wishes...
plugin_fields.target: 你瞧見市場攤位上那個賣水果的女人了嗎。看樣子白漫城所有的男人都被她迷得神魂顛倒的……她做夢去吧……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: if that's true then the men of Whiterun must be desperate either that or she is selling more than just fruit and vegetables.
plugin_fields.target: 如果那是真的，那白漫城的男人絕對是飢不擇食了，要麼就是她賣的不止是水果和蔬菜。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: After a few drinks one night I couldn't pronounce my 'I's properly and they sounded more like 'A's.
plugin_fields.target: 有天晚上我喝多了，舌頭打結，把「眨眼（Wink）」給念成了「自慰（Wank）」。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I got a few strange looks when I started asking about the Winking Skeever.
plugin_fields.target: 結果當我滿大街打聽「自慰惡鼠」在哪兒時，路人都用看變態的眼神看著我。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I think the fletcher in Solitude is a bit wary of me after what happened when I asked to try out some of his arrows.
plugin_fields.target: 自從上次我提出想「試用」一下他店裡的幾支箭之後，我覺得獨孤城的那個製箭師現在看到我就像見了鬼一樣。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'm usually OK with a bow but accidents happen. I don't think he ever got over it.
plugin_fields.target: 我平時的箭法挺準的，但難免會有走火的時候嘛。我看那傢夥這輩子都走不出那個心理陰影了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I thought about joining the Imperials in Solitude but that General Tullius is so annoying.
plugin_fields.target: 我也曾考慮過跑去獨孤城投奔帝國軍，但那個圖利烏斯將軍實在是個大嘴巴惹人厭的傢夥。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Then again I also considered joining the Stormcloaks but couldn't stand Ulfric Stormcloak, so now I just hate both of them. Problem solved.
plugin_fields.target: 後來我又琢磨著是不是該加入風暴斗篷，結果發現我也一樣噁心烏弗瑞克那副做派。所以現在我兩邊都討厭。這就叫兩全其美。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I tried joining the Bards College. I thought bards were supposed to have a sense of humour but they just sit there reading books.
plugin_fields.target: 我本來想報考吟遊詩人學院的。我一直以為吟遊詩人都該是風流倜儻、幽默風趣的，但他們只會坐在那裡看書。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I can't believe what that guy made me do to join though. Oh no it's nothing like that...
plugin_fields.target: 最離譜的是為了加入學院那個傢夥居然讓我做那種事。噢別誤會，不是你想的那種潛規則……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: He wanted me to retrieve some dusty old relic from some forbidden cave.
plugin_fields.target: 他非要指派我去什麼陰森恐怖的古墓裡挖出幾張發黴的廢紙。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I just handed him an old book and they spent ages trying to decipher the nonsense that I wrote in it.
plugin_fields.target: 於是我隨便撿了本破書交差，現在那幫白痴還在為我隨手瞎寫的塗鴉爭論不休呢。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I went into the clothes shop ran by some snobby high elves in Solitude and they said that if I had to ask the price then I was in the wrong place...
plugin_fields.target: 我走進獨孤城裡那家由幾個眼高於頂的高精靈開的服裝店，結果她們居然嘲諷我說，如果買東西還要先問價，那這地方就不適合我……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: so I said with what you're wearing you must be in the wrong place and it's no wonder people don't ask the price. That shut them up.
plugin_fields.target: 於是我立馬回敬道：看你穿得這麼寒酸，這店肯定也不適合你，難怪客人都懶得問價了。這下她們徹底沒脾氣了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I don't get what is so special about Solitude. You walk in and see someone having their head chopped off, go into a shop and get insulted...
plugin_fields.target: 我真沒看出來獨孤城有啥了不起的。剛進城門就碰上斷頭臺的血腥戲碼，進個商店買東西還要被老闆一頓冷嘲熱諷……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: and get charged an extortionate rate for a house that you can only get for sucking up to a weak willed jarl...
plugin_fields.target: 買間房子還得被狠狠宰一筆，而且前提是你得先去舔那個毫無主見的領主的臭腳……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: who would probably pledge allegiance to whichever side happens to win the war.
plugin_fields.target: 我敢打包票，不管哪邊贏了戰爭，她大概都會向贏家宣誓效忠。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Ah the temple of Mara. If Mara is the goddess of love what does that make Dibella. I suppose the goddess of making love.
plugin_fields.target: 啊，瑪拉神殿。如果瑪拉是代表愛情的神明，那蒂貝拉算什麼？我想她應該是代表「做愛」的女神吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well I know which one I prefer.
plugin_fields.target: 毫無疑問，我知道我更中意哪位神明。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I could see myself quite enjoying being a member of the Thieves Guild.
plugin_fields.target: 我覺得如果能混進盜賊公會，我肯定能如魚得水。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: The only problem is I would be stealing from the poor and needy when I would want to be stealing from the rich and greedy.
plugin_fields.target: 唯一的顧慮是，我更樂意劫富濟貧，而不是去榨乾那些苦哈哈的窮鬼。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Have you noticed something creepy about that wimpy guy following that tough looking Nord girl everywhere. It reminds me of a stalker I once had.
plugin_fields.target: 你有沒有發現，那個母老虎一樣的諾德妹子身後，總是像狗皮膏藥一樣黏著一個唯唯諾諾的小白臉。這畫面不禁讓我想起了曾經纏著我的某個變態跟蹤狂。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Oh no you don't think I'm like that do you? You don't think people say that about us?
plugin_fields.target: 哦別多心，你該不會以為我跟那個跟蹤狂一樣吧？路人應該也不會拿這事來編排我們吧？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I best keep my bag close now that we are in Riften. Apparently it's the most corrupt and crime ridden place in Skyrim.
plugin_fields.target: 既然踏進了裂谷城的地界，我最好還是把錢袋捂緊點。誰不知道這是整個天際最腐敗、犯罪率最高的賊窩。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'm not scared of a few petty thieves though and they would soon regret messing with me.
plugin_fields.target: 不過我可沒把那幾個街頭扒手放在眼裡，他們要是敢把手伸向我，我保證他們會後悔來到這個世上。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I have the advantage of looking all cute and innocent but when I strike I am deadly.
plugin_fields.target: 畢竟我這張人畜無害的清純臉蛋就是最好的偽裝，但我下起死手來絕對不含糊。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'm so glad the old woman at the orphanage is finally dead. That hag had it coming, it was just a matter of time.
plugin_fields.target: 得知孤兒院那個老巫婆總算死透了，我簡直想放煙花慶祝。那老妖婆死有餘辜，這不過是遲早的事。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'm surprised there are no brothels in Riften. Not that I would ever need to visit one but apparently the way the owner of the bunk house...
plugin_fields.target: 這裂谷城裡居然連家正兒八經的青樓都沒有，真是讓我開了眼了。倒不是說我有這方面的需求，只是看那個大通鋪女老闆的做派……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Haelga I think she is called, with what she gets up to it would be the perfect place and a very beneficial business decision for her.
plugin_fields.target: 好像是叫哈爾嘉來著，就憑她平日裡搞的那些烏煙瘴氣的名堂，要是直接掛牌開張，絕對是穩賺不賠的買賣。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I don't get it. The old woman at the orphanage in Riften is a right troll and treats those children like scum yet they all say how much they love her
plugin_fields.target: 我是真搞不懂。裂谷城孤兒院那個老巫婆簡直像個醜巨魔，把孩子們當畜生一樣使喚，結果這幫小鬼居然還口口聲聲說有多愛她。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Maybe we could convince them to start a revolution. It's not like a load of kids couldn't overpower some frail old woman.
plugin_fields.target: 也許我們該給他們洗洗腦，教他們怎麼掀起一場暴動。我就不信一窩蜂的小孩還幹不過一個行將就木的老太婆。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw
