plugin_fields.source: Then maybe they could worship me instead.
plugin_fields.target: 到時候這幫小孩就能擁立我為新的女王了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: When someone told me about the Pawned Prawn in Riften I thought it was some kind of sleazy shop where people go to buy... naughty things.
plugin_fields.target: 當有人跟我提起裂谷城的「典當小蝦」時，我還以為那是某種烏煙瘴氣的暗巷鋪子，專門賣些……「蝦作」的東西。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I was rather disappointed.
plugin_fields.target: 結果逛完之後我大失所望。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You don't think the dwarves disappeared because their own inventions considered them obsolete and turned against them.
plugin_fields.target: 你難道不覺得矮人的消失，是因為他們造出來的機器嫌棄主人太落後，從而集體造反了嗎？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I've heard some nasty stories about old dwemer ruins. Or maybe they discovered some alternate universe.
plugin_fields.target: 關於這些古老的鍛莫遺蹟，我可是聽過不少聳人聽聞的傳說。或者……也許他們真的集體穿越到了另一個平行宇宙？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Woah you can really feel the vibrations through the floor from all that machinery. It feels kind of good actually.
plugin_fields.target: 哇哦，你甚至能透過地板真切地感受到那些機械傳來的震動。說實話，這感覺還挺酥麻的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: If I had that kind of skill and knowledge I would create my own little device to use on myself. I would call it a vibrator.
plugin_fields.target: 要是我也有那種巧奪天工的技術和知識，我絕對要給自己量身訂製個專屬的「小玩具」。我會給它起名叫「震動棒」。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: It would only be used to massage my back of course.
plugin_fields.target: 當然啦，那東西僅限用來給我按摩後背而已。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Sometimes I think the Dwemer anticipated our arrival. Why else would they make this place such a death trap?
plugin_fields.target: 有時候我真覺得鍛莫早就預料到我們會闖進來。不然他們吃飽了撐的，把這地方設計成這麼一個步步殺機的死亡陷阱？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: It's not surprising the Dwemer are no longer among us with such dangerous underground cities.
plugin_fields.target: 住在這麼危機四伏的地下城裡，鍛莫落得個滅族的下場也就不奇怪了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Surely they must have set off a lot of traps on themselves. They are almost impossible to avoid.
plugin_fields.target: 我敢打包票，他們平時肯定沒少被自己設的陷阱坑死。這玩意兒簡直防不勝防。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Why are these old ruins built out of stone? And why are they so big? So many questions and no one to answer them.
plugin_fields.target: 為什麼這些古遺蹟全都是用石頭砌的？為什麼非得造得這麼宏偉？真是謎團重重，可惜連個能喘氣兒的解答者都沒有。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Why is everything that attacks us here made out of metal? How does that work anyway? Last time I checked metal wasn't capable of intelligent thought,
plugin_fields.target: 怎麼這兒冒出來攻擊我們的怪物全都是鐵疙瘩？這玩意兒到底是怎麼驅動的？據我所知，金屬可沒長腦子，更別提什麼獨立思考了，
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: or any thought for that matter. I wonder if I used the same metal for a sword whether it would start walking on its own.
plugin_fields.target: 或者說它壓根就不會思考。我琢磨著，如果我用同樣的金屬打製一把劍，它會不會自己長腿跑了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Surely the point of draugrs is that they are dead. So why do they start randomly attacking people?
plugin_fields.target: 按理說，屍鬼的最大特徵就是「已經死透了」。那他們怎麼還能跟瘋狗似的到處咬人？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Why would the dead not be dead? It makes my head hurt.
plugin_fields.target: 死人為什麼不安息？這邏輯真是想得我腦仁疼。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I don't understand why in these tombs all the torches are lit. I thought they were supposed to be abandoned for centuries.
plugin_fields.target: 我是真搞不懂，為什麼這些古墓裡的火把都還亮著？它們不是早就荒廢了好幾百年了嗎。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I guess it's one of life's mysteries.
plugin_fields.target: 我猜這大概也是天際的未解之謎之一吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Do you suppose the draugr are angry because we disturb their sleep. I know how they feel. I would also be pretty angry.
plugin_fields.target: 你覺得屍鬼發這麼大火，是不是因為我們攪了他們的清夢？我太懂這種起床氣了，換作是我，我也絕對會暴走的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Ah, the smell of death and rotting flesh. Is it weird that I kind of like it?
plugin_fields.target: 啊，這死亡和腐肉交織的曼妙氣息。我是不是有點變態，我居然還挺喜歡這味兒的？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I wonder if the draugr still have their bits and pieces tucked away somewhere if you know what I mean. If not then I feel very sorry for them.
plugin_fields.target: 不知道那些屍鬼有沒有把身上那些「零碎部件」好好保管起來，你懂我的意思吧？要是弄丟了，那我真是要為他們掬一把同情淚了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I would be pretty annoyed too if I looked like the draugr. I hope I don't die and end up looking like one of them. That would be my worst nightmare.
plugin_fields.target: 如果我長得跟屍鬼一副德行，我也會整天看誰都不爽的。希望我死後可千萬別變成那副鬼樣子，那絕對是我最深惡痛絕的噩夢。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I wouldn't want to work in a mine. Too much physical activity in the dark. Although I can think of one physical activity I like to do in the dark.
plugin_fields.target: 我才不想在礦坑裡幹活。在黑燈瞎火的地方幹體力活也太折騰人了。不過嘛，我倒是能想到一種我很樂意在「黑燈瞎火」裡幹的「體力活」。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You know we could make a bit of money by mining some ore. What? You don't think I would stoop that low as to do peasant work.
plugin_fields.target: 你知道嗎，我們隨便挖點礦石就能撈一筆。怎麼了？你該不會以為我會自降身價去幹這種泥腿子的粗活吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So how about you go and mine us some ore... What?
plugin_fields.target: 所以，不如你去替我們挖點礦……你瞪我幹嘛？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: This place is filthy. There's dirt everywhere. Well of course there is we're in a mine. Still, I don't like to get dirty. Well not that kind anyway.
plugin_fields.target: 這鬼地方真是髒透了。灰塵滿天飛。廢話，畢竟這是在礦坑裡。但我就是討厭弄得渾身髒兮兮的。至少，不是這種髒法。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: It's funny, I've been called a gold digger before yet I have never dug up any gold in my entire life. And people wonder why I get so confused.
plugin_fields.target: 說來好笑，以前總有人罵我是「拜金女」，可我這輩子連個金礦都沒拜過。大家居然還不明白我為什麼總是一臉懵逼。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I once asked the owner of a mine how big his shaft was. He seemed quite embarrassed by it, I'm not sure why.
plugin_fields.target: 有次我問一個礦主，他的「豎井」有多大。他聽完一臉便秘的表情，我是真搞不懂為什麼。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I've been in enough mines to know what they look like. He did seem a little confused though.
plugin_fields.target: 我下過的礦坑也不少了，什麼奇形怪狀的沒見過。他看起來倒是挺困惑的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Isn't it funny how the miners never seem to mind strangers just walking in and mining all their ore?
plugin_fields.target: 你不覺得很搞笑嗎，那些礦工居然完全不在意陌生人隨便闖進來，當著他們的面把礦石全挖走？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I bet you have explored a few damp, dark caves in your time. What? I didn't mean anything by it. I also like exploring caves from time to time.
plugin_fields.target: 我打賭你這輩子肯定沒少「探索」過那些又溼又暗的「幽深洞穴」吧。怎麼？我沒別的意思啊。我也經常「探索洞穴」來著。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I hope there aren't any bears or spiders in this cave. Nearly every cave I go in is full of undesirable things.
plugin_fields.target: 希望這洞裡別再冒出什麼熊或者大蜘蛛了。幾乎我進過的每一個洞穴，裡面塞滿的都是讓人掃興的玩意兒。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I would watch out if I were you. I once went into a cave and nearly got hit by a giant rock falling from the ceiling.
plugin_fields.target: 換作是我，我絕對會打起十二分精神。有次我進洞探險，差點被頭頂砸下來的巨石砸成肉餅。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: People seemed a little disappointed when I told them it missed.
plugin_fields.target: 後來當我把這事兒告訴別人，說我僥倖逃生時，他們居然還一臉失望。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Have you ever tried living in a cave? I have. It's not the most comfortable way of living but you won't find anywhere more private,
plugin_fields.target: 你體驗過住在山洞裡的日子嗎？我就體驗過。雖然談不上多舒坦，但除了正兒八經的房子，
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: well except a house of course. And unlike tents, you can give it a few homely touches.
plugin_fields.target: 你絕對找不到比它更隱秘的住所了。而且比起帳篷，你還能把山洞稍微佈置得有點家的溫馨感。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You would think it would be quite hard to see inside a dark cave but apparently not.
plugin_fields.target: 你可能會以為在黑黢黢的山洞裡什麼都看不見，但顯然並不是這麼回事。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Have you ever tried shouting inside a large cave? I once had a whole conversation with myself inside a cave.
plugin_fields.target: 你試過在空曠的山洞裡大喊大叫嗎？我曾經就在山洞裡跟自己的回聲聊了整整半天。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: When I said hello, my voice would say hello back. The conversation did get a bit repetitive after a while though.
plugin_fields.target: 我說「你好」，回聲也回我一句「你好」。不過聊久了，對話內容難免就變得有些鬼畜迴圈了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Markarth is a strange place, apparently built by dwarves.
plugin_fields.target: 馬卡斯城真是個奇葩的地方，一猜就知道是出自矮人之手。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Imagine where we would be today if they were still around inventing their amazing contraptions.
plugin_fields.target: 你想像一下，要是這幫矮人還在沒日沒夜地搗鼓他們那些黑科技機器，我們現在的生活得變成什麼樣。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I would have some weird metal servant to do all my dirty work such as cleaning and killing people, the usual.
plugin_fields.target: 我絕對要搞個金屬奴隸來幫我包攬所有髒活累活，比如打掃衛生和殺人這種尋常瑣事。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Did you know that the beds in Markarth are made out of stone? No wonder the people here are so miserable. They must have serious back problems.
plugin_fields.target: 你知道馬卡斯城的床全是用石頭鑿的嗎？難怪這兒的居民成天一副苦大仇深的樣子，這睡久了絕對會得腰椎間盤突出的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Do you really think this city is as safe as they say it is? If the Forsworn can attack inside the walls then it can't be all that safe.
plugin_fields.target: 你真信這城有他們吹得那麼固若金湯？既然棄誓者都能在城牆眼皮子底下發動襲擊，那所謂的安全根本就是個笑話。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: The guards trying to cover things up doesn't exactly give me much confidence either.
plugin_fields.target: 再加上那幫守衛成天忙著粉飾太平，更是讓人心裡沒底。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'd best be on my best behaviour here as Cidhna mine is supposed to be the most brutal prison in all of Skyrim.
plugin_fields.target: 我在這裡最好夾著尾巴做人，畢竟希訥礦坑可是號稱全天際最慘無人道的監獄。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: There is a whole dwarven city under Markarth. I wonder what happened to the dwarves. Maybe they were just too intelligent for their own good,
plugin_fields.target: 馬卡斯城底下居然埋著一座龐大的矮人都市。真好奇這幫矮人到底遭遇了什麼。沒準是因為他們聰明反被聰明誤，
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: which is more than you can say about some of the people I've come across... not you of course.
plugin_fields.target: 這就遠不是我遇到過的某些腦殘能比的了……當然，我說的不是你。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: There's something that makes me a little uneasy about some of the merchants here.
plugin_fields.target: 這兒的某些商販總讓我覺得渾身不自在。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: They seem to look at me like I'm a piece of meat and I'm not talking about the way people usually look at me.
plugin_fields.target: 他們盯著我的眼神，就像是在盯著一塊砧板上的肉。而且這可不是男人看美女的那種眼神。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I think we should pay a visit to the temple of Dibella. There is no way they would turn down a beauty such as mine.
plugin_fields.target: 我覺得咱們有必要去蒂貝拉神殿朝拜一下。像我這等絕色佳人，她們肯定敞開大門熱烈歡迎。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I wonder what really goes on there in private? You don't suppose it's some kind of secret brothel do you?
plugin_fields.target: 我很好奇她們關起門來到底都在幹些什麼勾當？你該不會以為那是什麼打著神殿幌子的地下青樓吧？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well I'm so glad I came all this way in the freezing cold just to visit some town that has collapsed into the sea.
plugin_fields.target: 太棒了，我簡直感激涕零，大老遠冒著風雪跑過來，就為了參觀一個大半截都塌進海里的鎮子。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Ok well I suppose there is the college and the most important thing of all, somewhere to get a drink.
plugin_fields.target: 好吧，至少這兒還有個法師學院，以及最重要的——有酒館能讓我買醉。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: It's not often I say this but I feel sorry for the woman that runs the shop here.
plugin_fields.target: 這話我很少說，但我真的挺同情在這兒開店的那個女老闆的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I mean there are no guys here at all unless you count the strange elves in the tavern which I certainly don't.
plugin_fields.target: 你看看，這鎮上連個像樣的男人都找不到，除非你把旅店裡那幾個奇形怪狀的精靈也算進去，反正我是絕對不會把他們當男人的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Do you believe the stories about the College destroying the city of Winterhold?
plugin_fields.target: 你相信那些關於「冬堡學院引發大塌陷毀了整座城」的鬼話嗎？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Trust me, I've been to the College and they are so inept that they could barely destroy a sweetroll, let alone a city.
plugin_fields.target: 相信我，我在學院裡待過，憑他們實力連捏碎個甜捲都費勁，更別提毀滅一座城了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I wonder if that grumpy old orc who works here has a copy of The Lusty Argonian Maid. Do you think I should ask him to see his reaction?
plugin_fields.target: 我敢打賭在這兒管圖書館的那個暴躁老獸人，私底下絕對偷偷藏了本《活力充沛的阿爾貢人女僕》。你說我要是當面問他借，他會是什麼表情？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'm almost tempted to rearrange some of the library books here to annoy that orc. He has quite a temper though so I am a bit wary.
plugin_fields.target: 我這手癢得都快忍不住想去把圖書館的書全弄亂，好氣死那個老獸人。不過他那暴脾氣確實有點唬人，我還是得收斂點。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: There's something not right about a Khajiit and a Nord being mages here at the College, and what's with the orc.
plugin_fields.target: 凱季特人和諾德人居然也能在學院裡當法師，這畫風怎麼看怎麼詭異，還有那個獸人是怎麼回事。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Now we just need an Argonian to complete the full set of misfits. Okay I may have studied here but I had no other choice.
plugin_fields.target: 現在我們只差再來個阿爾貢人，就能組成一個不靠譜奇葩法師組合了。好吧，我承認我以前也是這兒的學生，但我那是被逼無奈。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Ah, this place brings back memories. I spent ages working on my own unique spell.
plugin_fields.target: 啊，故地重遊總是讓人感慨萬千。當年我為了鑽研那套獨門絕技，可是嘔心瀝血耗費了無數光陰。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: The reason I got kicked out was because I used it to make everyone naked. I don't think anyone appreciated my true genius.
plugin_fields.target: 結果我被掃地出門的唯一原因，居然是因為我用那招把全校師生都剝光了。這幫凡夫俗子根本不懂欣賞我真正的才華。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Why did the Riverwood chicken cross the road? So if it accidentally got hit the carriage driver would get a five gold bounty,
plugin_fields.target: 為什麼河木鎮的雞老是喜歡在馬路上橫衝直撞？因為這樣一旦馬車伕不小心撞死了它，身上就會背上5個金幣的懸賞，
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: and the town would form an angry mob, chase down the carriage driver and proceed to killing him anyway.
plugin_fields.target: 然後全鎮的人就會瞬間化身暴民，抄起傢夥追著馬車伕砍，直到把他亂棍打死為止。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Seriously though, the people of Skyrim are a bit touchy about their livestock.
plugin_fields.target: 不開玩笑，天際的刁民們對他們的家禽確實護短得有些病態了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: The Sleeping Giant Inn. A word of advice: don't get hit by a giant. I've seen people launched a hundred feet in the air.
plugin_fields.target: 沉睡巨人旅店。聽我一句勸：千萬別被巨人打到。我親眼看著有個倒霉蛋被他們一棒子送上了百尺高空。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I don't even know how that is possible but it's true, I've seen it.
plugin_fields.target: 我都不知道這到底是怎麼做到的，但這是千真萬確的，我親眼所見。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'm sorry but I refuse to believe that anyone would be fighting over that Camilla what's her name in the Riverwood Trader.
plugin_fields.target: 恕我直言，打死我也不信真的會有人為了河木鎮貿易商行裡那個叫什麼凱米拉的村姑爭風吃醋。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You would have to be death, dumb and blind or a serious danger to the public to fancy her.
plugin_fields.target: 除非你是又瞎又聾的殘障人士，或者乾脆就是個反人類的瘋子，否則誰會看上她啊。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: There once was a hero named Ragnar the red who came riding to Whiterun from old Rorikstead.
plugin_fields.target: 「天際有豪俠，紅衣拉格納。身是洛鎮人，走馬上白漫。」
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Oh sorry that tune is stuck in my head now after visiting this place.
plugin_fields.target: 噢抱歉，只要一踏進這鬼地方，這調調就在我腦子裡揮之不去了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Rorikstead. Oh yeah that's right I met someone who was so desperate to get away from here that he stole a horse and got caught by the Imperials.
plugin_fields.target: 洛利克鎮。噢對了，我以前認識個傢夥，他為了逃離這個鳥不拉屎的地方，不惜去偷馬，結果當場被帝國軍逮個正著。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: It's funny because I stole the other horse and got away with it.
plugin_fields.target: 搞笑的是，當時我也偷了另一匹馬，結果我就全身而退了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: It's pretty sad when the only noteworthy thing in this place is a prize winning goat called Gleda. I'm sure if Skyrim had a competition for beauty,
plugin_fields.target: 一個地方最出名的竟然是一隻叫「格麗達」的獲獎母山羊，這鎮子是有多可悲。我敢打包票，如果天際要舉辦一場選美大賽，
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I would easily win first prize although hopefully I have something better to contend with than a goat.
plugin_fields.target: 我絕對能輕鬆奪魁。當然，我可不希望我的選美對手只是一隻羊。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Can you believe the Greybeards get some poor guy to walk all the way up High Hrothgar to deliver them food that they are too lazy to fetch themselves
plugin_fields.target: 你敢信嗎，那群灰髯士自己懶得下山拿補給，居然使喚個倒霉蛋辛辛苦苦爬幾千級臺階送飯上門。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: They can't even be paying him as they just sit on their lazy backsides all day praying or whatever it is they do.
plugin_fields.target: 而且那幫老傢夥整天就知道懶洋洋地癱坐在那兒祈禱，或者不管他們在幹嘛，反正肯定付不起他錢。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I hope you didn't come here to climb the 7000 steps. I think you will be dragging my lifeless body back down again,
plugin_fields.target: 我拜託你來這兒可千萬別是為了去爬那該死的七千級臺階。否則等下山的時候，你大概只能扛著我冰冷的屍體回去了，
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: if my legs even manage to carry me to the top.
plugin_fields.target: 前提是我這雙腿真能撐著我爬到山頂的話。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I wonder if there are actually any real ghosts at the nearby barrow? Can you believe people get scared of such things? I'm not scared of anything.
plugin_fields.target: 你猜附近的古墳裡會不會真有什麼鬼魂在遊蕩？你能相信人們會被這種東西嚇到嗎？我什麼都不怕。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Do you know what rhymes with Morthal? Awful, which is exactly what this place is. Who would want to live in a swamp anyway?
plugin_fields.target: 你知道什麼詞和墨索爾（Morthal）押韻嗎？糟糕透頂（Awful），這詞簡直就是為這地方量身定做的。到底哪個腦殘會想不開住在一片爛泥地裡？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: This place is kind of eerie looking don't you think? I almost expect to be attacked by werewolfs and vampires if I hang around here too long.
plugin_fields.target: 你不覺得這地方透著一股子邪門嗎？我要是在這兒多待上一會兒，簡直都做好了隨時被狼人或者吸血鬼撲倒咬斷脖子的準備了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Who in their right mind would think to set up a town in a swamp that is in the middle of nowhere? The people here are a bit strange though.
plugin_fields.target: 哪個腦子正常的人會選在荒郊野外的沼澤溝裡建鎮子？不過話說回來，這鎮子上的居民看著也挺不正常的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'm not really surprised this place has given people nightmares. If I had to live here I would also be a little bit traumatised.
plugin_fields.target: 這地方居然能讓人做噩夢，我是一點也不覺得奇怪。要換作是我住這兒，我也得落下一些的心理創傷。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: It's not the worst place though but it's not exactly the best either.
plugin_fields.target: 不過它雖然算不上墊底，但也絕對跟好地方沾不上半點邊。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: The museum of Dawnstar is just some crazy guy's house with a few bits of old junk laying around. It seems anything will pass as a museum these days.
plugin_fields.target: 晨星那所謂的博物館，不過就是個瘋老頭的屋子裡堆了幾件廢銅爛鐵而已。看來這年頭隨便什麼垃圾堆都能自封為博物館了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I think I should set up my own museum. The museum of Sofia where people can pay to look at my um...  underwear.
plugin_fields.target: 我覺得我大可以自己開個博物館。就叫索菲亞紀念館，大家買門票進來排隊瞻仰我的……呃，原味內衣。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Yes it might sound crazy but the amount of guys that ask me that is surprising. It can't be any worse than the one currently in Dawnstar.
plugin_fields.target: 我知道這聽起來很瘋狂，但這世上求著向我買原味內衣的男人數量絕對能嚇死你。它肯定不會比現在晨星的那個差。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: How do you feel about all the racist Nords in Windhelm? Whilst I agree we shouldn't be encouraging these elves into Skyrim, bullying isn't the answer,
plugin_fields.target: 你對風舵城裡那群搞種族歧視的諾德人怎麼看？雖說我也同意我們不該鼓勵這些精靈進入天際，但霸凌絕不是解決辦法，
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: and confining them to a slum with an insulting name is just going to cause civil unrest. But what do I know?
plugin_fields.target: 把他們像圈養牲口一樣關在名字充滿侮辱性的貧民窟裡，遲早會逼得他們造反。不過我懂什麼呢？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I don't know why anyone would want to live here. It's so cold that it makes Whiterun seem like a tropical paradise.
plugin_fields.target: 我真搞不懂為什麼會有人甘願在風舵城安家。這鬼地方冷得簡直能把白漫城襯託成一座熱帶天堂了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Not to mention the people here seem very bitter.
plugin_fields.target: 更別提住在這兒的刁民一個個看起來都滿臉苦大仇深的樣子了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: At the College of Winterhold there was a mage. Who got sent away after causing a rage.
plugin_fields.target: 冬堡學院有術姝，惹起眾怒被驅逐。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: She demonstrated her spell, but to no avail. It lead the brave woman to the stables on a haybale.
plugin_fields.target: 空呈妙法無人睹，巾幗流落臥馬鋪。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Then came a warrior who disturbed her rest. But accepted her presence for the upcoming quests.
plugin_fields.target: 壯士驚夢擾眠宿，結為同伴赴征途。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: They travelled together and met friend and foe. And word spread around about the legendary duo.
plugin_fields.target: 並肩歷劫友與敵，雙英傳奇滿江湖。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: They killed dragons and bandits, Forsworn, even bears. Travelled through Skyrim and walked Hrothgar's stairs.
plugin_fields.target: 屠龍斬叛獵灰熊，踏遍天際登高步。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: And all of this started with a silly funny spell. But lead to adventures soon everyone will tell.
plugin_fields.target: 一切皆因荒唐術，傳世奇談從此書。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: The Legendary Duo
plugin_fields.target: 傳奇二人組
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: A song that I wrote myself.
plugin_fields.target: 這是我自己創作的一首歌。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'd love to sing for you.
plugin_fields.target: 很樂意為您獻唱。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Oh, I love that one!
plugin_fields.target: 噢，我喜歡那首！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: That's one of my favorites.
plugin_fields.target: 那是我的最愛之一。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Sure, why not?
plugin_fields.target: 何樂而不為？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So what do you know about Whiterun?
plugin_fields.target: 關於白漫城，你知道些什麼？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Hmm... Well there's Jorrvaskr where the posers go to show off but start crying because they spilt their mead.
plugin_fields.target: 呃……好吧，比如勇士之家，那幫裝腔作勢的傢夥整天在那兒賣弄肌肉，結果一不小心灑了杯裡的蜂蜜酒就只會哭爹喊娘。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Then there's Dragonsreach the Jarls palace which is full of pretentious fools,
plugin_fields.target: 再就是龍臨堡，領主大人的金窩，裡面擠滿了自命不凡的蠢貨。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: some place called the drunken huntsman which is kind of misleading as there are no drunken huntsmen in there,
plugin_fields.target: 有個叫「醉獵戶」的店，名字純粹是虛假宣傳，因為裡面根本就找不到一個喝醉的獵人，
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: and some other places not worth a mention. Most importantly though there is an inn.
plugin_fields.target: 還有其他一些壓根不值一提的地方。不過最重要的是，這兒還有一家旅店。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: By produce I assume you mean your body.
plugin_fields.target: 說到做生意，我猜你賣的其實是自己的身體吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: To your bed more like.
plugin_fields.target: 倒不如說是去你的床上更貼切。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: No, we will visit a brothel if we want something cheap.
plugin_fields.target: 不勞費心了，如果我們想找點「廉價」的樂子，我們自己會去逛窯子的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Do the brothels know about you stealing their customers?
plugin_fields.target: 妓院老鴇知道你在搶她們生意嗎？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Tell me about the people in Whiterun.
plugin_fields.target: 給我講講白漫城裡的人吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well there are not enough bad words to describe Nazeem, who is lucky to still be alive.
plugin_fields.target: 世上的髒話都不足以用來形容納齊姆那個混蛋的惡劣，他真的應該慶幸自己還活著。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Then there's that kid Braith who thinks she can get away with anything but forgets that one day she will grow up.
plugin_fields.target: 還有個叫布賴絲的熊孩子，真以為自己小就可以為所欲為，她顯然忘了熊孩子遲早有一天也會長大的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: The annoying preacher that nobody listens to.
plugin_fields.target: 那個煩人的傳教士，根本沒人聽他嘮叨。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Also some slime ball called Belethor who runs the general store and frequently sells his family members to the lowest bidder.
plugin_fields.target: 哦對了，雜貨鋪裡還有個叫貝萊託爾的卑鄙小人，這孫子為了錢絕對幹得出把親戚論斤賤賣的勾當。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Then there's the alchemy woman who has pronounced me dead several times to flog her overpriced wares,
plugin_fields.target: 再就是那個賣鍊金藥水的，為了推銷她那些天價藥水，她都不知道把我「咒死」多少回了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: and some cheap tart at the market who sells her body to every man in Whiterun. Did I miss anyone?
plugin_fields.target: 最後就是市場裡那個廉價的騷貨，白漫城裡是個男人估計都沾過她的葷腥。我還漏了誰沒有？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Get away from me.
plugin_fields.target: 離我遠點。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I don't have to take this from the likes of you.
plugin_fields.target: 我憑什麼要受你這種貨色的氣。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'll teach you to talk to me that way!
plugin_fields.target: 你居然敢這樣跟我說話！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I don't have to take that from you!
plugin_fields.target: 你竟敢對我這麼放肆！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Give it another eight years or so and we will see who is afraid.
plugin_fields.target: 你給我等個十年八年的，到時候咱們再看看誰怕誰。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: If you were a little older or I was your parent I would give you such a beating.
plugin_fields.target: 你要是再大一點，或者乾脆我是你媽，我非得把你屁股打開花不可。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: If I had a child I would get them to knock every single one of your teeth out.
plugin_fields.target: 要是我有孩子，我絕對會指使他們把你滿嘴的牙一顆不剩全敲掉。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I don't have to take this from the likes of you.
plugin_fields.target: 我憑什麼要受你這種貨色的氣。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'll teach you to talk to me that way!
plugin_fields.target: 你居然敢這樣跟我說話！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I don't have to take that from you!
plugin_fields.target: 你竟敢對我這麼放肆！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Hey, get out of here!
plugin_fields.target: 嘿，滾開！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I have something for you.
plugin_fields.target: 我有東西要給你。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Oh, what is it?
plugin_fields.target: 喔，怎麼了嗎？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: That's very thoughtful of you.
plugin_fields.target: 你真是有心了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I could get used to this.
plugin_fields.target: 那我可真要習慣了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You seriously expect me to use this?
plugin_fields.target: 你該不會真指望我用這個吧？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Where did you find this heap of junk?
plugin_fields.target: 你究竟是從哪個垃圾堆裡把這坨破銅爛鐵刨出來的？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Am I supposed to be grateful?
plugin_fields.target: 我是不是還應該對你感恩戴德？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: This thing couldn't cut butter.
plugin_fields.target: 這玩意兒連黃油都切不開。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well I expected better but I suppose this will do.
plugin_fields.target: 我本以為你能拿出點更好的貨色，不過算了，湊合著用吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Uh... Thanks... I think?
plugin_fields.target: 呃……謝了……大概？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Is this really all you think I'm worth?
plugin_fields.target: 難道我在你眼裡就只值這麼點？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well aren't you generous.
plugin_fields.target: 你可真是「大方」啊。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: What's the polite way of saying thanks but this gift is complete cow dung?
plugin_fields.target: 該怎麼禮貌地對你說「謝謝，但這禮物完全就是一坨牛糞」？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I would be more likely to get a better gift from Belethor.
plugin_fields.target: 就算是從那個貝萊託爾手裡，估計我能拿到的禮物都比你這強。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Woah nice! I think I'm starting to like you.
plugin_fields.target: 哇太棒了！我想我開始喜歡你了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You can be sure I will put this to good use.
plugin_fields.target: 放心吧，我絕對會物盡其用的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So you really do care about me.
plugin_fields.target: 看來你是真心疼我嘛。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I shall do plenty of killing with this.
plugin_fields.target: 我絕對要拿這寶貝殺個痛快。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: How did you know I like expensive things? Oh yes, because I'm a woman.
plugin_fields.target: 你怎麼知道我喜歡這些貴重的小玩意兒？廢話，因為我是個女人嘛。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Oh wow, I do like shiny things.
plugin_fields.target: 噢哇哦，我就好閃閃發光這口。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I shall treasure this forever, or until I'm bored with it.
plugin_fields.target: 我發誓我會永遠珍藏它——或者至少珍藏到我玩膩了為止。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Nice! So what's tomorrow's gift then?
plugin_fields.target: 太棒了！那明天你打算送我什麼？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So what were you doing before you met me?
plugin_fields.target: 在遇見我之前你都在幹什麼？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I was playing two guys against each other in a bid to win me over. Of course they had to supply me with plenty of drink and earn my affection.
plugin_fields.target: 我故意讓兩個男的為了我爭風吃醋。當然啦，他們得掏空腰包給我買足夠多的好酒來討我的歡心。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I just wanted some entertainment. Oh it was great watching them get more and more competitive. It ended up in a massive brawl and once it was over,
plugin_fields.target: 我只是想找點樂子而已。噢，看著他們像兩條瘋狗一樣越爭越兇，簡直太好玩了。最後這事兒直接演變成了一場酒館大亂鬥，等風波平息之後，
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I left them both empty handed and out of pocket. As for waking up in a stable without any clothes on...
plugin_fields.target: 我拍拍屁股走人，留他們兩個人財兩空。至於後來我為什麼會光著身子在馬廄裡醒過來……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I don't remember what happened after leaving the tavern, but that's nothing new.
plugin_fields.target: 從離開酒館之後的事我全都斷片了，不過這也沒什麼稀奇的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: No, I mean before that.
plugin_fields.target: 不，我是說在那之前。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well I was wandering around Skyrim killing bandits who thought I was an easy target and meeting new locals or should I say making new enemies.
plugin_fields.target: 也沒幹什麼，也就是在天際四處晃悠，順手宰掉幾個覺得我是軟柿子的不長眼的強盜，然後去各個地方結識點新人——或者準確點說，到處樹點新敵。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Before that I was studying, if you can call it that, at the College of Winterhold. It wasn't my first choice of course being a Nord but
plugin_fields.target: 在那之前我其實還在冬堡學院「深造」過一陣子，如果那也算深造的話。當然，作為一個諾德人，當法師絕對不是我的首選，但
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I had no place to go and it was either that or live in a cave. So I learnt a few spells just to keep them happy.
plugin_fields.target: 當時我窮得走投無路，不躲進那兒就只能去睡山洞了。為了糊弄那幫導師，我勉為其難地學了幾個法術。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I must admit though that learning to blow stuff up was pretty fun. Unfortunately my genius was wasted on them,
plugin_fields.target: 不過我必須承認，學著怎麼把東西炸上天確實挺帶感的。只可惜我驚世駭俗的天賦用在他們身上完全是暴殄天物，
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: and I was kicked out for making everyone naked with a spell I forced some other student to create for me.
plugin_fields.target: 後來我被掃地出門了。原因是我威逼某個倒霉學生替我搗鼓出了一個「爆衣法術」，然後我把整個學院的人全剝光了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So it turns out I ended up living mostly in caves anyway.
plugin_fields.target: 兜兜轉轉，我最後大部分時間還是淪落到去睡山洞了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Have you ever thought you are perhaps a bit mean?
plugin_fields.target: 你有沒有想過也許你有點刻薄？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Are you trying to say that I'm evil or that I should try being a bit nicer to people?
plugin_fields.target: 你這是在拐彎抹角地罵我惡毒，還是在教訓我以後對別人好點？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I think you should change your evil ways.
plugin_fields.target: 我覺得你應該改改你那些惡劣的行徑。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: What are you, some kind of priest? I wouldn't say I'm evil. Perhaps I take things a bit too far sometimes. But I never said I was good.
plugin_fields.target: 你以為你是誰，神殿的祭司嗎？我倒不覺得自己有多邪惡。也許我有時候確實有點玩過火，但我也從沒標榜過自己是個好人。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I didn't think you were like other people.
plugin_fields.target: 我還以為你和其他人不一樣呢。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I think perhaps you could be a little nicer and not upset others.
plugin_fields.target: 我想也許你可以友善一點，別總惹別人生氣。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Where's the fun in that. I won't change for anyone. You can like it or lump it. Just be glad you aren't one of my victims.
plugin_fields.target: 那樣還有什麼樂趣可言？我不會為任何人改變。不管你喜不喜歡，都得給我受著。你應該慶幸自己不是我的受害者。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Let's just try and keep it that way or you could just leave. Actually no don't do that.
plugin_fields.target: 所以咱們最好井水不犯河水，不然你隨時可以離開。哎等等，你還是別走了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: No, I like to see people suffer.
plugin_fields.target: 不，我就喜歡看別人受折磨。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I think suffer is a bit of a strong word. There's a difference between the occasional nasty prank and blood sport,
plugin_fields.target: 用「折磨」這個詞也太上綱上線了。偶爾搞個惡劣的惡作劇，和那種血腥的殺戮遊戲可是兩碼事，
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: than just pure hatred and enjoyment in watching the pain of others.
plugin_fields.target: 這可不等於純粹為了滿足變態的私慾而去欣賞別人的痛苦。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You uh... look nice.
plugin_fields.target: 你……呃……長得挺好看。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'll assume you don't mean friendly. Look I barely know you so don't try anything on with me.
plugin_fields.target: 我就當你說的「友好」不只是字面意思。聽著，咱倆還沒熟到那份上，別想趁機佔我便宜。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I know. What can I say? It must be so hard for other people being so inferior to me.
plugin_fields.target: 我懂的。我還能說什麼呢？身邊有我這麼一個光芒四射的存在，其他人活得一定很自卑吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Please tell me that wasn't a chat up line. Look, I've heard it all before.
plugin_fields.target: 請告訴我你剛才不是在搭訕。聽著，這套說辭我早就聽膩了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: If you really want to impress me then it's going to cost you a lot in blood and gold. I'm not cheap you know.
plugin_fields.target: 如果你真想引起我的注意，那你恐怕得下血本了。我的身價可不低。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You seem like a funny person.
plugin_fields.target: 你看起來似乎是個挺逗的人。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You mean like weird? Huh, I thought you were different from all those other people who make fun of me
plugin_fields.target: 你是想說「奇葩」對吧？哼，我還以為你和那些只知道取笑我的人有什麼不同呢，
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: because I don't try and conform to people's ridiculous ideals.
plugin_fields.target: 就因為我不去迎合別人那些荒謬的標準。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: No, I mean you have a great sense of humour.
plugin_fields.target: 不，我是說你的幽默感很棒。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Yeah, I suppose. Being a free spirit like myself really lets you explore the world and see all its flaws but yet at the same time makes you appreciate them.
plugin_fields.target: 我想也是。像我這樣無拘無束地四處闖蕩，不僅能看透這個世界千瘡百孔的陰暗面，同時也能讓你學會去接納這些不完美。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: That's what some people who aren't like you just don't get.
plugin_fields.target: 這境界可不是那些庸俗之輩能體會得到的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: That's not such a bad thing. It makes you different.
plugin_fields.target: 這也不是什麼壞事。它能讓你與眾不同。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You think so. Everyone in Skyrim is like an exact replica of each other. Always bragging about themselves saying how beautiful or tough they are.
plugin_fields.target: 你真這麼想？天際的人簡直就像是一個模子裡刻出來的複製品。成天只會吹噓自己長得多俊、拳頭多硬。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I would never do that. Yes, ok I know what you're thinking but in my case it is actually true. Some people really do kid themselves.
plugin_fields.target: 我絕不會做出那種事。行，我知道你心裡在想什麼，但我說這些可是句句屬實啊。有些人真的是在自欺欺人。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Yes. I hate to break it to you.
plugin_fields.target: 沒錯，雖然我不想打擊你。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well, you are obviously just jealous of me. Either that, or you are just joking around. Anyway why would I want to impress you?
plugin_fields.target: 拉倒吧，你顯然是在嫉妒我。要不然，你就是在跟我扯淡。再說了，我幹嘛非得要你刮目相看不可？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I don't care what you think.
plugin_fields.target: 我壓根不在乎你是怎麼想的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: The sun has set, the dark appeared. Another cave, that was uncleared.
plugin_fields.target: 殘陽已盡夜蒼蒼，古洞幽深待人闖。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: A torch was lit, weapon sheathed. But she didn't know, when it was needed.
plugin_fields.target: 火把初燃刃未揚，不知何處用鋒芒。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: She walked right in, in a steady pace. It was one of those other days
plugin_fields.target: 緩步從容向裡行，渾如往昔舊時光。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: When a cave was her home. The cave was her home.
plugin_fields.target: 洞為棲所身所藏，幽幽古洞是吾鄉。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: To keep her warm the booze was near. And made place for joy instead of fear.
plugin_fields.target: 濁酒在旁禦寒涼，換取歡欣忘悲惶。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Another night to overcome. In a cave that was her home.
plugin_fields.target: 一宵長夜終須往，幽幽古洞是吾鄉。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: The cave was her home.
plugin_fields.target: 幽幽古洞是吾鄉。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: The Cave Was Her Home
plugin_fields.target: 洞穴為家
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Oh, I love that one!
plugin_fields.target: 噢，我喜歡那首！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'd love to sing for you.
plugin_fields.target: 很樂意為您獻唱。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: That's one my favorites.
plugin_fields.target: 那是我的最愛之一。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Sure, why not?
plugin_fields.target: 何樂而不為？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I need you to do something.
plugin_fields.target: 我需要你做些事。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: OK.
plugin_fields.target: 沒問題。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You got it.
plugin_fields.target: 包在我身上。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'll get right on it.
plugin_fields.target: 我馬上去辦。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: No problem.
plugin_fields.target: 沒問題。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I can do that.
plugin_fields.target: 沒問題。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Is that all?
plugin_fields.target: 就這樣？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Yes.
plugin_fields.target: 是的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Always glad to help.
plugin_fields.target: 很樂意效勞。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Just leave it to me.
plugin_fields.target: 交給我好了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Will you quit being so drunk!
plugin_fields.target: 你能別老是喝得爛醉如泥嗎！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw
Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; manually reviewed target

plugin_fields.source: Finally! I thought she was never going to let us in.
plugin_fields.target: 謝天謝地！我還以為她打算讓我們在橋上喝一輩子西北風呢。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So you're joining the College to become a mage? I guess I could use a mage.
plugin_fields.target: 所以你加入學院是為了當法師？我猜我確實缺個法師幫手。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I can be the muscle and beauty and you can be the wise wizard who incinerates anyone who opposes us.
plugin_fields.target: 以後我負責貌美如花和武力輸出，你就在後面當個充滿智慧的法師，誰敢惹我們你就一把火把他燒成灰。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: If you try any mind tricks or any other funny business on me though then you will find that you will be missing your magic stick,
plugin_fields.target: 但醜話說在前頭，你要是敢用魔法催眠我，或者對我動什麼歪腦筋，小心你這輩子都別想再見到你的「魔杖」了，
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: and you will no longer be able to conjure up any children. Do I make myself clear?
plugin_fields.target: 讓你這輩子都別想再「召喚」出任何小孩子來。聽明白了嗎？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Wow, this College tour is so interesting *yawn*.
plugin_fields.target: 哇哦，這學院觀光遊可真是讓人「有趣」啊 *打哈欠*。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I think I'll sit this lesson out. Good luck with your fancy spell casting.
plugin_fields.target: 這課我就不上了。祝你變戲法順利吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I wonder what we will find in Saarthal. Hopefully there are some ancient relics, excluding Tolfdir of course.
plugin_fields.target: 真好奇這薩瑟爾城裡能挖出什麼寶貝。希望能扒出幾件值錢的老古董，當然，托夫迪爾這種老古董除外。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Oh no, we're trapped! What should we do? What if we get trapped in here forever!? Don't you turn cannibal on me.
plugin_fields.target: 噢不，我們被困住了！該怎麼辦？要是我們永遠被困在這裡怎麼辦！？你可別餓得把我當人肉給啃了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: OK, maybe I shouldn't have panicked so soon.
plugin_fields.target: 好吧，看來是我瞎緊張了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So you're having funny visions that nobody else can see? Don't tell me you're starting to go crazy.
plugin_fields.target: 所以你剛才產生幻覺，看見了只有你能看見的東西？別告訴我你這就開始發瘋了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I feel as though I should say something but what is there to say about a big shiny ball? It means some work for us though,
plugin_fields.target: 感覺這氣氛我應該發點什麼高論，但是面對這麼個發光的巨大圓球我能說什麼？這下算是又攬到麻煩差事了，
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: as we always end up as someone's courier. I suppose at least we finally get to see the arch-mage that we hear so much about but never actually see.
plugin_fields.target: 畢竟我們這輩子就是給別人當跑腿的命。不過往好處想，這回總算能見到那個傳說中神龍見首不見尾的首席法師了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Oh no, not the orc. You can't even talk to that guy without getting a lecture.
plugin_fields.target: 噢不，別去找那個獸人。跟他搭句話還得先聽一頓說教。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I might have known. Why is nothing ever simple in life?
plugin_fields.target: 我早該猜到的。這世界上為什麼就沒有一件事是能順順利利辦完的？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: We go to the library to take out a book and instead end up having to chase down a group of rogue mages. I don't see anyone else having this trouble.
plugin_fields.target: 我們去圖書館借本書，結果卻變成要去追捕一群叛逃法師。我沒見別人遇到過這種麻煩。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Are those vampires? What kind of experiments are they doing here?
plugin_fields.target: 那些是吸血鬼嗎？他們到底在這裡搞什麼實驗？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So this is Orthorn. Well I guess he got what he deserved.
plugin_fields.target: 原來這傢夥就是奧拓恩。落得這步田地，純屬他咎由自取。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So do you think we should let him rot for his stupidity or do you think we should let him out?
plugin_fields.target: 你是打算讓他為自己的愚蠢付出代價在這兒爛掉，還是覺得咱們應該把他放出來？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well you're certainly a more charitable soul than myself but I can see how he could benefit us if we make him help us.
plugin_fields.target: 行吧，你絕對比我心地善良得多，不過留著這條命讓他給咱們當免費的打手，這筆買賣倒也不虧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I don't know, maybe I do feel a little sorry for the guy. Not a lot but a little.
plugin_fields.target: 我也不知道，也許我確實有一丟丟同情這倒霉蛋吧。就只有一丟丟。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: What kind of name is The Caller? More like the name caller as she certainly doesn't look capable of much else to me.
plugin_fields.target: 「召喚者」這算哪門子破名字？我看叫她「罵街者」更貼切，畢竟除了隔著老遠打嘴砲，我看她那副德行也搞不出什麼名堂來。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well that was a tough fight. Not! Anyway do you have the books?
plugin_fields.target: 這仗打得可真夠慘烈的。才怪！書拿到了沒？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Then let's get back to the jolly orc at the College and let him give us another one of his charming speeches.
plugin_fields.target: 趕緊拿去給學院裡那個「和顏悅色」的獸人交差吧，免不了又要聽他來段「動聽的演講」了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: A Psijic monk? I guess that means you're not crazy after all, although I don't get why he just left without saying a word.
plugin_fields.target: 賽伊克教團的修士？看來你之前沒發瘋。不過我不明白他怎麼一言不發就走了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Anyway, I would keep an eye on that Ancano, he seems to be stalking you an awful lot and needless to say the Thalmor cannot be trusted.
plugin_fields.target: 總之，你最好提防著點那個安卡諾，那傢夥總像個陰魂不散的變態一樣盯著你。梭默的狗腿子向來都沒安好心。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well the Augur of Dunlain looked less hideous than I thought he would look. I guess it falls to us to save the world once again.
plugin_fields.target: 這個占卜師杜蘭長得倒沒我想像中那麼磕磣。看來拯救世界的重任又要落在我們肩上了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: What in Oblivion is that strange contraption and what is with these monks?
plugin_fields.target: 湮滅在上，那個稀奇古怪的玩意兒究竟是什麼鬼東西？這幫修士又是從哪兒冒出來的？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: That guy is crazy. After all this effort it better be in Labyrinthian, otherwise I'm going to start charging the College for our services.
plugin_fields.target: 那傢夥絕對是瘋了。咱們被折騰了這麼久，那法杖最好真在迷城裡，否則我絕對要找學院結清咱們的勞務費。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: That Ancano... I always said there wasn't something right about him and it just goes to show that you should never trust the Thalmor.
plugin_fields.target: 那個安卡諾……我就說他不太對勁，這剛好證明瞭你永遠都不該相信梭默。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: If we don't stop him then we really will be at the mercy of the Thalmor and they will have power beyond our control.
plugin_fields.target: 要是讓他得逞，咱們就全得看梭默的臉色了，他手裡捏著的可是能讓所有人都完蛋的力量。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: We can't trust the College to do anything about it so I guess yet again it falls down to us.
plugin_fields.target: 指望學院去阻止他簡直是天方夜譚，看來這事兒又落回咱們頭上了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: The arch-mage is dead. I guess we should feel sad but I feel happy because I know that since there is no arch-mage,
plugin_fields.target: 首席法師死了。我想我們應該感到難過，但我其實挺高興的，因為既然現在沒有首席法師了，
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: and the rest of the College are not exactly fit for the role, once we defeat Ancano they will begging for your leadership.
plugin_fields.target: 學院剩下的那些人也不太適合這個位子，一旦我們擊敗了安卡諾，他們絕對會求著你來領導他們。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: And of course I can help out a little.
plugin_fields.target: 當然啦，我也可以稍微幫你「分擔」點。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: This place is strange. First some strange apparitions, now some creepy voice coming from nowhere and it doesn't sound amused.
plugin_fields.target: 這地方太詭異了。先是冒出些奇奇怪怪的幻影，現在又是這不知從哪兒傳來的鬼聲音。聽起來它挺不爽的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You just killed a dragon priest and the stupid Thalmor thought they could take you down with one guy.
plugin_fields.target: 你連活了上千年的龍祭司都能宰了，那幫蠢鈍如豬的梭默居然以為隨便派個蝦兵蟹將就能了結你。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I thought they were supposed to be intellectually superior, or so they would have you believe.
plugin_fields.target: 他們不是成天吹噓自己智力超群嗎，怎麼幹出來的事這麼沒腦子。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Things are looking bad, let's hope we're not too late.
plugin_fields.target: 情況不容樂觀，希望咱們沒有來太遲。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So this is the Staff of Magnus huh? I guess since it's so powerful and you have it, that must make you the most powerful mage there is.
plugin_fields.target: 這就是傳說中的瑪格努斯之杖？這玩意兒這麼逆天，現在又落到了你的手裡，這下你絕對是天下第一法師了吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I wonder what kind of power we could wield if we did happen to use it with the Eye. I suppose it depends on whether world domination is your thing.
plugin_fields.target: 如果拿它和瑪格努斯之眼一起用，天知道能釋放出什麼力量。不過，這得看你對「統治世界」感不感興趣了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Will the Thalmor ever learn?
plugin_fields.target: 梭默是不見棺材不掉淚嗎？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well now since we run this place I think it's time to dish out some ridiculously harsh and unfair rules for all the College students just for fun.
plugin_fields.target: 好極了，既然現在這地方歸我們管了，我覺得是時候擬定一堆慘無人道的霸王條款來好好折磨一下那幫學生了，純粹是為了好玩。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Yes I did say we, you don't think I would go through all that trouble just so I could be treated like a common student.
plugin_fields.target: 沒錯，我說的是「咱們」。你該不會以為我費這麼大勁，最後就甘心混成個普通學徒吧？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You can have the fancy robes though as they look better on you and magic's not really my thing.
plugin_fields.target: 至於那件華麗的長袍你還是留著自己穿吧，因為穿在你身上更合適，而且我對研究那些枯燥的魔法也沒多大興趣。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So you want to be a Companion? I guess it's quite a noble role to play and follows the proud traditions of my ancestors,
plugin_fields.target: 所以你想加入戰友團？聽起來是個挺高尚的行當，也是延續我祖先光榮傳統的正道，
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: but let's just hope they don't take this honour thing too seriously, especially since being honourable is not something I'm known for.
plugin_fields.target: 但願他們別太把「榮耀」這兩個字當回事，畢竟我這人可從來沒和「高尚」沾過邊。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well I'd hoped for a better welcome than this, but as much as I hate to say it,
plugin_fields.target: 本來我還指望能有個隆重點的歡迎儀式呢。但不得不說，
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Nords aren't always the most welcoming of people and it's as good a welcome as I usually get.
plugin_fields.target: 諾德人向來不懂什麼叫熱情好客。不過這已經算是我能得到的最好待遇了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Get my sword sharpened, deliver this shield! I know most people have to work their way up from the bottom but the servants get treated better than us.
plugin_fields.target: 「去把我的劍磨鋒利點」、「把這塊盾牌送過去」！我知道新人得從底層做起，但這也太使喚人了吧，連個雜役的待遇都比我們強。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I think Vilkas is a bit upset though about not being able to handle a beating from you.
plugin_fields.target: 不過我看威爾卡斯心裡挺不爽的，畢竟他在較量中被你單方面暴揍了一頓。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Great! Finally we get to do what you signed up for: beating someone senseless.
plugin_fields.target: 太棒了！終於能幹你想乾的事了：找個倒霉蛋狠揍一頓。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: It's a shame we can't kill them, but maybe they don't deserve it, and we've always got the bandits for practice.
plugin_fields.target: 不能下死手真是有點掃興，不過這些人罪不至死。再說了，咱們大可以拿強盜來練手嘛。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Now's our chance to prove ourselves and make the other Companions look bad in comparison. Let's do this.
plugin_fields.target: 是時候露兩手讓他們開開眼了，順便把其他戰友團成員都比下去。咱們上吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I hope this Farkas guy can handle himself. I don't really want to have to babysit him,
plugin_fields.target: 希望法卡斯這傢夥別是個拖油瓶。我可沒興趣給他當老媽子，
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: just so the Companions don't get angry at us for not protecting him if he dies.
plugin_fields.target: 省得他要是死了，戰友團那幫人因為我們沒保護好他而跟我們發火。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: That was intense. I don't think I have ever seen so many draugr come out of nowhere and just totally outnumber us.
plugin_fields.target: 剛才可真是驚險刺激。我這輩子都沒見過這麼多屍鬼不知從哪兒突然冒出來，直接在數量上壓倒了我們。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Anyway I think we have earned ourselves some mead.
plugin_fields.target: 不管怎麼說，我覺得我們該喝杯蜜酒犒勞下自己了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Skjor wants to meet you at some secret hideout when it's dark? Sounds exciting but if there's one thing you should have learned by now,
plugin_fields.target: 斯科約爾約你天黑後在秘密基地碰頭？這聽起來挺刺激的。但我必須提醒你一個至理名言：
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: it's never to trust a Nord when it's dark. Actually that might just be me.
plugin_fields.target: 「天黑之後，永遠別相信任何一個諾德人」。其實可能也就只有我不能信。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Woah! That was you? You're a werewolf now, that's amazing! I wonder if the other Companions approve of this. Ah, who cares,
plugin_fields.target: 哇哦！剛才那是你？你現在竟然變成了一個狼人，這簡直酷斃了！不知道其他戰友團的人要是知道會怎麼想。哎呀管他呢，
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: we could really put your power to some use. Oh and you're naked, you might want to put something on... or not, I don't mind.
plugin_fields.target: 咱們這下真能好好利用一下你的這份力量了。噢，還有，你現在光著呢……不過穿不穿隨你，我倒是不介意。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Oh, Skjor is dead. I actually quite liked him. He was the only companion to give us... well, you, a true gift.
plugin_fields.target: 噢，斯科約爾居然戰死了。其實我還挺喜歡他的。他是戰友團裡唯一一個給了我們……呃，給了你，一份真正大禮的人。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I suppose we should also be thankful to Aela but she seems a bit too full of herself to me. Ooh look at me I'm so tough and pretty. Ugh!
plugin_fields.target: 我想我們也應該感謝艾拉，但在我看來她實在太自負了。「噢你們快看看我，我不僅身手不凡還是個大美女呢！」嘔！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Being a werewolf is the only thing she has going for her.
plugin_fields.target: 能變身狼人，大概是她身上唯一能拿得出手的優點了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I wonder what the Silver Hand have against werewolves. Anyway I suppose if we want to avenge Skjor and protect your new gift,
plugin_fields.target: 真不知道白銀之手跟狼人到底有什麼深仇大恨。不管怎樣，既然咱們要為斯科約爾報仇，同時還要守住你這份新的天賦，
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: we will have to take them all out.
plugin_fields.target: 那咱們就只能將他們斬草除根了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So Kodlak wants you to kill some witches who gave the companions a curse which in actual fact is a blessing. There's no pleasing people.
plugin_fields.target: 所以克拉科想讓你去滅了那幾個女巫，就因為她們賜予了戰友團一種在咱們看來明明是祝福的「詛咒」？這些人還真是永遠滿足不了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: That will teach those old hags. Now we better hurry back and hope Kodlak has a generous reward for us.
plugin_fields.target: 這就叫給那些老妖婆一點顏色瞧瞧。現在咱們最好麻溜地趕回去，祈禱克拉科那老頭能給咱們備上一份厚禮。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: What's going on? Did the Silver Hand actually work up the courage to attack after we gave them such a good thrashing? I hope everyone's okay.
plugin_fields.target: 這是什麼情況？被咱們揍得屁滾尿流之後，白銀之手居然還敢不要命地殺上門來？希望大家都平安無事。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw
