plugin_fields.source: Actually, I'm not that bothered. I find most of the Companions quite rude and arrogant, and they clearly don't recognise talent when they see it.
plugin_fields.target: 說實話，我其實沒那麼擔心。戰友團那幫傢夥大都粗魯又狂妄，而且最要命的是他們完全是有眼不識泰山，根本不懂得賞識我的才華。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Kodlak's dead. Oh how terrible. OK I may seem a little harsh but this works in our favour,
plugin_fields.target: 克拉科死了。哎呀這可真是太「不幸」了。好吧，我這話聽起來可能有些沒心沒肺，但這其實是天賜良機啊。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: because now their leader is dead we may be able to sway the vote for the next leader or harbinger or whatever they like to call it.
plugin_fields.target: 他們現在群龍無首了，咱們正好可以趁機左右一下選舉，決定誰來當那個什麼勞什子領袖、先驅，或者隨便他們叫什麼都行。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well, time to finish those Silver Hand once and for all.
plugin_fields.target: 好了，是時候把白銀之手的餘孽徹底解決了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Sorry, I always get emotional at funerals. Actually I've never been to one and I don't care that Kodlak is dead.
plugin_fields.target: 抱歉，一參加葬禮我就忍不住掉眼淚。其實我以前從來沒參加過這玩意兒，而且我也根本不在乎克拉科的死活。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I just never get the chance to have a good cry without looking like a total weirdo and this place is so depressing.
plugin_fields.target: 我只是單純地想找個理由痛痛快快地哭一場，而不用被人當成神經病看待，這裡的氛圍實在是太壓抑了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Wow, Wuuthrad, the legendary weapon wielded by Ysgramor himself. I think we should keep it for ourselves.
plugin_fields.target: 哇哦，精靈屠戮者！伊斯格拉謨本人揮舞過的傳奇戰斧。依我看，咱們直接把它昧下來當私有財產吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: At the very least it would make a magnificent trophy.
plugin_fields.target: 退一萬步說，把它掛在牆上當戰利品也絕對拉風。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Great, now remember to reclaim Wuuthrad for yourself once you are done. I'm sure Ysgramor won't be missing it now.
plugin_fields.target: 棒極了，記得完事後要把精靈屠戮者拿回來據為己有。我敢保證伊斯格拉謨肯定不會再惦記它了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: OK, so Kodlak goes to Sovngarde and lives happily ever after, we get to lead the Companions which gives us a reputation amongst the warriors of Skyrim,
plugin_fields.target: 行了，現在克拉科如願以償去了安息聖域過他幸福的鬼日子，咱們則順理成章地接管了戰友團，這絕對能讓咱們在天際的勇士們中名聲大噪。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: everyone's a winner. I wonder what our next big adventure will be.
plugin_fields.target: 皆大歡喜的結局。我都有點迫不及待想知道咱們的下一場大冒險是什麼了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Wedding Test...
plugin_fields.target: 婚禮測試……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Running Wedding Test!
plugin_fields.target: 執行婚禮功能測試！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So let us begin. Do you... uh sorry I've forgotten your name... whatever. Do you take this woman, Sofia to be your wife?
plugin_fields.target: 讓我們開始吧。你願意……呃抱歉我把你的名字給忘了……不管了。你願意娶這位名叫索菲亞的女士作為你的合法妻子嗎？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I do.
plugin_fields.target: 我願意。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You do? Really!? You may wish to reconsider? Well okay, rather you than me.
plugin_fields.target: 你願意？沒開玩笑吧！？你真不再慎重考慮一下了？好吧，反正是你娶她又不是我。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: No.
plugin_fields.target: 不。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Thank goodness for that. You've finally seen sense. I wouldn't even be here if it wasn't for the gold I was promised. You do have it right?
plugin_fields.target: 謝天謝地，你總算是恢復理智了。要不是看在那些承諾給我的金幣的份上，我才懶得站在這兒瞎湊熱鬧呢。錢你帶夠了對吧？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: What!? You are just going to stand me up like that and make me feel like an idiot!? OK well fine! You had your chance and blew it!
plugin_fields.target: 什麼！？你就打算這樣當眾放我鴿子，把我當成個傻子一樣耍是嗎！？行，算你狠！機會給你了，是你自己搞砸了！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'll be going now to find myself some proper company!
plugin_fields.target: 我這就走，去給自己找個更體面的伴侶！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Oh, and remember to pay the priest. I said you would pay him 1000 gold to do this special ceremony.
plugin_fields.target: 噢對了，記得把祭司的出場費給結了。我可是替你答應過，辦完這場特別的儀式要付給他1000金幣的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So about my payment?
plugin_fields.target: 所以，之前說好的錢呢？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well I guess it falls down to you then to pay me. Don't tell me you are having regrets already?
plugin_fields.target: 那看來這筆錢只能由你來付了。別告訴我你現在反悔了？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Ugh fine. Here just take the money. (Pay 1000 gold)
plugin_fields.target: 啊行吧。錢拿去。（支付1000金幣）
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'll just be taking that now to buy some... uh I mean to donate to the temple... yes that's what I meant. Goodbye.
plugin_fields.target: 那這筆錢我就勉為其難地收下了，剛好可以拿去買點……呃，我是說捐給神殿做慈善……沒錯就是這樣。後會無期。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: This is between you and Sofia.
plugin_fields.target: 這是你和索菲亞之間的事情。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: What!? Damn it. I knew it was too good to be true. How did I ever get talked into this?
plugin_fields.target: 你沒錢！？靠。我就知道天上掉餡餅準沒好事。我當時是怎麼鬼迷心竅接下這破差事的？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Fine well may Mara punish you for eternity in the depths of Oblivion.
plugin_fields.target: 行吧，那就願瑪拉在湮滅深淵的盡頭永世懲罰你。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'm sorry but I don't have enough money.
plugin_fields.target: 很抱歉，我的錢不夠。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Why does that not surprise me. It seems to be a common occurrence around anyone that has the misfortune to spend time with her.
plugin_fields.target: 果然不出我所料。任何倒霉催的和她扯上關係的人，似乎最後都免不了落得個人財兩空的下場。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Ugh fine. Here just take the money. (Not enough money)
plugin_fields.target: 啊行吧。錢拿去。（金錢不足）
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: This isn't enough money! Bah! She's got to you already. Well enjoy your life of poverty, as every septim you earn will be taken by her.
plugin_fields.target: 這點錢根本不夠！呸！看你這窮酸樣，估計早被她給榨乾了。那就好好享受你下半輩子的貧苦生活吧，你掙的每一枚金幣遲早都會被她吸個精光。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: And do you, Sofia, promise to give up alcohol?
plugin_fields.target: 那麼你，索菲亞，你發誓從此戒酒嗎？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I d... Hey! Nice try.
plugin_fields.target: 我發……嘿！少來套路我。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I know you are still upset after I made you spend all your gold on buying me drinks and threw up on your best clothes but you need to get over it.
plugin_fields.target: 我知道你還在為我硬逼著你花光所有積蓄請我喝酒、還吐了你一身最體面的衣服而耿耿於懷，但事情都過去了，你就別計較啦。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Right, well, do you, Sofia, take... uh... this man to be your husband?
plugin_fields.target: 那好吧。你，索菲亞，願意……呃……讓這位男士成為你的丈夫嗎？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Right well do you, Sofia, take... uh... this woman to be your wife?
plugin_fields.target: 那好吧。你，索菲亞，願意……呃……讓這位女士成為你的妻子嗎？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: No.
plugin_fields.target: 不。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You what?
plugin_fields.target: 你說什麼？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Just kidding.
plugin_fields.target: 開個玩笑而已。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Yes, very funny.
plugin_fields.target: 呵，這笑話可真好笑。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You are now married. My commiserations... I mean congratulations. May you forever remember this day and learn from it.
plugin_fields.target: 你們正式結為連理了。我向你們致以深切的同情……我是說祝賀。願你們永遠銘記這一天，並在其中吸取慘痛的教訓。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I don't know what to say. This is the happiest day of my life. Which actually isn't that difficult, but yes, let's not spoil the moment.
plugin_fields.target: 我都激動得說不出話來了。這絕對是我這輩子最開心的一天。雖說這個標準的門檻其實挺低的，不過，咱們還是別破壞這浪漫的氣氛了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Yes, yes. This all very sweet but what about my money? You said you would pay me 1000 gold for this special ceremony.
plugin_fields.target: 是是。這一切都非常感人，但我的錢呢？你明明說好主持完這場見鬼的儀式就給我一千金幣的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Uh... Yes about that.
plugin_fields.target: 呃……對，關於那件事嘛。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I should have known this was another one of your empty promises, just like you promised to deliver that love letter.
plugin_fields.target: 我早該猜到這又是你隨口畫的一張大餅，就像你上次答應去送那封情書一樣不靠譜。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: But I did deliver that letter.
plugin_fields.target: 我明明送到了好嗎。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Ok so maybe I accidentally dropped it in some cow dung and had it delivered by the town drunk but it did arrive... eventually.
plugin_fields.target: 好吧，我可能是不小心把它掉進了牛糞堆裡，然後又隨便塞給了街頭某個醉漢代為跑腿……但最終它還是送達了啊。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: It's not my fault she got offended and threw it away.
plugin_fields.target: 她收到信之後氣急敗壞地把它扔了，這鍋總不能也扣在我頭上吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So that was kind of fun I guess... well not really. Let's just go and find something else to do. What do married couples do anyway?
plugin_fields.target: 這結個婚好像還挺好玩的……好吧其實也就那樣。咱們還是去找點其他樂子吧。所以，結了婚的兩個人平時都能幹點啥？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I don't think I've stuck around with anyone for as long as I have with you.
plugin_fields.target: 說實話，我還從來沒跟誰在一起待過這麼長的時間。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I really like you though and you are one of the bravest and most heroic people I know. If only someone like you was to... uh never mind.
plugin_fields.target: 不過我確實挺喜歡你的，你是我見過最勇敢、最了不起的英雄。要是像你這樣的人能……哎，當我沒說。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I have noticed that you have been giving me a lot of gifts lately. Whilst I appreciate it it does make me wonder whether there is some secret reason.
plugin_fields.target: 我發現你最近老是往我手裡塞禮物。我當然很高興啦，但這也不禁讓我犯嘀咕，你是不是瞞著我圖謀不軌？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So we have spent quite a while together now and have got to know each other better. You could even say we were quite close.
plugin_fields.target: 不知不覺咱們也一塊兒混了這麼久了，可以說是知根知底。甚至說咱們關係相當親密都不為過吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Have you ever found that it is really hard to tell people the way you really feel? You can be close to them and they might even know that,
plugin_fields.target: 你有沒有發現，要把自己的真心話向別人坦白是一件極其困難的事？你們明明很親近，甚至他們可能早就察覺到了你的心意，
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: but to actually say the words is difficult. Sorry I'm just rambling.
plugin_fields.target: 但真要親口說出那幾個字，就感覺像喉嚨被堵住了一樣。抱歉，我又在胡言亂語了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Have you noticed how boring the couples in Skyrim are? I bet we would make a much better couple... uh I mean not that... I was just... uh never mind.
plugin_fields.target: 你有沒有發現天際裡的那些情侶活得有多無聊？我敢打賭，要是換作咱們倆湊一對絕對比他們強一百倍……呃我不是說那個……我只是……算了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Are you ok? You seem a little distracted.
plugin_fields.target: 你還好嗎？你看上去有點心不在焉的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well there is this person that I have feelings for but I don't know if you... uh I mean they feel the same way.
plugin_fields.target: 那個，其實有個人一直讓我挺動心的，但我不知道你……呃我是說，不知道那個人是不是也對我有同樣的感覺。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I am good friends with them but I don't want to spoil things between us.
plugin_fields.target: 畢竟我們已經是很好的朋友了，我不想因為說破了反而把關係搞僵。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Are you ok? You seem a little distracted.
plugin_fields.target: 你還好嗎？你看上去有點心不在焉的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well there is this person that I have feelings for but I don't know if you... uh I mean they feel the same way.
plugin_fields.target: 那個，其實有個人一直讓我挺動心的，但我不知道你……呃我是說，不知道那個人是不是也對我有同樣的感覺。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I am good friends with them but I don't want to spoil things between us.
plugin_fields.target: 畢竟我們已經是很好的朋友了，我不想因為說破了反而把關係搞僵。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Don't worry, you're better off without all that romance nonsense.
plugin_fields.target: 別擔心，沒有那些所謂的浪漫破事兒你會過得更好。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Oh... yes, I suppose you may be right.
plugin_fields.target: 噢……好吧，你說得也對。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Yes, I am in a similar situation.
plugin_fields.target: 是的，我也遇到過類似的情況。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Really? Who is this person?
plugin_fields.target: 真的嗎？那人是誰？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Okay, perhaps we should talk about something else.
plugin_fields.target: 好吧，也許我們該聊點別的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Oh, okay.
plugin_fields.target: 噢，這樣啊。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Oh, nobody you would know.
plugin_fields.target: 噢，是個你不認識的人。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Oh okay.
plugin_fields.target: 哦，行吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'm not sure I should say. You do seem to get a little jealous.
plugin_fields.target: 我不確定該不該說，你看起來確實有點吃醋了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Jealous!? Me!? I have never been jealous of anyone. Everyone is jealous of me. I don't care about you or who you like.
plugin_fields.target: 嫉妒！？我！？我可從來沒嫉妒過任何人，只有別人嫉妒我的份兒。我才不在乎你，更不在乎你心裡惦記著誰。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well... um it's you.
plugin_fields.target: 好吧……嗯，是你。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Me!? I... I don't know what to say. I really like you too. Don't think this changes anything though.
plugin_fields.target: 我！？我……我高興得都不知道該說什麼了。其實我也很喜歡你。不過，別以為這就能改變什麼。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You will never be better than me and I will never answer to you.
plugin_fields.target: 你這輩子都休想超越我，我也絕對不會淪為你呼之即去的應聲蟲。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Look, I barely know you so don't try anything on with me. I'm not that easy you know.
plugin_fields.target: 聽著，咱倆還沒熟到能掏心掏肺的地步，別想趁機對我動什麼歪腦筋。我可不是那種隨便的人，你懂的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well I truly am flattered but it just wouldn't work out between us. I see you as more of a good friend.
plugin_fields.target: 你能這麼說我真的受寵若驚。但咱們倆是絕對沒戲的。其實我一直都只拿你當好朋友來看。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Who is it?
plugin_fields.target: 是誰？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Oh never mind it's no one. I'm fine, let's just keep moving.
plugin_fields.target: 噢沒誰，當我什麼都沒說。我沒事，我們還是趕緊趕路吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So has there ever been anyone special in your life?
plugin_fields.target: 在你的生命中，有沒有出現過什麼特別的人？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well there was someone but he wasn't from Skyrim. He was a Breton from High Rock. I took him around Skyrim to see the sights,
plugin_fields.target: 倒還真有這麼一號人，不過他不是天際人。是個來自高巖省的布萊頓人。我當時帶著他到處遊山玩水，
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: well mainly the taverns, but unfortunately I turned out to be too much to handle for him. I mean who doesn't like to get drunk?
plugin_fields.target: 好吧其實主要是帶他逛遍了各大酒館，結果他根本招架不住我這種狂野的作風。我是說還有人能拒絕喝個爛醉的誘惑嗎？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Perhaps if someone else was interested in me though?
plugin_fields.target: 不過，要是剛好有別的人對我有意思的話呢？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well, I can think of someone who I may be interested in.
plugin_fields.target: 嗯，我倒是能想到一個我挺感興趣的人。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Who?
plugin_fields.target: 誰？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well, you know that weird guy in Whiterun?
plugin_fields.target: 嗯，你認識白漫城裡那個奇怪的傢夥嗎？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Ugh! Gross! I hope you are just joking. I was hoping someone a bit more like... somebody I know.
plugin_fields.target: 嘔！太噁心了吧！希望你只是在開玩笑。我其實是希望能找個更像……我認識的人。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'm so happy we are kind of a couple now but don't you think we should make things official?
plugin_fields.target: 我很高興咱們現在勉強算是一對兒了。不過你難道不覺得咱們該把這名分給坐實了嗎？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I wouldn't want you thinking you can just find somebody else without any consequences.
plugin_fields.target: 我可不想讓你誤以為以後你出去沾花惹草還能全身而退，連一點代價都不用付。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Would you be interested in marrying me?
plugin_fields.target: 你有興趣和我結婚嗎？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Really? You mean that? I always dreamt this day would come. Um tell you what, you leave the wedding arrangements to me.
plugin_fields.target: 當真？你沒糊弄我？我做夢都盼著這一天呢。那什麼，婚禮的事兒就包在我身上了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Sorry but isn't it a little bit too soon for all that? You kind of come across as desperate.
plugin_fields.target: 但你這進展是不是也太快了點兒？你看起來有點太猴急了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So now that we are married are there certain things I have to do? Like actually making an effort? No, that's not going to happen.
plugin_fields.target: 既然咱倆都結婚了，我是不是還得做點什麼？比如真的為了婚姻去付出點努力？拉倒吧，那種事絕不可能發生在我身上。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I heard that it is tradition for married couples to have breakfast in bed so I made you some breakfast and tipped it on your mattress.
plugin_fields.target: 我聽說夫妻在床上吃早餐是種傳統，所以我給你做了些早餐，然後倒在你的床墊上了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So I suppose you will want me to make you dinner from now on. What would you prefer bread or cheese? Perhaps both if I feel like putting on a feast.
plugin_fields.target: 看樣子你是指望我以後每天伺候你吃晚飯咯。你今晚是想啃乾麵包還是嚼乳酪塊？如果本小姐心情好，也許會破例賞你個麵包夾乳酪的「豪華大餐」。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Nah that's too much work for me.
plugin_fields.target: 算了，那也太折騰我了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So since we have to share a bed I hope you don't mind if I snore or have a little flatulence.
plugin_fields.target: 既然咱們以後要擠同一張床了，那希望你千萬別介意我半夜打呼嚕，或者不小心放幾個悶屁熏熏你。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I have heard that people toss in their sleep. If we share a bed I hope you don't make a mess on my side.
plugin_fields.target: 我聽說有人睡覺時很不老實。如果我們同睡一張床，我希望你別把我這邊也弄得一塌糊塗。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You know since we are married now that means what's yours is mine. I reckon this could be quite a beneficial relationship.
plugin_fields.target: 你知道的，既然我們已經結了婚，那就意味著你的就是我的。我越發覺得這絕對是一門穩賺不賠的好生意。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: OK, so it's normal for couples to fight apparently, so I will try and make this painless. I will use a blunt object to whack you with instead.
plugin_fields.target: 行吧，看樣子夫妻之間幹架是家常便飯。我會儘量下手輕點兒，下次揍你的時候我保證只用鈍器砸。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I suppose being married now means I can shout at you all I want. This is going to be fun.
plugin_fields.target: 我想現在結了婚就意味著，我想怎麼吼你你都得受著。以後的日子絕對越來越好玩了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Um where's my gift? Don't tell me you forgot our anniversary!? Well it was worth a try.
plugin_fields.target: 呃，我的禮物呢？別告訴我你忘了我們的紀念日！？好吧，這也算值得一試。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I suppose being married means teasing other men is out of the question? What about getting free drinks?
plugin_fields.target: 結了婚是不是就意味著我再也不能隨心所欲地去撩撥其他男人了？那順便騙他們請我喝幾杯免費酒總行吧？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You know being married does have its benefits. I can now follow you around everywhere you go, every single moment of every day, forever and ever.
plugin_fields.target: 你瞧，結婚確實也是有好處的。從今往後，不管你躲到天涯海角，我都能像背後靈一樣全天候24小時死死地黏著你，直到海枯石爛永不分離。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: What's the matter? You look a little pale.
plugin_fields.target: 怎麼了親愛的？你臉色看起來怎麼有點發白啊？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I think it's time we both work up a nice sweat. How about we go and you know...
plugin_fields.target: 我覺得是時候幹點能讓人酣暢淋漓大出熱汗的事了。不如我們去……你懂的……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: kill something. What!? What did you think I meant?
plugin_fields.target: ……去殺點什麼。什麼！？你以為我指的是什麼？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You must be the luckiest person alive to have me as your wife. I bet most people would give up their sword arm for the honour.
plugin_fields.target: 能娶我做妻子，你一定是世上最幸運的人。我打賭大多數人願意為了這份殊榮獻出他們拿劍的手臂。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So now we are married what are you going to do for me? Perhaps I could get you doing a bit of cooking, cleaning, that kind of stuff. What?
plugin_fields.target: 既然咱倆連婚都結了，你打算怎麼伺候我？以後家裡那些做飯洗衣掃地倒馬桶的瑣事，全包給你幹怎麼樣？怎麼？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: What you don't expect me to do that surely?
plugin_fields.target: 你總不至於指望我去做那些粗活吧？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I think as the dominant one in this relationship I should have control of all of our gold. What? I'm sorry to tell you but it's no longer just yours.
plugin_fields.target: 我覺得既然我在這個家裡是說一不二的一家之主，那家裡的財政大權自然該全權交由我掌管。怎麼？很遺憾地通知你，從今往後你的錢再也不是你一個人的了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'm so happy you gave up your perfect life of independence for me. I kind of feel bad for you now knowing what's in store.
plugin_fields.target: 你願意為了我放棄你那自由自在的單身生活，這可真讓我感動。但一想到你接下來的日子，我都忍不住要開始可憐你了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: It looks like we will be together forever until death do us part. Looks like you will end up dead at some point then. It was just a joke... Kind of.
plugin_fields.target: 看來我們要永遠在一起了，直到死亡將我們分離。那照這麼說，你大概在未來的某個時候會死掉吧。開個玩笑而已……大概吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Beware of the woman with the bow and arrow, especially when she is holding her booze.
plugin_fields.target: 持弓嬌娥切莫撩，尤其玉手把金樽。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: A brilliant idea left her to hunt, oh but handling a weapon was too hard to do.
plugin_fields.target: 突發奇想逐獵去，怎奈兵戈使不馴。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: She sat in a bush and while steadying herself, she focused on movement while vision was blurred.
plugin_fields.target: 伏坐叢中強定神，醉眼迷離看未真。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: The arrow got planted in the bottom of an elf, and the screams that came from him were the loudest she'd heard.
plugin_fields.target: 一箭飛來貫尻入，精靈慘叫泣鬼神。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Oh, there once was a hero named Ragnar the Red who came riding to Whiterun from ole Rorikstead.
plugin_fields.target: 天際有豪俠，紅衣拉格納。身是洛鎮人，走馬上白漫。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: And the man did something and brandish his blade as he told of some battles and gold he had made.
plugin_fields.target: 豪擲百十金，含糊嘴邊掛。閒言戰幾回，愛將刀劍挎。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: But then he went quiet, did Ragnar the Red when he met a fierce woman Matilda, who said;
plugin_fields.target: 一日遭不測，話癆變啞巴。悍婦挑戰來，名喚瑪蒂達。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: "Oh, you talk and you lie and you drink all our mead, now I think it's high time that you stop that and bleed!"
plugin_fields.target: 「狂徒飲我酒，今日血濺沙！」
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: And so then came clashing and slashing of steel, as the brave lass Matilda charged in, with a meal.
plugin_fields.target: 俠女攜餐上，兵戈響咔嚓。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: And the man named Ragnar was talking no more- when his ugly big head rolled around on the floor!
plugin_fields.target: 可憐拉格納，大頭落階下！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: The Bow And Arrow
plugin_fields.target: 弓與箭
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Oh, I love that one!
plugin_fields.target: 噢，我喜歡那首！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'd love to sing for you.
plugin_fields.target: 很樂意為您獻唱。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: That's one of my favourites.
plugin_fields.target: 那是我的最愛之一。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Sure, why not?
plugin_fields.target: 何樂而不為？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Ragnar The Red
plugin_fields.target: 紅衣拉格納
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.target: 噢，我喜歡那首！

plugin_fields.target: 那是我的最愛之一。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Sure, why not?
plugin_fields.target: 何樂而不為？

plugin_fields.source: (Show relationship stats)
plugin_fields.target: （顯示好感度狀態）
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw
Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; manually reviewed target

plugin_fields.source: Can you sing for me?
plugin_fields.target: 你能為我唱首歌嗎？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Which song?
plugin_fields.target: 想聽哪首？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Test Function...
plugin_fields.target: 測試功能……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Running Test Function...
plugin_fields.target: 正在執行測試功能……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I would like you to wear this. (Set Outfit)
plugin_fields.target: 我希望你穿上這個。（設定套裝）
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: If you say so.
plugin_fields.target: 如果你這麼說的話。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Can I ask you something?
plugin_fields.target: 我能問你個問題嗎？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: There was something I wanted to ask you.
plugin_fields.target: 有件事我一直想問你。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Sure, what is it?
plugin_fields.target: 行啊，什麼事？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw
Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; manually reviewed target

plugin_fields.source: Sorry, I'm busy.
plugin_fields.target: 抱歉，我正忙著呢。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw
Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; manually reviewed target

plugin_fields.source: Would you rather have no gold and be good looking or rich and ugly?
plugin_fields.target: 你寧願選一貧如洗但美若天仙，還是腰纏萬貫但奇醜無比？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: No gold and good looking
plugin_fields.target: 一貧如洗但美若天仙
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Yeah me too. I would hate being ugly and I can just make gold on my looks. As long as I have enough for booze nothing else matters.
plugin_fields.target: 所見略同。我才不要變成醜八怪呢，憑我的美色想搞錢還不是分分鐘的事。只要賺的錢夠我買酒喝，其他的都是浮雲。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Rich and ugly
plugin_fields.target: 腰纏萬貫但奇醜無比
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: As much as I like gold I would never give up my amazing looks. What can you get with gold anyway? A fancy house? A new sword? How boring.
plugin_fields.target: 雖然我也愛錢，但打死我都不會拿我這張完美無瑕的臉去換。錢能買來什麼？一棟豪宅？一把新劍？俗不可耐。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: None of that really matters
plugin_fields.target: 這些都不重要
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Of course it does. It would take a lot of gold to spend time with someone as beautiful as me if you were ugly.
plugin_fields.target: 當然重要了。你要是長得醜，想泡我這麼驚為天人的絕世美女，不大出血砸錢怎麼可能辦得到。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You married a Hagraven? Stop it I can’t breathe. There was me worrying.
plugin_fields.target: 你居然跟一隻烏鴉鬼婆成親了？快閉嘴我笑得喘不過氣了。虧我還白為你操了半天心。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Shame on you for seeing Esmerelda on the side though. Well I’m not sure if killing her counts as a divorce but who cares.
plugin_fields.target: 不過你居然還在外面勾搭那個叫什麼艾斯梅拉達的小三，真是不要臉。雖然我也不確定一刀砍死她算不算辦了離婚手續，不過管他呢。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You married a Hagraven? Stop it I can’t breathe. There was me worrying.
plugin_fields.target: 你居然跟一隻烏鴉鬼婆成親了？快閉嘴我笑得喘不過氣了。虧我還白為你操了半天心。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Shame on you for seeing Esmerelda on the side though. Well I’m not sure if killing her counts as a divorce but who cares.
plugin_fields.target: 不過你居然還在外面勾搭那個叫什麼艾斯梅拉達的小三，真是不要臉。雖然我也不確定一刀砍死她算不算辦了離婚手續，不過管他呢。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You got married? It wasn’t to me was it? No it couldn’t have been I would be wearing a ring. Shame...
plugin_fields.target: 你結婚了？新娘該不會是我吧？不，絕對不可能是我，因為我手上連個戒指都沒有。真可惜……
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: uh what I mean is it’s a shame that you lost the ring... yea.
plugin_fields.target: 呃，我的意思是，你把結婚戒指給弄丟了，真可惜……對，真可惜。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You got married? But I thought we... Ugh! Your second wife is so dead! Nobody marries my lover and gets away with it!
plugin_fields.target: 你竟然結婚了？但我以為我們……啊！你新娶的那個二房死定了！敢搶走我的人，她絕對活不到明天！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Whiterun? Wow you really did travel a long way.
plugin_fields.target: 白漫城？哇哦，你這一路可真是夠能折騰的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Haha you stole a farmers prize winning goat and sold it to a giant? You really did have a good time.
plugin_fields.target: 哈哈，你居然把那個農場主心肝寶貝一樣的獲獎山羊偷走了，還轉手倒賣給了一個巨人？你玩得可真夠狂野的啊。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I guess there’s worse things you could have done with a goat though.
plugin_fields.target: 不過我想，你本來還能對那隻山羊做出更過分的事。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well you were lucky you only upset a priestess of Dibella.
plugin_fields.target: 算你運氣好，這次不過是得罪了個蒂貝拉女祭司而已。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Anyway we should go and find Sam but my memory is also a bit fuzzy as I didn't want to miss out on the fun.
plugin_fields.target: 不管怎樣，咱們還是趕緊去找那個山姆算賬吧，不過我昨晚光顧著瞎湊熱鬧，現在腦子裡也是一團漿糊。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Wow that was a night to remember. You certainly showed me a good time... You don’t remember any of it do you?
plugin_fields.target: 哇哦，昨晚可真是個不眠之夜。你那晚的表現簡直讓我欲罷不能……你該不會全斷片了吧？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Probably just as well, it might make things a little awkward between us... Um I’ve already said too much.
plugin_fields.target: 忘了也好，不然以後咱們見面怪尷尬的……呃，我好像說得太多了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You can beat him! Come on!
plugin_fields.target: 幹趴他！加油！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well you may have come out empty handed but... yeah you're empty handed. That's not exactly good is it.
plugin_fields.target: 好吧，雖然你可能兩手空空地回來了，但是……行吧，你就是兩手空空。這可不是什麼好事，對吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So you have the skull of corruption. As if there wasn't enough corrupt people in Skyrim.
plugin_fields.target: 你居然拿到了墮落頭骨。說得好像天際裡滿地爬的墮落人渣還不夠多似的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I don’t think I will be spending the night with you here then. Uh, no I didn’t mean it like... I meant... Nevermind let’s just follow this guy.
plugin_fields.target: 那看來今晚我是沒法陪你在這兒過夜了。呃，不，我不是那個意思……我是說……算了，咱們還是先盯緊前面那傢夥吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So you let him live and gave up any hope of getting your hands on a legendary daedric artefact. Oh well, it’s your call.
plugin_fields.target: 所以你居然發善心饒了他一命，白白錯失了把這件傳說級魔神器搞到手的機會。行吧，你高興就好。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So you decided to kill him. That was probably a smart move. After all I doubt Mehrunes Dagon would have fixed it otherwise.
plugin_fields.target: 看樣子你最終還是選擇宰了他。這絕對是明智之舉。畢竟如果不這麼幹，我估計梅魯涅斯·大袞是絕不會幫你把它修好的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So he’s going to fix the dagger. Don’t let him walk away with it once it’s mended.
plugin_fields.target: 所以他打算把那把匕首修好。等他一修完，可千萬別讓他捲著匕首跑路了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I don’t want him locking it away never to be used. We could make better use of it.
plugin_fields.target: 我可不想看著這等神器被他束之高閣暴殄天物。這寶貝在咱們手裡才能發光發熱。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: We have all three. Let’s go and collect our reward.
plugin_fields.target: 三塊碎片都集齊了。走，收戰利品去。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: We now have two pieces. Just the last one to find now.
plugin_fields.target: 現在碎片已經到手兩塊了。就差最後一塊了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So we have the first piece. Just two more to go.
plugin_fields.target: 第一塊到手。還有兩塊。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So all we have to do is fetch a few pieces for some blade. How hard can that be?
plugin_fields.target: 所以咱們這趟的活兒就是滿世界找幾塊破爛刀片。這聽起來也沒多難嘛。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: This is usually the moment that we discover that we have to go to some forbidden place full of perilous danger.
plugin_fields.target: 通常來說，每當我覺得簡單的時候，接下來咱們就得被迫鑽進某個機關重重的要命鬼地方了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Oh well, I suppose that makes it more interesting.
plugin_fields.target: 噢不過嘛，這樣反而更刺激了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I think we can deal with a few petty followers of Boethiah. This will be a piece of cake… hopefully a sweetroll.
plugin_fields.target: 區區幾個波耶西亞的狂熱腦殘粉，收拾他們簡直就是一碟小蛋糕……或者我更希望是一個甜捲。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Oh no I shouldn’t start thinking of food I’ll end up making myself hungry.
plugin_fields.target: 噢要命，我不該在這個節骨眼上想吃的，我都快被自己說饞了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Uh oh. I think you’ve upset them.
plugin_fields.target: 啊哦，看來你把他們惹毛了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You need to sacrifice someone who trusts you, that’s rather harsh even for me. Well I guess it’s the only way to earn Boethiah’s favour.
plugin_fields.target: 居然要求你去獻祭一個死心塌地信任你的人，這手段連我都覺得有點喪心病狂。不過，想討好波耶西亞估計也只有這一個法子了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: As long as you don’t try sacrificing me though I don’t care.
plugin_fields.target: 只要你別打我的主意把我給獻祭了，其他的我一概不關心。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Woah! You killed one of your own friends? That’s really messed up. Who am I to judge though.
plugin_fields.target: 哇靠！你居然殺了自己的朋友？這也太病態了。不過我也沒資格對你指指點點。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I’ve done some pretty terrible things that I’m not proud of but maybe not quite as bad.
plugin_fields.target: 我也對別人幹過些不太光彩的缺德事，雖然我不覺得光榮，但恐怕還沒惡劣到你這種地步。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: They were weak though so don’t get any ideas about me. I wouldn’t be so easy.
plugin_fields.target: 不過那些被我下手的人都很軟弱。所以你最好別把主意打到我頭上，我可沒那麼好對付。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: It’s our time to shine. Let’s go and get that pretender who actually thinks he’s worthy of being the champion of Boethiah.
plugin_fields.target: 輪到咱們大顯身手了。走，去會會那個恬不知恥、竟敢自詡為波耶西亞勇士的冒牌貨。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Wow that’s a pretty good reward. No using it to spy on me though.
plugin_fields.target: 哇哦，這賞賜可夠大手筆的。不過你最好別用這玩意兒來偷窺我。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I find most of the children in Skyrim to be evil little creatures,
plugin_fields.target: 我一直覺得天際的小屁孩基本上都是一幫沒教養的惡魔，
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: and I don’t suppose being spoilt little brats because their father happens to be the jarl helps.
plugin_fields.target: 尤其是這幾個有個當領主的爹在背後撐腰，更是把他們慣成了無法無天的混世魔王。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Anyway let’s check it out, it sounds interesting at the very least.
plugin_fields.target: 不管了，咱們過去看看情況，這聽起來還挺有意思的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: That doesn’t sound like any normal door to me. I reckon there’s something evil lurking behind it,
plugin_fields.target: 這聽著怎麼這麼邪門兒。我敢打賭，那門後絕對藏著什麼極其惡毒的玩意兒，
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: so be on your guard and don’t trust what it has to say.
plugin_fields.target: 所以你要提高警惕，千萬別相信它說的話。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: How are we supposed to get the key? I suppose you could try and steal it somehow.
plugin_fields.target: 咱們該怎麼搞到鑰匙？我想憑你那雞鳴狗盜的手藝，總能想辦法把它順走吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I’m not sure I would want to touch that weapon as from what I’ve heard, that thing corrupts peoples minds but I’m not stopping you from using it.
plugin_fields.target: 如果是我，我絕對不會去碰那把見鬼的武器。我可是聽人說過，那玩意兒會吞噬人的心智，當然，你要是執意想用它我也懶得攔你。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Just don't go all crazy on me.
plugin_fields.target: 只要你別因為它對我發瘋就行。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Are you sure this guy is right in the head? He said something about tea with his master who happens to be more important than the jarl,
plugin_fields.target: 你確定這傢夥腦子沒病嗎？他剛才居然瘋言瘋語說什麼他的主子比領主還要牛逼，這會兒正等著跟他一起喝下午茶，
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: and that we need a hip bone to gain access to the unused wing of the Blue Palace. Oh well can’t hurt to look I suppose.
plugin_fields.target: 然後咱們居然還得靠著一截死人的髖骨才能混進藍宮那荒廢的側廳。噢算了，去開開眼界總沒壞處。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So you have the Wabbajack huh? Sounds interesting. I wonder what crazy stuff this staff can do? I bet it doesn't make people naked though.
plugin_fields.target: 所以你把瓦巴傑克搞到手了？聽起來還挺帶感的。真好奇這破法杖到底能整出什麼花活兒。不過我打賭它肯定沒有剝光別人衣服的功能。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So she has these funny visions. I’ve also had visions about you, no wait a minute I think they were dreams.
plugin_fields.target: 所以她滿腦子都是些亂七八糟的幻象。其實我腦子裡也經常冒出關於你的幻象，等等，那好像是我做過的夢才對。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I think I best keep them to myself though, they were a little inappropriate.
plugin_fields.target: 不過我覺得我還是把那些畫面憋在肚子裡比較好，畢竟畫面實在是有點……不太能播。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Isn’t it funny how every time we want something we have to go into some long forgotten cave or tomb or some other ancient structure
plugin_fields.target: 你不覺得很搞笑嗎，每次我們想要找點什麼寶貝，最後總是免不了進入一些被遺忘已久的洞穴、墳墓或其他古老建築，
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: and do a lot of killing. The gods certainly don’t want to make our lives easy.
plugin_fields.target: 然後就是一陣毫無懸唸的血腥大屠殺。看來眾神是鐵了心不想讓咱們有哪怕一天的好日子過。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well we have the star but it seems pretty useless at the moment. I suppose it’s time to decide who we should give it to.
plugin_fields.target: 這顆破星星總算弄到手了，但看起來暫時也只是一塊沒用的發光石頭。是時候決定咱們該把它送給哪個大冤種了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well I’m glad we took the star to Nelacar as he seems to be the one with the knowledge of how this thing works
plugin_fields.target: 老實說，我挺慶幸咱們把這星星交給了內拉卡。看來整個天際也就只有他這種老學究才知道這破石頭到底該怎麼用，
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: and has even made it so it can trap human souls.
plugin_fields.target: 他居然還能把這玩意兒改造成能吸人類靈魂的大殺器。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well we now have the star it’s just a pity it doesn’t work on human souls. There are quite a few people I would like to trap in there if I had my way
plugin_fields.target: 星星倒是到手了，只可惜這玩意兒居然吸不了人的靈魂。要是這東西真管用，我黑名單上可有一長串的名字等著被我關進去做成標本呢。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You’ve got to feel sorry for the orcs. Not only are they cursed with being hideously ugly
plugin_fields.target: 我有時候真挺同情這幫獸人的。他們生下來不僅被老天爺詛咒長著一張慘絕人寰的醜臉，
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: but they also get cursed by their daedric prince who they for some reason look up to.
plugin_fields.target: 甚至還要被那個他們當成祖宗一樣供著的魔神再詛咒一遍。這到底圖個啥啊。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Oh dear, I think he has upset Malacath. Anyway who does he think he is? We don’t have to help him at all,
plugin_fields.target: 哎呀我的媽，我看這老傢夥是真的把瑪拉凱斯給徹底惹毛了。話說回來，他算哪根蔥？咱們壓根就沒義務幫他收拾這個爛攤子，
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: he’s a rubbish leader and he should be grateful we even bothered to try and help with his tribes curse.
plugin_fields.target: 他就是一個一無是處的廢物首領，咱們肯屈尊去替他解除部落的詛咒，他早就該感極涕零了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: If that orc doesn’t pay up then I say we show him how weak and pathetic he really is.
plugin_fields.target: 如果那個死獸人敢事後不付咱們酬勞，那咱們就好好教他做人，讓他見識見識自己到底是個什麼窩囊廢。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I thought orcs were supposed to strong and fearless and die fighting. This guy is a complete joke and it’s no wonder Malacath is angry.
plugin_fields.target: 我一直以為獸人都是些悍不畏死、寧願戰死沙場的猛男。這傢夥簡直就是個徹頭徹尾的小丑，難怪瑪拉凱斯氣得要在天上跳腳。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Did he really think he could take us on and that Malacath wouldn’t have noticed that he cheated? Orcs aren’t the most intelligent creatures though.
plugin_fields.target: 他腦子被門擠了嗎，居然覺得他那點三腳貓的功夫能打得過咱們？更別提瑪拉凱斯怎麼可能看不穿他那點偷雞摸狗的把戲？不過考慮到獸人的智商普遍堪憂，這倒也不奇怪。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well it seems that you are Malacaths new champion and that you get a nice new weapon to beat any other orcs who try it on with us senseless.
plugin_fields.target: 好吧，看來你現在已經是瑪拉凱斯的新一任神選勇士了。而且你還拿到了一把趁手的新武器，以後再有哪個不長眼的獸人敢來找茬，你大可以拿它去敲碎他們的腦殼。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: That can’t be good.
plugin_fields.target: 這可不是什麼好事。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: There’s no denying someone with that kind of power. We better do as he says and kill him quick, before he kills us.
plugin_fields.target: 面對擁有那種力量的存在，我們根本無法抗拒。咱們最好乖乖照他說的辦，趕在這傢夥弄死咱們之前，先一刀解決了他。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I hope he doesn’t mean bowels as in the kind inside of people otherwise that would be kind of gross.
plugin_fields.target: 我祈禱他說的「深入腸子內部」不是指物理意義上鑽進人的大腸裡，要不然那場面也太倒胃口了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I was so afraid just then when he trapped you inside of that thing. I thought we were dead for sure especially when I found out it was Molag Bal.
plugin_fields.target: 剛才他把你鎖在那個破籠子裡的時候，我嚇得魂都沒了。我當時滿腦子都在想這回絕對是死定了，特別是當我反應過來那玩意兒居然是莫拉格·巴爾。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: the daedric prince of domination, possibly the most fearsome and evil of them all.
plugin_fields.target: 那可是執掌奴役與支配的魔神啊，十有八九是那幫魔神裡最窮兇極惡、最喪心病狂的瘋子。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: We better do as he says as I would rather someone else be dominated by him than myself. I prefer to be the one doing the dominating.
plugin_fields.target: 咱們最好還是乖乖照做，我寧可看別人被他支配，也絕對不想親身體驗。要玩「支配遊戲」，我永遠只做支配別人的那一方。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Now that looked painful. Remind me never to get on Molag Bals bad side.
plugin_fields.target: 那場面看著都讓人覺得骨頭疼。你得時刻提醒我，打死都不能去招惹莫拉格·巴爾那個瘋批。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Anyway that is one evil looking mace, I bet it could do some real damage to someone.
plugin_fields.target: 不過話說回來，那把破狼牙棒看起來還真是邪氣凜然。我敢打賭，要是被它砸上一下，絕對能把人砸成重傷。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I thought incense was forbidden... no wait a minute I think that was incest.
plugin_fields.target: 我原以為「進香」是被禁止的……不對，等等，我記混了，被禁止的應該是「近親」。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Ew... What is that disgusting smell and that strange green goo?
plugin_fields.target: 嘔……這股作嘔的臭味是怎麼回事？還有那一灘灘綠油油的噁心黏液是什麼鬼？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So wait a minute…we have to go to some place full of infectious, diseased people? No thanks.
plugin_fields.target: 等等，你先讓我捋捋……你的意思是我們要去一個充滿傳染病和患者的地方？不了，謝謝。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Ah who am I kidding I couldn’t let you go alone I care too much about you. Damn it, let’s not make this all awkward. I don’t really do sentimental.
plugin_fields.target: 哎呀我在騙誰呢，我不能讓你一個人去，我太在乎你了。該死，別把氣氛搞得這麼尷尬。我不習慣多愁善感。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Ew... did he just try and spray goo all over my face? At least I think it was a he, I wasn’t really paying attention.
plugin_fields.target: 嘔……那傢夥剛才是不是想把那灘噁心的黏液噴我一臉？我猜那是個雄性生物吧，我連正眼都沒瞧他一下。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Anyway it wouldn’t be the first time a guy has got sticky gunk all over my face... Oh no it’s not what you think.
plugin_fields.target: 不過話說回來，這倒也不是第一次有傢夥把那種黏糊糊的東西噴我一臉了……噢別亂想，根本不是你腦子裡想的那種齷齪事。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I upset an alchemist and he started throwing bottles of... oh don’t worry I’ll tell you some other time.
plugin_fields.target: 我之前不小心惹惱了一個鍊金術士，然後他就抓起各種瓶瓶罐罐朝我砸過來……哎呀別管了，改天我再仔細跟你講。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well he’s dead and we haven’t been killed by a nasty disease yet so I’m assuming Peryite is pleased with us. I see a reward coming our way.
plugin_fields.target: 好吧，他死了，而且我們還沒被惡疾弄死，所以我猜魄伊特對我們很滿意。看來我們有獎賞拿了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well it’s not a big weapon but it’s always good to wear protection. Actually do you wear a shield I’m not sure, but you get what I mean right?
plugin_fields.target: 這盾牌雖然算不上什麼重型大殺器，但老話說得好，「做好安全措施總歸沒壞處」。老實說我甚至沒留意過你到底用不用盾，但你肯定懂我的意思對吧？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Just be careful not to wear it out.
plugin_fields.target: 就是別用得太狠把它給磨破了就行。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Woah! You were just floating high up in the sky. I felt sick just watching.
plugin_fields.target: 哇！你剛才居然整個人都懸在半空中。我光是抬頭看著都覺得頭暈目眩的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Anyway from what I heard Meridia wants you to get back her temple from some guy called Malkoran. Sounds easy enough.
plugin_fields.target: 聽那架勢，似乎是梅瑞狄雅讓你去幫她把神殿從一個叫什麼莫克然的傢夥手裡給搶回來？聽起來簡直是小菜一碟嘛。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Wow shiny balls. I do like shiny balls. Ok a bit random but ah whatever.
plugin_fields.target: 哇哦，發光的小球球。我就好這口亮晶晶的圓球。好吧，我承認我有點神經質，隨便啦。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well Malkoran was no match for us even if he did have lots of strange ghostly skeleton things to help him.
plugin_fields.target: 我就說嘛，那個什麼莫克然在咱們面前根本就不夠看的，就算他召喚了一大堆見鬼的發光排骨精出來助陣。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Now let’s take Dawnbreaker and get out of here. Perhaps you should make sure you grab all the loot you can first as these dead guys seem to be loaded
plugin_fields.target: 好了，趕緊拿上破曉者然後閃人吧。不過在離開之前，你最好仔細搜刮一下這幫死鬼的口袋，他們看起來可是富得流油呢。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well you now have the mighty Dawnbreaker from no less than Meridia herself. Sometimes I amaze myself at how easily we stumble across such treasures.
plugin_fields.target: 絕了，你這趟居然白嫖了一把梅瑞狄雅親自賜福的逆天神器破曉者。有時候我連自己都覺得不可思議，咱們是怎麼做到隨便散個步都能踩中這種稀世珍寶的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You just accepted a cursed ring? Now you’re the one who’s cursed. You must be crazy helping out a child murderer.
plugin_fields.target: 你居然想都沒想就接下了一枚被詛咒的戒指？恭喜你，現在你就是那個被詛咒的倒霉蛋了。你絕對是腦子進水了才會去幫一個殺小孩的連環兇手跑腿。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Oh well if what he says is true then we may actually meet Hircine and then perhaps we can get on his good side and be rewarded with true power.
plugin_fields.target: 不過話又說回來，要是他沒撒謊，咱們沒準真能見到海爾辛本尊。要是能順勢拍拍這位魔神的馬屁，說不定咱們也能分到一點逆天的力量呢。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Time to prove ourselves to Hircine then so we better not fail.
plugin_fields.target: 是時候向海爾辛大展身手了，這次只許成功，不許失敗。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I love to hunt, in fact I think I have killed every type of thing there is to kill so this should be no problem for me.
plugin_fields.target: 我生平最愛狩獵了，說實話，我覺得這世上但凡能喘氣兒的玩意兒都被我屠過一遍了，所以這點小場面對我來說絕對不在話下。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Looks like we’re up against some competition but they should be no match for us considering what we’ve been through.
plugin_fields.target: 看來這次咱們還有幾個不自量力的競爭對手。不過就憑咱們一路走來那些刀光劍影的履歷，這幫菜雞根本不夠咱們塞牙縫的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well that was my kind of hunting. You should try that new outfit on, I reckon it would make you look even more irresistible.
plugin_fields.target: 這才是我夢寐以求的狩獵方式。你真該趕緊換上那套新行頭試試，我敢打賭你穿上它絕對能迷死人不償命。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Uh what I mean is it will probably look good on you.
plugin_fields.target: 呃，我是說，那衣服你穿肯定挺精神的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You let him go. I’m not sure you should have unleashed such a dangerous creature into the wild and I was looking forward to a bit of hunting,
plugin_fields.target: 你居然放他走了？我真不敢相信你竟然把這麼個嗜血的怪物重新放歸山林。我本來還期待著能大開殺戒過把癮呢，
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: but I suppose everyone's conscience kicks in sooner or later. Still the ring may have some future use.
plugin_fields.target: 不過算啦，人非草木，就算是冷血殺手偶爾也會良心發現的。不管怎樣，那枚戒指留著說不定以後還能派上什麼大用場。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You cheated haha. But seriously I’m impressed at your level of genius. Not many people could fool a daedric prince like that.
plugin_fields.target: 你居然作弊哈哈。不過說正經的，你這鑽空子的天賦真是讓我佩服得五體投地。這世上能把一個魔神當猴耍的人可真找不出幾個。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: A talking dog? Either I’m going mad or you’ve been putting skooma in my drinks and moon sugar in my food.
plugin_fields.target: 一隻會口吐人言的狗？要麼是我腦子壞掉了，要麼就是你揹著我偷偷在我的酒裡摻了斯庫瑪，還往我的飯裡撒了月亮糖。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Anyway I don’t trust any animal that can talk, I’m not even sure I trust my own mind right now.
plugin_fields.target: 總之我是絕對不會去相信一隻長了人嘴的畜生的。說真的，我現在連我自己腦子正不正常都不敢確定了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Haha I like his style. Someone is suffering so what’s the easy solution? Just kill them.
plugin_fields.target: 哈哈，這魔神對我的胃口。有人正在生不如死，最簡單粗暴的解決辦法是什麼？當然是殺了他們。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Anyway it looks like we may be in for a reward if we pull this off and a bit of adventure at the same time. My time with you is anything but dull.
plugin_fields.target: 不管怎樣，看這架勢只要咱們能把這爛攤子搞定，不僅能撈著一筆豐厚的賞金，還能順便享受一場刺激的冒險。跟著你混，我的生活可真是精彩紛呈啊。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So you chose to kill the dog. I guess he was pretty annoying and you get a rare daedric artefact in return.
plugin_fields.target: 結果你還是選擇了把那條狗給宰了。也是，那狗平時確實吵得人心煩，拿它的命換一件稀有的魔神器，這筆買賣怎麼算都值了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I bet if you told people of our adventure with a talking dog, a bunch of vampires and a strange daedric prince they would think that you are crazy.
plugin_fields.target: 我敢打包票，要是你把咱們這一趟跟一隻會說話的狗、一窩老古董吸血鬼，還有一個神經病魔神混在一起的冒險經歷說出去，別人絕對會把你當成從瘋人院跑出來的精神病。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So you chose not to kill the dog. I guess it was the right thing to do and he didn’t seem that upset.
plugin_fields.target: 所以你居然選擇了放那條狗一條生路。我猜這大概也是唯一積點德的做法了，而且那魔神看起來好像也沒氣得跳腳。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You may have lost the axe but you get a cool enchanted mask in return so it wasn’t a total waste of time.
plugin_fields.target: 雖然你跟那把拉風的斧頭失之交臂，但好歹也換回來一張附了魔的炫酷面具，這趟折騰也不算完全是白費功夫。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I bet if you told people of our adventure with a talking dog, a bunch of vampires and a strange daedric prince they would think that you are crazy.
plugin_fields.target: 我敢打包票，要是你把咱們這一趟跟一隻會說話的狗、一窩老古董吸血鬼，還有一個神經病魔神混在一起的冒險經歷說出去，別人絕對會把你當成從瘋人院跑出來的精神病。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: So we need to kill one of each type of elf. This sounds as though it could be rather enjoyable.
plugin_fields.target: 所以咱們接下來要像集郵一樣，把每一種精靈都挨個殺一遍？光是聽聽就覺得這絕對是一場酣暢淋漓的血腥狂歡啊。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Well now those elfs suffered at our hand we better go and see what reward Hermaeus Mora has in store for us.
plugin_fields.target: 大功告成，那些長耳朵的精靈全都成了咱們的刀下亡魂了。咱們還是趕緊去看看赫麥尤斯·莫拉到底給咱們備了什麼大禮吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Being the Daedric prince of knowledge and memory I’m guessing he’s going to give us some kind of forbidden secret.
plugin_fields.target: 既然他是號稱掌管知識與記憶的魔神，我猜他一定會傳授給我們某種駭人聽聞的禁忌秘術。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Let’s hope it’s something like the answer to how to stay young and good looking forever.
plugin_fields.target: 最好是類似於「如何永葆青春、容顏不老」這類的終極奧秘。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: A book? Is that it?
plugin_fields.target: 就這？一本破書？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: It better contain some knowledge that mere mortals cannot comprehend such as the meaning of life otherwise I’m going to be very disappointed.
plugin_fields.target: 它裡面最好記載了些凡人根本無法參透的知識，比如「生命的意義」什麼的，否則我這心都要涼透了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: You better get used to it kid as let's face it, I would be bullying you if I wasn't over twice your age.
plugin_fields.target: 你最好學著點去適應這種生活，小屁孩。咱們實話實說，如果不是因為我比你大了整整兩倍還多，我肯定會欺負你的。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Time to grow a back-bone and stop crying to mummy.
plugin_fields.target: 是時候學著硬氣一點了，別一受委屈就只會哭著去找媽媽。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'm not surprised. What girl would ever want to look at a loser like you?
plugin_fields.target: 意料之中。這世上哪個女孩會願意多看你這種失敗者一眼？
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Oh don't let her nonsense fool you. You will grow up to be a weak coward that everyone jokes about. You don't need a psychic to tell you that.
plugin_fields.target: 別被她的胡言亂語騙了。你長大後會變成一個懦弱無能、人人嘲笑的窩囊廢。這事兒根本不需要占卜師來預言。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I'm not surprised. If you were my child I would disown you. You are a disgrace to all nords.
plugin_fields.target: 一點都不意外。你要是我孩子，我也會和你斷絕關係。你簡直丟光了所有諾德人的臉。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Don't hurt me! You win.
plugin_fields.target: 別傷害我。我認輸。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: What? Nooo!
plugin_fields.target: 什麼？不！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Go away.
plugin_fields.target: 走開。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Get away from me.
plugin_fields.target: 離我遠點。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Trust me it will be him doing any licking. Ugh! Whatever just go and play with your dollies like a good little boy.
plugin_fields.target: 相信我，要舔也是他來舔。呃！不管了，像個聽話的小男孩一樣去玩你的洋娃娃吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: And the only people who talk back to me are six feet under... it seems you got lucky because of your age.
plugin_fields.target: 唯一敢跟我頂嘴的人此刻都已經躺在地下了……看來你是因為年紀小才逃過一劫。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Oh trust me if this is bothering you then you haven't seen anything yet. Just you wait.
plugin_fields.target: 噢相信我，如果這都讓你感到困擾，那你還什麼都沒見識到呢。你就等著瞧吧。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Get away from me.
plugin_fields.target: 離我遠點。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I don't have to take this from the likes of you.
plugin_fields.target: 我憑什麼要受你這種貨色的氣。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: No need to get rough!
plugin_fields.target: 不要這麼粗魯！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I don't have to take that from you!
plugin_fields.target: 你竟敢對我這麼放肆！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: And you might need to rethink that face before I rearrange it.
plugin_fields.target: 在我用拳頭幫你重新整容之前，你最好趕緊換上一副討人喜歡的嘴臉。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: How about I replace your face with my fist.
plugin_fields.target: 要不我一拳把你的臉砸扁怎麼樣。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: With what you are wearing I know for a fact we are in the wrong store. It's no wonder people don't ask the price.
plugin_fields.target: 就衝你身上這身破布條，我就知道咱們肯定是進錯店了。難怪大家進來都懶得問價錢。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: And I usually reserve a good beating for those who can take it but for you I'll make an exception.
plugin_fields.target: 我通常只把痛打留給那些抗揍的人，但對你，我可以破例一次。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Now let us turn our conversation away from such unpleasantness.
plugin_fields.target: 聽著，我們就別再談這件不開心的事了。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: No need to get rough!
plugin_fields.target: 不要這麼粗魯！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: Don't hurt me! You win.
plugin_fields.target: 別傷害我。我認輸。
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw

plugin_fields.source: I don't have to take that from you!
plugin_fields.target: 你竟敢對我這麼放肆！
plugin_fields.provenance: Sofia Traditional Chinese Localization Patch v2; OpenCC s2tw normalization; OpenCC s2tw
